AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a Step Functions workflow that sends custom events to a custom EventBridge bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.

Parameters:
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyStateMachine
    Description: Name for the Step Functions state machine.
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyCustomEventBus
    Description: Name for the custom EventBridge event bus.
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/events/my-custom-bus
    Description: Name for the CloudWatch Logs log group.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Retention period for the CloudWatch Logs log group.

Resources:
  # CloudWatch Logs Log Group for EventBridge rule target
  EventBridgeLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  # Resource policy to allow EventBridge to write to the log group
  EventBridgeLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EventBridgeLogGroupPolicy
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventBridgeLogGroup.Arn}"
            }
          ]
        }

  # Custom EventBridge Event Bus
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName

  # EventBridge Rule that forwards all events to CloudWatch Logs
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ""
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt EventBridgeLogGroup.Arn
          Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget

  # IAM Role for Step Functions to put events to EventBridge
  StepFunctionsEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToEventBridge
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  # Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsEventBridgeRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "A state machine that sends a custom event to EventBridge.",
          "StartAt": "SendEvent",
          "States": {
            "SendEvent": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
              "Parameters": {
                "Entries": [
                  {
                    "EventBusName": "${EventBusName}",
                    "Source": "com.example.myapp",
                    "DetailType": "UserAction",
                    "Detail": {
                      "userId": "12345",
                      "action": "login"
                    }
                  }
                ]
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group.
    Value: !Ref EventBridgeLogGroup

    Properties:

      Description: "Core network for centralized outbound traffic inspection"
      PolicyDocument:
        core-network-configuration:
          asn-ranges:
            - "64512-65534"
          edge-locations:
            - Location: "us-east-1"
            - Location: "us-west-2"
        segments:
          - name: "production"
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: "development"
            require-attachment-acceptance: true
        network-function-groups:
          - name: "inspection"
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 10
            action:
              association-method: tag
              segment: "production"
              tag-value-of-key: "Domain"
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: "Domain"
              - type: tag-value
                key: "Domain"
                value: "production"
          - rule-number: 20
            action:
              association-method: tag
              segment: "development"
              tag-value-of-key: "Domain"
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: "Domain"
              - type: tag-value
                key: "Domain"
                value: "development"
          - rule-number: 30
            action:
              association-method: tag
              network-function-group-name: "inspection"
              tag-value-of-key: "Function"
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: "Function"
              - type: tag-value
                key: "Function"
                value: "inspection"
        segment-actions:
          - action: send-via
            mode: dual-hop
            segment: "production"
            destination-cidr-blocks:

              - "0.0.0.0/0"
            send-via:
              - "inspection"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "InspectionCoreNetwork"

    Value: !Ref GlobalNetwork

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

  DynamoDBEncryptionKeyAlias:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create an AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) resource share for sharing resources across accounts."
Parameters:
  ResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyResourceShare"
    Description: "Name of the RAM resource share."
  ResourceArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional list of ARNs of resources to share (e.g., arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:123456789012:instance/*). Leave empty if not specifying resources."
  Principals:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional list of principals (AWS account IDs, OU ARNs, or organization ARN) to share resources with. Leave empty if not specifying principals."
  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Whether to allow external principals (accounts outside the organization) to access the shared resources."
Conditions:
  AllowExternal:
    !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, "true"]
  HasResourceArns:
    !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref ResourceArns], ""]]
  HasPrincipals:
    !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref Principals], ""]]
Resources:
  ResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If [AllowExternal, true, false]
      ResourceArns: !If
        - HasResourceArns
        - !Split [",", !Join [",", !Ref ResourceArns]]
        - []
      Principals: !If
        - HasPrincipals
        - !Split [",", !Join [",", !Ref Principals]]
        - []
Outputs:
  ResourceShareArn:
    Description: "ARN of the RAM resource share."
    Value: !Ref ResourceShare
  ResourceShareStatus:
    Description: "Status of the RAM resource share."
    Value: !GetAtt ResourceShare.Status

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a CodePipeline custom action type for OpsWorks deployment via Lambda, with provider equal to stack name"
Resources:
  CustomActionType:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::CustomActionType
    Properties:
      Category: Deploy
      Provider: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Version: "1"
      ConfigurationProperties:
        - Name: Deploy-Bucket
          Type: String
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Queryable: false
          Description: "The S3 bucket containing the deployment artifact"
        - Name: OpsWorks-Stack-ID
          Type: String
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Queryable: false
          Description: "The OpsWorks stack ID"
        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID
          Type: String
          Required: true
          Key: true
          Secret: false
          Queryable: false
          Description: "The OpsWorks app ID (key property)"
      InputArtifactDetails:
        MinimumCount: 1
        MaximumCount: 1
      OutputArtifactDetails:
        MinimumCount: 0
        MaximumCount: 0

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OpsWorksAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                  - opsworks:DescribeDeployments
                  - opsworks:DescribeApps
                  - opsworks:DescribeStacks
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OpsWorksDeploy"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              job_id = event['CodePipeline.job']['id']
              user_params = event['CodePipeline.job']['data']['actionConfiguration']['configuration']
              opsworks_stack_id = user_params['OpsWorks-Stack-ID']
              opsworks_app_id = user_params['OpsWorks-App-ID']

              client = boto3.client('opsworks')
              codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
              try:
                  client.create_deployment(
                      StackId=opsworks_stack_id,
                      AppId=opsworks_app_id,
                      Command={'Name': 'deploy'},
                      Comment='Deployment via CodePipeline custom action'
                  )
                  codepipeline.put_job_success_result(jobId=job_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  codepipeline.put_job_failure_result(
                      jobId=job_id,
                      failureDetails={
                          'type': 'JobFailed',
                          'message': str(e)
                      }
                  )
              return 'Done'
      Description: "Lambda function for OpsWorks deployment via CodePipeline custom action"

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: codepipeline.amazonaws.com

Outputs:
  CustomActionProvider:
    Description: "Provider name of the custom action type (equal to stack name)"
    Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  CustomActionTypeArn:
    Description: "ARN of the custom action type"
    Value: !Ref CustomActionType
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function"
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates DLM IAM role and lifecycle policy for daily snapshots of EBS volumes tagged with TeemDLM=daily, retaining 7 snapshots at 1:00 UTC.'
Resources:
  DLMServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DLMServiceInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:CopySnapshot
                Resource: '*'
  DailySnapshotPolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: 'Daily snapshot policy for EBS volumes tagged TeemDLM daily'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DLMServiceRole.Arn
      State: ENABLED
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: TeemDLM
            Value: daily
        Schedules:
          - Name: DailySnapshots
            CopyTags: true
            CreateRule:
              Interval: 24
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - '01:00'
            RetainRule:
              Count: 7
Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DLM service role
    Value: !GetAtt DLMServiceRole.Arn
  PolicyId:
    Description: ID of the DLM lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref DailySnapshotPolicy

Description: "IAM Access Analyzer with archive rules, managed via custom resource with proper error handling"
Parameters:

  DocsBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: "docs-bucket"

  ClientsBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: "clients-bucket"
    Description: "Name of the second S3 bucket"
Resources:
  AnalyzerCustomResourceFunction:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Function"
    Properties:
      Handler: "index.handler"
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: "python3.14"
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import requests
          import logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          client = boto3.client('accessanalyzer')
          def convert_archive_rules(archive_rules):
              converted = []
              for rule in archive_rules:
                  rule_name = rule.get('RuleName')
                  filters = rule.get('Filter', [])
                  filter_dict = {}
                  for f in filters:
                      prop = f.get('Property')
                      eq_values = f.get('Eq', [])
                      filter_dict[prop] = {'eq': eq_values}
                  converted.append({'ruleName': rule_name, 'filter': filter_dict})
              return converted
          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f"See details in CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_response_body = json.dumps(response_body)
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_response_body))
              }
              try:
                  response = requests.put(event['ResponseURL'], data=json_response_body, headers=headers)
                  logger.info(f"Response sent: {response.status_code}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to send response: {str(e)}")
          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              analyzer_name = props['AnalyzerName']
              analyzer_type = props['Type']
              tags = props.get('Tags', [])
              archive_rules = props.get('ArchiveRules', [])
              # Convert tags from list of dicts to dict
              tags_dict = {}
              for tag in tags:
                  key = tag.get('Key')
                  value = tag.get('Value')
                  if key and value:
                      tags_dict[key] = value
              # Convert archive rules
              converted_archive_rules = convert_archive_rules(archive_rules)
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      # Delete any existing analyzer with the same name to avoid conflict
                      try:
                          client.delete_analyzer(analyzerName=analyzer_name)
                          logger.info(f"Deleted existing analyzer: {analyzer_name}")
                      except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning(f"Failed to delete analyzer: {str(e)}")
                      # Create the analyzer
                      create_args = {
                          'analyzerName': analyzer_name,
                          'type': analyzer_type,
                          'tags': tags_dict,
                          'archiveRules': converted_archive_rules
                      }
                      logger.info(f"Creating analyzer with args: {json.dumps(create_args, default=str)}")
                      response = client.create_analyzer(**create_args)
                      physical_resource_id = response['arn']
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Arn': physical_resource_id}, physical_resource_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      # For updates, we delete and recreate (simple approach)
                      try:
                          client.delete_analyzer(analyzerName=analyzer_name)
                          logger.info(f"Deleted existing analyzer for update: {analyzer_name}")
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning(f"Failed to delete analyzer during update: {str(e)}")
                      create_args = {
                          'analyzerName': analyzer_name,
                          'type': analyzer_type,
                          'tags': tags_dict,
                          'archiveRules': converted_archive_rules
                      }
                      response = client.create_analyzer(**create_args)
                      physical_resource_id = response['arn']
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Arn': physical_resource_id}, physical_resource_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          client.delete_analyzer(analyzerName=analyzer_name)
                          logger.info(f"Deleted analyzer for cleanup: {analyzer_name}")
                      except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning(f"Failed to delete analyzer during delete: {str(e)}")
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {})
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error processing request: {str(e)}")
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)})
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Serverless workflow to monitor EC2 instance state changes and trigger a Step Functions state machine with placeholder business logic for running, stopped, and terminated states. Uses default event bus and includes logging for the state machine."

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EC2StateChangeWorkflow"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  StateMachineLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StateMachineLogPolicy"
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "states.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents",
                "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
                "logs:CreateLogDelivery"
              ],
              "Resource": "${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionRunning.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionStopped.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionTerminated.Arn

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  PlaceholderLambdaFunctionRunning:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RunningPlaceholder"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
              // Placeholder for business logic when EC2 instance transitions to running
              console.log("Running state triggered with event:", JSON.stringify(event));
              return { statusCode: 200, body: "Placeholder executed for running" };
          };

  PlaceholderLambdaFunctionStopped:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StoppedPlaceholder"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
              // Placeholder for business logic when EC2 instance transitions to stopped
              console.log("Stopped state triggered with event:", JSON.stringify(event));
              return { statusCode: 200, body: "Placeholder executed for stopped" };
          };

  PlaceholderLambdaFunctionTerminated:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TerminatedPlaceholder"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
              // Placeholder for business logic when EC2 instance transitions to terminated
              console.log("Terminated state triggered with event:", JSON.stringify(event));
              return { statusCode: 200, body: "Placeholder executed for terminated" };
          };

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EC2StateChangeWorkflow"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Workflow for EC2 instance state changes",
              "StartAt": "ChoosePath",
              "States": {
                "ChoosePath": {
                  "Type": "Choice",
                  "Choices": [
                    {
                      "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                      "StringEquals": "running",
                      "Next": "RunningPlaceholder"
                    },
                    {
                      "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                      "StringEquals": "stopped",
                      "Next": "StoppedPlaceholder"
                    },
                    {
                      "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                      "StringEquals": "terminated",
                      "Next": "TerminatedPlaceholder"
                    }
                  ],
                  "Default": "UnhandledState"
                },
                "RunningPlaceholder": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${RunningFunctionArn}",
                  "End": true
                },
                "StoppedPlaceholder": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${StoppedFunctionArn}",
                  "End": true
                },
                "TerminatedPlaceholder": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${TerminatedFunctionArn}",
                  "End": true
                },
                "UnhandledState": {
                  "Type": "Fail",
                  "Cause": "Unrecognized EC2 instance state"
                }
              }
            }
          - RunningFunctionArn: !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionRunning.Arn
            StoppedFunctionArn: !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionStopped.Arn
            TerminatedFunctionArn: !GetAtt PlaceholderLambdaFunctionTerminated.Arn

  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EC2StateChangeRule"
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          Id: "StepFunctionsTarget"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Description: "CloudWatch Log group for state machine logs"
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: "Name of the EventBridge rule"
    Value: !Ref EventBridgeRule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Foundational infrastructure for ECS Anywhere: ECS cluster, IAM role, and SSM registration document."
Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyECSAnywhereCluster"
    Description: "Name of the ECS cluster for ECS Anywhere."
  ContainerInstanceName:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-container-instance"
    Description: "Default container instance name used in the SSM registration document."
Resources:
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
  ECSAnywhereRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSAnywherePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RegisterContainerInstance
                  - ecs:DeregisterContainerInstance
                  - ecs:DiscoverPollEndpoint
                  - ecs:Poll
                  - ecs:StartTelemetrySession
                  - ecs:UpdateContainerInstancesState
                  - ecs:SubmitContainerStateChange
                  - ecs:SubmitTaskStateChange
                  - ecs:DescribeContainerInstances
                Resource: "*"
  SSMRegistrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: ECSAnywhereRegistration
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "2.2",
              "description": "ECS Anywhere instance registration document",
              "parameters": {
                "ClusterName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Name of the ECS cluster to register with",
                  "default": "${ClusterName}"
                },
                "ContainerInstanceName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Name for the container instance",
                  "default": "${ContainerInstanceName}"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "action": "aws:runShellScript",
                  "name": "RegisterECSInstance",
                  "inputs": {
                    "runCommand": [
                      "#!/bin/bash",
                      "set -e",
                      "if ! command -v ecs-init &> /dev/null; then",
                      "  amazon-linux-extras disable docker",
                      "  amazon-linux-extras enable ecs",
                      "  yum clean metadata",
                      "  yum install -y ecs-init",
                      "fi",
                      "echo 'ECS_CLUSTER={{ ClusterName }}' | sudo tee /etc/ecs/ecs.config",
                      "echo 'ECS_INSTANCE_NAME={{ ContainerInstanceName }}' | sudo tee -a /etc/ecs/ecs.config",
                      "sudo systemctl enable ecs-init",
                      "sudo systemctl start ecs-init"
                    ]
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
            ContainerInstanceName: !Ref ContainerInstanceName
Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: "ECS Cluster Name"
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  SSMRegistrationDocumentName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document for registration"
    Value: !Ref SSMRegistrationDocument
  ECSAnywhereRoleArn:

        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sort_key
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode

        Fn::If:

    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: "askAroundMeUserPoolClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - "ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH"
        - "ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH"
  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: "askAroundMeIdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}"

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: "askAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "unauthenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoSyncPolicy"

                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityPoolUsage"
                  - "cognito-sync:GetBulkPublishDetails"
                  - "cognito-sync:GetCognitoEvents"
                  - "cognito-sync:ListDatasets"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${CognitoIdentityPool}/*"
        - PolicyName: "IoTPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "iot:Connect"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "iot:Subscribe"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topicfilter/*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "iot:Receive"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topic/*"
  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: "askAroundMeAuthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "authenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoSyncPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:ListRecords"
                  - "cognito-sync:UpdateRecords"
                  - "cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:UnsubscribeFromDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityUsage"
                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityPoolUsage"
                  - "cognito-sync:GetBulkPublishDetails"
                  - "cognito-sync:GetCognitoEvents"
                  - "cognito-sync:ListDatasets"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${CognitoIdentityPool}/*"
        - PolicyName: "IoTPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "iot:Connect"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: "Allow"

              - Effect: "Allow"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for ECS chaos engineering workflow using Step Functions, Lambda, and SNS
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t2.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t2.micro
      - t2.small
      - t2.medium
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for the ECS container instance
  WaitTimeSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 3600
    Description: Wait time in seconds before checking service health after instance termination
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS topic for alerts
Conditions:
  HasEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-route-table'
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  ECSInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS container instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-sg'
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ec2-instance-role'
  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
  TerminateInstanceLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateInstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminate-lambda-role'
  HealthCheckLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HealthCheckPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-healthcheck-lambda-role'
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceLambda.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckLambda.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-stepfunctions-role'
  TerminateInstanceLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              instance_id = event['InstanceId']
              try:
                  ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps(f'Successfully terminated instance {instance_id}')
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps(f'Error terminating instance {instance_id}: {str(e)}')
                  }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance-lambda'
  HealthCheckLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-health-check'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')

              cluster_name = event['ClusterName']
              service_name = event['ServiceName']
              sns_topic_arn = event['SnsTopicArn']

              try:
                  response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster_name, services=[service_name])
                  service = response['services'][0]
                  desired_count = service['desiredCount']
                  running_count = service['runningCount']

                  if running_count < desired_count:
                      message = f'ECS Service {service_name} is UNHEALTHY. Desired: {desired_count}, Running: {running_count}'
                      sns.publish(TopicArn=sns_topic_arn, Message=message, Subject='ECS Service Health Alert')
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'body': json.dumps('Alert sent - service unhealthy')
                      }
                  else:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'body': json.dumps('Service is healthy')
                      }
              except Exception as e:
                  error_msg = f'Error checking service health: {str(e)}'
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=sns_topic_arn, Message=error_msg, Subject='ECS Health Check Error')
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps(error_msg)
                  }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-health-check-lambda'
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-cluster'
  EC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
          DeviceIndex: 0
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref ECSInstanceSecurityGroup
          SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64:
          Fn::Sub: |
            #!/bin/bash
            echo ECS_CLUSTER=${ECSCluster} >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-instance'
  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-task'
      Cpu: 256
      Memory: 512
      NetworkMode: bridge
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - EC2
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: nginx
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          Memory: 512
          Cpu: 256
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-task-definition'
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: EC2Instance
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-service'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 0
        MaximumPercent: 100
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-service'
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-alerts'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-alerts-topic'
  SNSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref SNSTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Chaos Engineering Workflow - Terminate EC2 Instance and Check ECS Service Health",
              "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
              "States": {
                "TerminateInstance": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${TerminateInstanceLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "InstanceId": "${EC2InstanceId}"
                  },
                  "Next": "Wait"
                },
                "Wait": {
                  "Type": "Wait",
                  "Seconds": ${WaitTimeSeconds},
                  "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
                },
                "CheckServiceHealth": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${HealthCheckLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "ClusterName": "${ECSClusterName}",
                    "ServiceName": "${ECSServiceName}",
                    "SnsTopicArn": "${SNSTopicArn}"
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - TerminateInstanceLambdaArn: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceLambda.Arn
            EC2InstanceId: !Ref EC2Instance
            WaitTimeSeconds: !Ref WaitTimeSeconds
            HealthCheckLambdaArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambda.Arn
            ECSClusterName: !Ref ECSCluster
            ECSServiceName: !Ref ECSService
            SNSTopicArn: !Ref SNSTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-state-machine'
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine for the chaos workflow
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster created for chaos testing
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alert notifications
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic
  EC2InstanceId:
    Description: ID of the EC2 instance that will be terminated during the workflow
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates SSM parameters, a Secrets Manager secret with auto-generated password, and a Lambda function to demonstrate retrieval.'
Resources:
  SSMParameter1:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/param1'
      Type: String
      Value: 'value1'
      Description: 'First parameter under stack path'
  SSMParameter2:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/param2'
      Type: String
      Value: 'value2'
      Description: 'Second parameter under stack path'
  MySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/MySecret'
      Description: 'Auto-generated secret for demo'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: 'password'
        PasswordLength: 16
        ExcludePunctuation: true
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreDemoPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaRole'
  ParameterStoreDemo:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3
          import json
          
          def handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
              
              # Retrieve SSM parameters under the stack's path
              ssm_path = f'/{stack_name}/'
              ssm_params = []
              try:
                  paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Path=ssm_path, Recursive=True, WithDecryption=True):
                      for param in page['Parameters']:
                          ssm_params.append({'Name': param['Name'], 'Value': param['Value']})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Error getting SSM parameters: {e}')
              
              print('SSM Parameters:')
              for p in ssm_params:
                  print(p)
              
              # Retrieve secrets with name prefix matching stack name
              secrets = []
              try:
                  paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator('list_secrets')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=[{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [f'{stack_name}/']}]):
                      for secret in page['SecretList']:
                          try:
                              secret_value = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret['ARN'])
                              secrets.append({'Name': secret['Name'], 'Value': secret_value.get('SecretString', 'Binary hidden')})
                          except Exception as e:
                              print(f'Error getting secret {secret["Name"]}: {e}')
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Error listing secrets: {e}')
              
              print('Secrets:')

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Custom Systems Manager Inventory Collection for Database and Caching Processes"
Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Linux instances"
  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Windows instances"
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(30 days)"
    Description: "Cron or rate expression for the association schedule"
Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Document"
    Properties:
      Name: "Custom-Inventory-Processes"
      DocumentType: "Command"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Collect running database and caching process information into custom inventory"
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: "String"
            default: !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
            description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords for Linux"
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: "String"
            default: !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords
            description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords for Windows"
        mainSteps:
          - action: "aws:runShellScript"
            name: "LinuxInventory"
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - "platformType"
                - "Linux"
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  # Get instance ID using IMDSv2
                  TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  # Split keywords into array
                  IFS=',' read -ra KEYWORDS <<< "{{ LinuxProcessKeywords }}"
                  PROCESSES=""
                  FIRST=true
                  for kw in "${KEYWORDS[@]}"; do
                    # Trim whitespace
                    kw=$(echo "$kw" | xargs)
                    if [ -z "$kw" ]; then
                      continue
                    fi
                    # Get matching processes (PID, name)
                    while IFS= read -r line; do
                      if [ -z "$line" ]; then
                        continue
                      fi
                      # line format: user pid cpu mem vsz rss tty stat start time command
                      PID=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $2}')
                      CMD=$(echo "$line" | awk '{for(i=11;i<=NF;i++) printf "%s ", $i; print ""}' | sed 's/ *$//')
                      if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
                        PROCESSES+="{\"pid\":\"$PID\",\"process\":\"$CMD\"}"
                        FIRST=false
                      else
                        PROCESSES+=",{\"pid\":\"$PID\",\"process\":\"$CMD\"}"
                      fi
                    done < <(ps aux | grep -i "$kw" | grep -v grep)
                  done
                  # Create custom inventory directory
                  CUSTOM_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/$INSTANCE_ID/inventory/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$CUSTOM_DIR"
                  # Write JSON file
                  echo "{\"instanceId\":\"$INSTANCE_ID\",\"processes\":[$PROCESSES]}" > "$CUSTOM_DIR/custom-processes.json"
          - action: "aws:runPowerShellScript"
            name: "WindowsInventory"
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - "platformType"
                - "Windows"
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  # Get instance ID
                  $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds" = "21600"} -UseBasicParsing
                  $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token" = $token} -UseBasicParsing
                  # Split keywords
                  $keywords = "{{ WindowsProcessKeywords }}" -split ','
                  $processes = @()
                  foreach ($kw in $keywords) {
                    $kw = $kw.Trim()
                    if (-not $kw) { continue }
                    Get-Process -Name "*$kw*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
                      $processes += @{
                        pid = $_.Id
                        process = $_.ProcessName
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  # Create custom inventory directory
                  $customDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"
                  if (-not (Test-Path $customDir)) {
                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $customDir -Force | Out-Null
                  }
                  # Write JSON file
                  $data = @{
                    instanceId = $instanceId
                    processes = $processes
                  }
                  $data | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Out-File -FilePath "$customDir\custom-processes.json" -Encoding utf8
  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Association"
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      DocumentVersion: "$DEFAULT"
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: "InstanceIds"
          Values:
            - "*"
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords
Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: "SSM Document Name"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
  AssociationId:
    Description: "SSM Association ID"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Colorteller demo using ALB, ECS Fargate, and Cloud Map (App Mesh deprecated). Creates VPC and subnets, two ECS services (blue/green) with 50/50 traffic split.'
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'
  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: Namespace for colorteller service
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: A
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      ServiceConnectDefaults:
        Namespace: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cloudmap-discovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicediscovery:DiscoverInstances
                  - servicediscovery:Get*
                  - servicediscovery:List*
                Resource: '*'
  TaskDefinitionBlue:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: colorteller-blue
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: colorteller-blue
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable-alpine
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: colorteller-blue
          HealthCheck:
            Command:
              - CMD-SHELL
              - curl -f http://localhost:80/ || exit 1
            Interval: 5
            Timeout: 2
            Retries: 2
            StartPeriod: 10
  TaskDefinitionGreen:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: colorteller-green
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: colorteller-green
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable-alpine
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
              Name: colorteller-green
          HealthCheck:
            Command:
              - CMD-SHELL
              - curl -f http://localhost:80/ || exit 1
            Interval: 5
            Timeout: 2
            Retries: 2
            StartPeriod: 10
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for colorteller services
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9080
          ToPort: 9080
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9080
          ToPort: 9080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: colorgateway
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
  TargetGroupBlue:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller-blue-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200'
  TargetGroupGreen:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller-green-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200'
  Listener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          ForwardConfig:
            TargetGroups:
              - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupBlue
                Weight: 50
              - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupGreen
                Weight: 50
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 9080
      Protocol: HTTP
  ServiceBlue:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - Listener
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: colorteller-blue
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinitionBlue
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: colorteller-blue
          ContainerPort: 80
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupBlue
      ServiceConnectConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        Namespace: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
        Services:
          - PortName: colorteller-blue
            ClientAliases:
              - DnsName: colorteller-blue
                Port: 9080
  ServiceGreen:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - Listener
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: colorteller-green
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinitionGreen
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: colorteller-green
          ContainerPort: 80
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupGreen
      ServiceConnectConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        Namespace: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
        Services:
          - PortName: colorteller-green
            ClientAliases:
              - DnsName: colorteller-green
                Port: 9080
Outputs:
  LoadBalancerDNS:
    Description: DNS name of the colorgateway ALB (access on port 9080)
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map namespace
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to automatically disable IMDSv1 on EC2 instances using EventBridge and Lambda to trigger SSM Automation'
Parameters:
  HopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: 'The HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests (1-64)'
Resources:
  AutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2MetadataModification
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: '*'
      Path: /
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:aws:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Path: /
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: ' + json.dumps(event))
              instance_id = event.get('instanceId')
              hop_limit = event.get('hopLimit')
              automation_role_arn = event.get('automationRoleArn')

              if not instance_id or not hop_limit or not automation_role_arn:
                  logger.error('Missing required parameters')
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Missing required parameters'}

              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              try:
                  response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                      DocumentName='AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata',
                      Parameters={
                          'InstanceId': [instance_id],
                          'HttpTokens': ['required'],
                          'HttpPutResponseHopLimit': [str(hop_limit)],
                          'AutomationAssumeRole': [automation_role_arn]
                      }
                  )
                  logger.info('Automation execution started: ' + response['AutomationExecutionId'])
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Automation execution started'}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error('Error starting automation: ' + str(e))
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': str(e)}
      Timeout: 60
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRule.Arn
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      Path: /
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: LambdaTarget
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: $.detail.instance-id
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "instanceId": "<instanceId>",
                "hopLimit": "${HopLimit}",
                "automationRoleArn": "${AutomationRole.Arn}"
              }
Outputs:
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers Lambda to start SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRule.Arn
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that starts SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by SSM Automation to modify EC2 instance metadata
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS AppSync GraphQL API with EventBridge data source and IAM authentication
Parameters:
  BusName:
    Type: String
    Default: AppSyncEventBus
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyGraphQLApi
    Description: Name of the AppSync GraphQL API
Resources:
  AppSyncEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref BusName
  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncEventBridgePutEvents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBus.Arn
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Note {
          NoteId: String!
          title: String!
          content: String!
        }
        type Query {
          getNote(noteId: String!): Note
        }
        type Mutation {
          saveNote(noteId: String!, title: String!, content: String!): Note
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }
  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: EventBridgeDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBus.Arn
  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE
  GetNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getNote
      DataSourceName: NoneDataSource
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({
          "NoteId": $context.arguments.noteId,
          "title": "Sample Title",
          "content": "Sample Content"
        })
  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: EventBridgeDataSource
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "Source": "appsync.saveNote",
              "DetailType": "NoteSaved",
              "Detail": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)
Outputs:
  GraphQLApiEndpoint:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  EventBusArn:
    Description: Custom EventBridge event bus ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBus.Arn
  IAMRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for AppSync to write to EventBridge
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
