      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: throttle
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          import time
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              now = int(time.time())
              response = table.scan(
                  FilterExpression=Key('expiry').lt(now)
              )
              items = response.get('Items', [])
              with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                  for item in items:
                      batch.delete_item(
                          Key={
                              'id': item['id'],
                              'expiry': item['expiry']
                          }
                      )
              while 'LastEvaluatedKey' in response:
                  response = table.scan(
                      ExclusiveStartKey=response['LastEvaluatedKey'],
                      FilterExpression=Key('expiry').lt(now)
                  )
                  items = response.get('Items', [])
                  with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                      for item in items:
                          batch.delete_item(
                              Key={
                                  'id': item['id'],
                                  'expiry': item['expiry']
                              }
                          )
              return f"Deleted {len(items)} items"
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
  EventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
          Id: DynamoDBCleanupTarget
  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt EventRule.Arn
Outputs:
  FunctionName:
    Value: !Ref LambdaFunction
    Description: "Name of the Lambda function"
  FunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function"
  ScheduleExpression:
    Value: !Ref ScheduleExpression
    Description: "Schedule expression used for the rule"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates IoT SiteWise asset models for a wind farm demo"
Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: "AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel"
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: "TurbineAssetModel"
      AssetModelDescription: "Asset model for a wind turbine"
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: "SerialNumber"
          Name: "SerialNumber"
          DataType: "STRING"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Attribute"
        - LogicalId: "RatedPower"
          Name: "RatedPower"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Attribute"
        - LogicalId: "WindSpeed"
          Name: "WindSpeed"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Measurement"
        - LogicalId: "Torque"
          Name: "Torque"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Measurement"
        - LogicalId: "PowerOutput"
          Name: "PowerOutput"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Measurement"
        - LogicalId: "OverdriveState"
          Name: "OverdriveState"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Transform"
            Transform:
              Expression: "if(torque > 3, 1.0, 0.0)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "torque"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "Torque"
        - LogicalId: "AvgWindSpeed"
          Name: "AvgWindSpeed"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(wind_speed)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "wind_speed"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "WindSpeed"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
        - LogicalId: "OverdriveStateTime"
          Name: "OverdriveStateTime"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(overdrive_state)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "overdrive_state"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "OverdriveState"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
        - LogicalId: "AvgPower"
          Name: "AvgPower"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(power_output)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "power_output"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "PowerOutput"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: "AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel"
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: "WindFarmAssetModel"
      AssetModelDescription: "Asset model for a wind farm"
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: "FarmName"
          Name: "FarmName"
          DataType: "STRING"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Attribute"
        - LogicalId: "TotalCapacity"
          Name: "TotalCapacity"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Attribute"
        - LogicalId: "FarmAvgWindSpeed"
          Name: "FarmAvgWindSpeed"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(turbine_avg_wind_speed)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "turbine_avg_wind_speed"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "AvgWindSpeed"
                    HierarchyLogicalId: "TurbineHierarchy"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
        - LogicalId: "FarmOverdriveTime"
          Name: "FarmOverdriveTime"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(turbine_overdrive_time)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "turbine_overdrive_time"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "OverdriveStateTime"
                    HierarchyLogicalId: "TurbineHierarchy"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
        - LogicalId: "FarmTotalPower"
          Name: "FarmTotalPower"
          DataType: "DOUBLE"
          Type:
            TypeName: "Metric"
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(turbine_avg_power)"
              Variables:
                - Name: "turbine_avg_power"
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: "AvgPower"
                    HierarchyLogicalId: "TurbineHierarchy"
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: "PT5M"
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - LogicalId: "TurbineHierarchy"
          Name: "TurbineHierarchy"
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
Outputs:

    Value: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Value: !Ref WindFarmAssetModel
  HierarchyAssociationId:
    Value: "TurbineHierarchy"

                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: "*"
  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Restrict VPC default security group by revoking all ingress and egress rules"
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "The VPC ID (optional). If not provided, the default VPC will be discovered."
            default: ""
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: "The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf."
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: getDefaultVpcOrUseProvided
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events.get('VpcId', '')
                    if vpc_id:
                        return {'VpcId': vpc_id}
                    response = ec2.describe_vpcs(Filters=[{'Name': 'isDefault', 'Values': ['true']}])
                    if response['Vpcs']:
                        return {'VpcId': response['Vpcs'][0]['VpcId']}
                    raise Exception('No default VPC found and no VpcId provided.')
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: "$.Payload.VpcId"
                Type: String
            nextStep: findDefaultSecurityGroup
          - name: findDefaultSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}
                        ]
                    )
                    if response['SecurityGroups']:
                        return {'SecurityGroupId': response['SecurityGroups'][0]['GroupId']}
                    raise Exception(f'Default security group not found in VPC {vpc_id}')
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroupId
                Selector: "$.Payload.SecurityGroupId"
                Type: String
            nextStep: revokeAllRules
          - name: revokeAllRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    if sg.get('IpPermissions'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions']
                        )
                    if sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress']
                        )
                    return {'Success': True, 'SecurityGroupId': sg_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: "$.Payload"
                Type: StringMap
      Name: !Sub "PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup-${AWS::Region}"
  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Delete security groups that are not associated with any network interface"
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupIds:
            type: StringList
            description: "List of security group IDs to evaluate. If empty, all security groups in the account will be evaluated."
            default: []
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: "The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf."
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: getSecurityGroupsToEvaluate
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    sg_ids = events.get('SecurityGroupIds', [])
                    if sg_ids:
                        return {'SecurityGroupIds': sg_ids}
                    all_sgs = []
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_security_groups')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for sg in page['SecurityGroups']:
                            all_sgs.append(sg['GroupId'])
                    return {'SecurityGroupIds': all_sgs}
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroupIds
                Selector: "$.Payload.SecurityGroupIds"
                Type: StringList
            nextStep: filterUnusedSecurityGroups
          - name: filterUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    sg_ids = events['SecurityGroupIds']
                    # Get all network interfaces
                    eni_sgs = set()
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_network_interfaces')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for eni in page['NetworkInterfaces']:
                            for group in eni.get('Groups', []):
                                eni_sgs.add(group['GroupId'])
                    # Also check for default security groups (cannot be deleted)
                    default_sgs = set()
                    vpc_response = ec2.describe_vpcs(Filters=[{'Name': 'isDefault', 'Values': ['true']}])
                    default_vpc_ids = [v['VpcId'] for v in vpc_response['Vpcs']]
                    if default_vpc_ids:
                        sg_response = ec2.describe_security_groups(Filters=[{'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}])
                        for sg in sg_response['SecurityGroups']:
                            default_sgs.add(sg['GroupId'])
                    unused = [sg for sg in sg_ids if sg not in eni_sgs and sg not in default_sgs]
                    return {'UnusedSecurityGroupIds': unused}
            outputs:
              - Name: UnusedSecurityGroupIds
                Selector: "$.Payload.UnusedSecurityGroupIds"
                Type: StringList
            nextStep: deleteUnusedSecurityGroups
          - name: deleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    unused_ids = events['UnusedSecurityGroupIds']
                    results = []
                    for sg_id in unused_ids:
                        try:
                            ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=sg_id)
                            results.append({'SecurityGroupId': sg_id, 'Status': 'Deleted'})
                        except Exception as e:
                            results.append({'SecurityGroupId': sg_id, 'Status': 'Failed', 'Error': str(e)})
                    return {'Results': results}
            outputs:
              - Name: Results
                Selector: "$.Payload"
                Type: StringMap
      Name: !Sub "PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups-${AWS::Region}"
  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Release unassociated Elastic IP addresses using their allocation IDs"
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          AllocationIds:
            type: StringList
            description: "List of allocation IDs to evaluate. If empty, all addresses in the account will be evaluated."
            default: []
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: "The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf."
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: getAddressesToEvaluate
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    alloc_ids = events.get('AllocationIds', [])
                    if alloc_ids:
                        return {'AllocationIds': alloc_ids}
                    all_alloc_ids = []
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_addresses')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for addr in page['Addresses']:
                            all_alloc_ids.append(addr['AllocationId'])
                    return {'AllocationIds': all_alloc_ids}
            outputs:
              - Name: AllocationIds
                Selector: "$.Payload.AllocationIds"
                Type: StringList
            nextStep: filterUnassociatedEIPs
          - name: filterUnassociatedEIPs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    alloc_ids = events['AllocationIds']
                    response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=alloc_ids)
                    unassociated = []
                    for addr in response['Addresses']:
                        if 'AssociationId' not in addr and 'InstanceId' not in addr:
                            unassociated.append(addr['AllocationId'])
                    return {'UnassociatedAllocationIds': unassociated}
            outputs:
              - Name: UnassociatedAllocationIds
                Selector: "$.Payload.UnassociatedAllocationIds"
                Type: StringList
            nextStep: releaseEIPs
          - name: releaseEIPs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(events, context):
                    unassociated_ids = events['UnassociatedAllocationIds']
                    results = []
                    for alloc_id in unassociated_ids:
                        try:
                            ec2.release_address(AllocationId=alloc_id)
                            results.append({'AllocationId': alloc_id, 'Status': 'Released'})
                        except Exception as e:
                            results.append({'AllocationId': alloc_id, 'Status': 'Failed', 'Error': str(e)})
                    return {'Results': results}
            outputs:
              - Name: Results
                Selector: "$.Payload"
                Type: StringMap
      Name: !Sub "PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs-${AWS::Region}"
  UpdateASGHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Update an Auto Scaling group's health check type to ELB with a grace period of 300 seconds"
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: "The name of the Auto Scaling group to update."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: "The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf."
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: updateHealthCheckType
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                asg = boto3.client('autoscaling')
                def handler(events, context):
                    asg_name = events['AutoScalingGroupName']
                    asg.update_auto_scaling_group(
                        AutoScalingGroupName=asg_name,
                        HealthCheckType='ELB',
                        HealthCheckGracePeriod=300
                    )
                    return {'AutoScalingGroupName': asg_name, 'HealthCheckType': 'ELB', 'HealthCheckGracePeriod': 300}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: "$.Payload"
                Type: StringMap
      Name: !Sub "PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheck-${AWS::Region}"
Outputs:
  PCIAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role created for PCI automation"
    Value: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: The target AWS region to mirror repositories to.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d$
Resources:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildMirrorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/RepoMirrorProject
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/RepoMirrorProject:log-stream:*
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuild
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: RepoMirrorProject
      Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to target region
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:5.0
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: SOURCE_REGION
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
          - Name: ACCOUNT_ID
            Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.8
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  for repo in card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline; do
                    echo "Mirroring $repo"
                    git clone --branch mainline --single-branch codecommit::$SOURCE_REGION://$repo
                    cd $repo
                    git remote add target codecommit::$TARGET_REGION://$repo
                    git push target mainline
                    cd ..
                    rm -rf $repo
                  done
      Status: ENABLED
      TimeoutInMinutes: 10
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          GroupName: /aws/codebuild/RepoMirrorProject
          StreamName: !Sub "build-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}"
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: CodeCommitPushToMainline
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: CodeBuildProject
      State: ENABLED
Outputs:
  CodeBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild project
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Aurora Global Database failover automation using SSM, Lambda, and Route 53 ARC'
Parameters:
  GlobalClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Identifier of the Aurora global database cluster
    Default: my-global-cluster
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: Primary region for the global database
    Default: us-east-1
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: Secondary region for the global database
    Default: us-west-2
  RoutingControlARN:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC routing control (must be provided)
    Default: ''
  SecretARN:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret to update (must be provided)
    Default: ''
  LambdaRoleName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Lambda execution role
    Default: LambdaSSMExecutionRole
  SSMRoleName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the SSM automation execution role
    Default: SSMAutomationRole
Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SSMRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonRDSFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonRoute53RecoveryControlConfigFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationAdditionalPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref LambdaRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSSMStartAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Automation document to failover an Aurora global database and update ARC routing control and Secrets Manager'
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Primary region of the global database
            default: us-east-1
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Secondary region of the global database
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the Aurora global database cluster
          RoutingControlARN:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC routing control (must be provided)
            default: ''
          SecretARN:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret to update (must be provided)
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                RoutingControlARN: '{{ RoutingControlARN }}'
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config')
                    routing_control_arn = event['RoutingControlARN']
                    if not routing_control_arn:
                        raise ValueError('RoutingControlARN is required')
                    response = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=routing_control_arn)
                    state = response['RoutingControlState']
                    if state == 'On':
                        active_region = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    else:
                        active_region = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    return {'ActiveRegion': active_region}
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
          - name: PerformGlobalClusterFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                TargetRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('rds')
                    response = client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier'],
                        TargetRegion=event['TargetRegion']
                    )
                    return {'FailoverStatus': 'Initiated'}
            outputs:
              - Name: FailoverStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.FailoverStatus
                Type: String
          - name: UpdateRoutingControlAndSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                RoutingControlARN: '{{ RoutingControlARN }}'
                SecretARN: '{{ SecretARN }}'
                NewActiveRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def handler(event, context):
                    routing_control_arn = event['RoutingControlARN']
                    secret_arn = event['SecretARN']
                    if not routing_control_arn or not secret_arn:
                        raise ValueError('RoutingControlARN and SecretARN are required')
                    arc_client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config')
                    arc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                        RoutingControlArn=routing_control_arn,
                        RoutingControlState='On'
                    )
                    rds_client = boto3.client('rds')
                    response = rds_client.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    )
                    global_cluster = response['GlobalClusters'][0]
                    writer_endpoint = None
                    for member in global_cluster['GlobalClusterMembers']:
                        if member['IsWriter'] and member['Region'] == event['NewActiveRegion']:
                            writer_endpoint = member['DBClusterArn']
                            break
                    secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                    secrets_client.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=secret_arn,
                        SecretString=json.dumps({'writerEndpoint': writer_endpoint})
                    )
                    return {'UpdateStatus': 'Completed'}
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdateStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.UpdateStatus
                Type: String
  TriggerFailoverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID: !Ref GlobalClusterIdentifier
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          ROUTING_CONTROL_ARN: !Ref RoutingControlARN
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref SecretARN
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              required_vars = ['SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME', 'GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID', 'PRIMARY_REGION', 'SECONDARY_REGION', 'ROUTING_CONTROL_ARN', 'SECRET_ARN']
              missing = [v for v in required_vars if not os.environ.get(v)]
              if missing:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Missing required environment variables: {missing}'})
                  }
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              doc_name = os.environ['SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME']
              params = {
                  'PrimaryRegion': [os.environ['PRIMARY_REGION']],
                  'SecondaryRegion': [os.environ['SECONDARY_REGION']],
                  'GlobalClusterIdentifier': [os.environ['GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID']],
                  'RoutingControlARN': [os.environ['ROUTING_CONTROL_ARN']],
                  'SecretARN': [os.environ['SECRET_ARN']]
              }
              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=doc_name,
                  Parameters=params
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'AutomationExecutionId': response['AutomationExecutionId']
                  })
              }
Outputs:
  SSMAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document
    Value: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
  LambdaFunctionARN:
    Description: ARN of the TriggerFailover Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailoverFunction.Arn
  SSMAutomationRoleARN:
    Description: ARN of the SSM automation execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleARN:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

Description: 'CloudFormation template for multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard App Runner service'

Parameters:

    Default: quicksight-dashboard-app
    Description: Name for the App Runner service
  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: latest
    Description: Tag for the container image
  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Admin user name for QuickSight
  DummyEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder@example.com
    Description: Placeholder email for QuickSight
  TemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: dashboard-template
    Description: QuickSight template identifier
  DataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: dashboard-dataset
    Description: QuickSight dataset identifier
  DataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: dashboard-datasource
    Description: QuickSight datasource identifier
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: dashboarddb
    Description: Database name for QuickSight
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: dashboardtable
    Description: Table name for QuickSight
  FilterColumnName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_id
    Description: Filter column name for QuickSight

Resources:
  ECRRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref ServiceName
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  BuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECRBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-build-role'

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightDirectoryAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                  - quicksight:PassDataSource
                  - quicksight:PassTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:ListAuthorizedApplications
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
                  - ds:DeleteDirectory
                  - ds:CreateUser
                  - ds:DeleteUser
                  - ds:DescribeUsers
                  - ds:ListLogSubscriptions
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-task-role'

  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ServiceName}-build'
      Description: Builds and pushes container image for App Runner
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:4.0
        PrivilegedMode: true
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: REPOSITORY_URI
            Value: !GetAtt ECRRepository.RepositoryUri
          - Name: IMAGE_TAG
            Value: !Ref ImageTag
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - echo Logging in to Amazon ECR...
                - aws ecr get-login-password --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $REPOSITORY_URI
            build:
              commands:
                - echo Build started on `date`
                - echo Building the Docker image...
                - cat > Dockerfile <<EOF
                FROM public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:2
                RUN yum install -y python3 && yum clean all
                RUN pip3 install flask
                COPY app.py /app.py
                EXPOSE 8080
                CMD ["python3", "/app.py"]
                EOF
                - cat > app.py <<EOF
                from flask import Flask
                app = Flask(__name__)
                @app.route('/status')
                def status():
                    return 'OK', 200
                if __name__ == '__main__':
                    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)
                EOF
                - docker build -t $REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG .
            post_build:
              commands:
                - echo Build completed on `date`
                - echo Pushing the Docker image...
                - docker push $REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG
                - echo "IMAGE_URI=$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" > /tmp/image_uri.txt
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Sub '/aws/codebuild/${ServiceName}'

  ImageBuildTrigger:
    Type: Custom::ImageBuildTrigger
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ImageBuildFunction.Arn
      ProjectName: !Ref CodeBuildProject
      RepositoryUri: !GetAtt ECRRepository.RepositoryUri
      ImageTag: !Ref ImageTag

  ImageBuildFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 600
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time

          def handler(event, context):
              if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                  return

              codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
              project_name = event['ResourceProperties']['ProjectName']
              repository_uri = event['ResourceProperties']['RepositoryUri']
              image_tag = event['ResourceProperties']['ImageTag']

              try:
                  response = codebuild.start_build(projectName=project_name)
                  build_id = response['build']['id']

                  # Wait for build to complete
                  while True:
                      build = codebuild.batch_get_builds(ids=[build_id])['builds'][0]
                      if build['buildStatus'] == 'SUCCEEDED':
                          break
                      elif build['buildStatus'] in ['FAILED', 'FAULT', 'STOPPED']:
                          raise Exception(f"Build failed with status: {build['buildStatus']}")
                      time.sleep(5)

                  image_uri = f"{repository_uri}:{image_tag}"
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      'ImageUri': image_uri
                  })
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {
                      'Error': str(e)
                  })

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-lambda-role'

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !GetAtt ImageBuildTrigger.ImageUri
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref AWS::Region
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Name: DUMMY_EMAIL
                Value: !Ref DummyEmail
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME

              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref AutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
  DirectEnableDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DirectAutomationDocName
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs for reject traffic on a given VPC directly.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on (e.g., vpc-12345678)
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref LogGroupName
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group to send flow logs to
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
            description: IAM role ARN for flow log delivery
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableVPCFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Enables VPC Flow Logs capturing only rejected traffic
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: enable_flow_logs
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def enable_flow_logs(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    delivery_role_arn = events['DeliveryRoleArn']
                    try:
                        response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                            ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                            ResourceType='VPC',
                            TrafficType='REJECT',
                            LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                            DeliverLogsPermissionArn=delivery_role_arn
                        )
                        return {
                            'status': 'Success',
                            'flowLogIds': response['FlowLogIds'],
                            'message': f'Flow logs enabled for VPC {vpc_id}'
                        }
                    except Exception as e:
                        return {
                            'status': 'Failed',
                            'error': str(e)
                        }
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                DeliveryRoleArn: '{{ DeliveryRoleArn }}'
  ChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ChangeAutomationDocName
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs for reject traffic via a Change Manager change request.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on (e.g., vpc-12345678)
          ChangeRequestTitle:
            type: String
            default: Enable VPC Flow Logs for Reject Traffic
            description: Title for the change request
          ChangeRequestDescription:
            type: String
            default: Automated remediation to enable VPC Flow Logs capturing rejected traffic as per CIS benchmark
            description: Description of the change request
          ApprovalType:
            type: String
            default: None
            allowedValues:
              - None
              - Single
              - All
            description: Approval requirement for the change request
        mainSteps:
          - name: CreateChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: Creates a change request using AWS Systems Manager Change Manager
            inputs:
              DocumentName: AWS-StartChangeRequest
              RuntimeParameters:
                AutomationAssumeRole:
                  - !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
                ChangeRequestTitle:
                  - '{{ ChangeRequestTitle }}'
                ChangeRequestDescription:
                  - '{{ ChangeRequestDescription }}'
                ApprovalType:
                  - '{{ ApprovalType }}'
                AutomationDocumentName:
                  - !Ref DirectAutomationDocName
                AutomationDocumentParameters:
                  - '{"VpcId":"{{ VpcId }}"}'
          - name: WaitForApproval
            action: aws:approve
            description: Waits for the change request to be approved before proceeding
            inputs:
              Approvers:
                - '*'
              Message: 'Change request to enable VPC Flow Logs for reject traffic has been submitted. Please approve or reject this change request.'
          - name: ExecuteRemediation
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: Executes the direct enable flow log automation after approval
            inputs:
              DocumentName: !Ref DirectAutomationDocName
              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId:
                  - '{{ VpcId }}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a reusable delegation set for Route53 using a custom resource backed by Lambda"

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: "ReusableDelegationSet"
    Description: "Name for the Lambda function"
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: "CloudWatch log retention period in days"
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "ReusableDelegationSetPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:GetReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:ListReusableDelegationSets
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)
              
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      response_data = create_delegation_set(event)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      response_data = handle_update(event, physical_resource_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      response_data = handle_delete(event, physical_resource_id)
                  else:
                      raise ValueError(f"Unknown request type: {request_type}")
                  
                  return send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error processing request: {str(e)}")
                  return send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)})

          def create_delegation_set(event):
              try:
                  response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                      CallerReference=event['RequestId']
                  )
                  
                  delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                  delegation_set_id = delegation_set['Id'].split('/')[-1]
                  name_servers_raw = delegation_set['NameServers']
                  
                  logger.info(f"Delegation set created: {delegation_set_id}")
                  logger.info(f"Name servers: {name_servers_raw}")
                  
                  # Resolve nameserver IPs
                  import socket
                  ns_ips = []
                  for ns in name_servers_raw:
                      try:
                          ips = socket.getaddrinfo(ns, None)
                          ipv4s = [addr[4][0] for addr in ips if addr[0] == socket.AF_INET]
                          ipv6s = [addr[4][0] for addr in ips if addr[0] == socket.AF_INET6]
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning(f"Could not resolve {ns}: {str(e)}")
                          ipv4s = []
                          ipv6s = []
                      ns_ips.append({'name': ns, 'ipv4': ipv4s, 'ipv6': ipv6s})
                  
                  response_data = {
                      'DelegationSetId': delegation_set_id,
                      'NameServer1': name_servers_raw[0] if len(name_servers_raw) > 0 else '',
                      'NameServer2': name_servers_raw[1] if len(name_servers_raw) > 1 else '',
                      'NameServer3': name_servers_raw[2] if len(name_servers_raw) > 2 else '',
                      'NameServer4': name_servers_raw[3] if len(name_servers_raw) > 3 else '',
                      'NameServer1IPv4': ','.join(ns_ips[0]['ipv4']) if len(ns_ips) > 0 else '',
                      'NameServer1IPv6': ','.join(ns_ips[0]['ipv6']) if len(ns_ips) > 0 else '',
                      'NameServer2IPv4': ','.join(ns_ips[1]['ipv4']) if len(ns_ips) > 1 else '',
                      'NameServer2IPv6': ','.join(ns_ips[1]['ipv6']) if len(ns_ips) > 1 else '',
                      'NameServer3IPv4': ','.join(ns_ips[2]['ipv4']) if len(ns_ips) > 2 else '',
                      'NameServer3IPv6': ','.join(ns_ips[2]['ipv6']) if len(ns_ips) > 2 else '',
                      'NameServer4IPv4': ','.join(ns_ips[3]['ipv4']) if len(ns_ips) > 3 else '',
                      'NameServer4IPv6': ','.join(ns_ips[3]['ipv6']) if len(ns_ips) > 3 else '',
                  }
                  
                  return {'PhysicalResourceId': delegation_set_id, **response_data}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error creating delegation set: {str(e)}")
                  raise

          def handle_update(event, physical_resource_id):
              # Delegation sets are immutable; just return current data
              return get_existing_delegation_set(physical_resource_id)

          def handle_delete(event, physical_resource_id):
              if physical_resource_id:
                  try:
                      full_id = f"/delegationset/{physical_resource_id}"
                      route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=full_id)
                      logger.info(f"Delegation set deleted: {full_id}")
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.warning(f"Error deleting delegation set {physical_resource_id}: {str(e)}")
              return {'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id}

          def get_existing_delegation_set(physical_resource_id):
              try:
                  full_id = f"/delegationset/{physical_resource_id}"
                  response = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=full_id)
                  delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                  name_servers_raw = delegation_set['NameServers']
                  
                  response_data = {
                      'DelegationSetId': physical_resource_id,
                      'NameServer1': name_servers_raw[0] if len(name_servers_raw) > 0 else '',
                      'NameServer2': name_servers_raw[1] if len(name_servers_raw) > 1 else '',
                      'NameServer3': name_servers_raw[2] if len(name_servers_raw) > 2 else '',
                      'NameServer4': name_servers_raw[3] if len(name_servers_raw) > 3 else '',
                  }
                  
                  return {'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id, **response_data}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error getting delegation set: {str(e)}")
                  raise

          def send_response(event, context, status, data):
              response_body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': f'See details in CloudWatch Logs: {context.log_group_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': data.get('PhysicalResourceId', event.get('PhysicalResourceId', '')),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != 'PhysicalResourceId'}
              }
              
              logger.info(f"Sending response: {json.dumps(response_body)}")
              
              # Send response back to CloudFormation
              import urllib3
              http = urllib3.PoolManager()
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              
              try:
                  encoded_response = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
                  r = http.request('PUT', response_url, body=encoded_response, headers={'Content-Type': ''})
                  logger.info(f"Response status: {r.status}")

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for serverless content moderation API using Amazon Rekognition"
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage
  ImageSizeLimitMB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Maximum image file size in MB
  ConfidenceThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Minimum confidence threshold for Rekognition moderation detection
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  InvokeContentModeration:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT_MB: !Ref ImageSizeLimitMB
          CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD: !Ref ConfidenceThreshold
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          
          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
          
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png']
          IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT = int(os.environ.get('IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT_MB', 5)) * 1024 * 1024
          CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = float(os.environ.get('CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD', 60))
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  image_url = body.get('url', '')
                  
                  if not image_url:
                      return response(400, {'error': 'Missing required field: url'})
                  
                  # Validate file extension
                  valid_ext = False
                  for ext in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
                      if image_url.lower().endswith(ext):
                          valid_ext = True
                          break
                  
                  if not valid_ext:
                      return response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported image format. Allowed formats: jpg, jpeg, png'})
                  
                  # Fetch image from URL with size limit
                  try:
                      req = urllib.request.Request(image_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as conn:
                          if conn.length and conn.length > IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT:
                              return response(413, {'error': f'Image exceeds maximum size of {IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT/1024/1024} MB'})
                          image_bytes = conn.read()
                          if len(image_bytes) > IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT:
                              return response(413, {'error': f'Image exceeds maximum size of {IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT/1024/1024} MB'})
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                      return response(e.code, {'error': f'Failed to fetch image from URL: HTTP {e.code}'})
                  except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                      return response(400, {'error': f'Invalid URL or network error: {str(e.reason)}'})
                  
                  # Call Rekognition
                  try:
                      rekognition_response = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                          Image={
                              'Bytes': image_bytes
                          },
                          MinConfidence=CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
                      )
                      
                      moderation_labels = rekognition_response.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                      return response(200, {
                          'moderationLabels': [
                              {
                                  'name': label['Name'],
                                  'confidence': label['Confidence'],
                                  'parentName': label.get('ParentName', '')
                              }
                              for label in moderation_labels
                          ]
                      })
                  except ClientError as e:
                      return response(500, {'error': f'Rekognition error: {e.response["Error"]["Message"]}'})
                  
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': f'Internal server error: {str(e)}'})
          
          def response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }
  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: REST API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "moderate"
  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${InvokeContentModeration.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt InvokeContentModeration.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate
Outputs:

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function"
    Value: !GetAtt InvokeContentModeration.Arn
