AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "SLO Monitoring Dashboard and Alarms for FSx for ONTAP Event-Driven Pipeline"

Parameters:
  EnableMonitoring:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: "Set to true to deploy monitoring resources"

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: "Prefix for resource names"

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    Description: "CloudWatch namespace for SLO metrics"

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    Description: "CloudWatch namespace for synthetic canary metrics"

  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications"

  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: "P99 threshold for Event Ingestion Latency in seconds"

  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: "Average threshold for Processing Success Rate in percent"

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Maximum threshold for FPolicy Reconnect Time in seconds"

  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: "Maximum threshold for Replay Completion Time in seconds"

Conditions:
  ShouldDeploy: !Equals [!Ref EnableMonitoring, "true"]
  UseSNS: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SNSTopicArn, ""]]

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-Alarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when P99 Event Ingestion Latency exceeds threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref SNSTopicArn]
        - []

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate-Alarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average Processing Success Rate falls below threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref SNSTopicArn]
        - []

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime-Alarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when maximum FPolicy Reconnect Time exceeds threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref SNSTopicArn]
        - []

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime-Alarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when maximum Replay Completion Time exceeds threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref SNSTopicArn]
        - []

  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-SLO-Dashboard"
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "stat": "p99" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "p99",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold} * 2,
                    "label": "Seconds"
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold},
                      "label": "Threshold: ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold}s",
                      "color": "#ff0000"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "stat": "Average" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 90,
                    "max": 100,
                    "label": "Percent"
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold},
                      "label": "Threshold: ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}%",
                      "color": "#ff0000"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime", { "stat": "Maximum" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time (Max)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold} * 2,
                    "label": "Seconds"
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold},
                      "label": "Threshold: ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold}s",
                      "color": "#ff0000"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime", { "stat": "Maximum" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Replay Completion Time (Max)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold} * 2,
                    "label": "Seconds"
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold},
                      "label": "Threshold: ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold}s",
                      "color": "#ff0000"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "ListLatency", { "stat": "Average" } ],
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "GetLatency", { "stat": "Average" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "S3AP Canary Latencies",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "label": "Milliseconds"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "HealthCheck", { "stat": "Average" } ]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "ONTAP Health Check",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": 1,
                    "label": "Status"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardUrl:
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Description: "URL of the SLO Monitoring Dashboard"
    Value: !Sub "https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${SloDashboard}"

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarmArn:
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Description: "ARN of Event Ingestion Latency Alarm"
    Value: !GetAtt EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarmArn:
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Description: "ARN of Processing Success Rate Alarm"
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Description: "ARN of FPolicy Reconnect Time Alarm"
    Value: !GetAtt FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: ShouldDeploy
    Description: "ARN of Replay Completion Time Alarm"
    Value: !GetAtt ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito User Pool for JWT testing with AgentCore Gateway and MCP server'
Parameters:
  CallbackUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-delimited list of callback URLs for the web client
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/callback'
  LogoutUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-delimited list of logout URLs for the web client
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/logout'
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain (must be globally unique)
    Default: 'mcp-test'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Domain prefix must start and end with alphanumeric, using only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens in between'
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: 'MCPTestUserPool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Verify your email for MCP Test'

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: 'api'
      Name: 'API Resource Server'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: 'mcp'
          ScopeDescription: 'Access to MCP server'
        - ScopeName: 'gateway'
          ScopeDescription: 'Access to AgentCore Gateway'

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: 'WebClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackUrls
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutUrls
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoResourceServer

  MachineClientGateway:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: 'MachineClientGateway'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoResourceServer

  MachineClientMCP:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: 'MachineClientMCP'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoResourceServer

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Hosted UI domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  WebClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the web application
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  MachineClientGatewayId:
    Description: Client ID for the Gateway machine client
    Value: !Ref MachineClientGateway
  MachineClientGatewaySecret:
    Description: Client secret for the Gateway machine client
    Value: !GetAtt MachineClientGateway.ClientSecret
  MachineClientMCPId:

    Value: !Ref MachineClientMCP
  MachineClientMCPSecret:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito User Pool with KMS key and API Gateway secured by Cognito authorizer."

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyServerlessLandUserPool"
    Description: "Name of the Cognito user pool."

  ClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyWebClient"
    Description: "Name of the app client."

  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "https://example.com/callback"
    Description: "Callback URLs for the app client."

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "https://example.com/logout"
    Description: "Logout URLs for the app client."

  APIName:
    Type: String
    Default: "PetstoreAPI"
    Description: "Name of the API Gateway REST API."

  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: "prod"
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - test
      - dev
    Description: "Stage name of the API deployment."

  SampleBackendEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: "https://httpbin.org/post"
    Description: "Public sample backend endpoint for HTTP proxy integration."

Conditions:
  HasCallbackURLs: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs], ""]]
  HasLogoutURLs: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Ref LogoutURLs], ""]]

Resources:
  CustomerManagedKMSKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Properties:
      Description: "Customer-managed KMS key for encryption."
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable Root Account Full Access"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow EventBridge to Generate Data Keys and Decrypt"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "events.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  KMSAlias:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Alias"
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CustomerManagedKMSKey

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain"
    Properties:
      Domain: !Select [2, !Split ["/", !Ref "AWS::StackId"]]
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer"
    Properties:
      Identifier: "petstore-api.example.com"
      Name: "Petstore API Resource Server"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "domestic.read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read domestic data"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  AppClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref ClientName
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - "client_credentials"
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read"
      CallbackURLs: !If [HasCallbackURLs, !Ref CallbackURLs, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      LogoutURLs: !If [HasLogoutURLs, !Ref LogoutURLs, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      GenerateSecret: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "apigateway.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "ApiGatewayLoggingPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:GetLogEvents"
                  - "logs:FilterLogEvents"
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::Account"
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  PetstoreRestApi:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi"
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref APIName
      Description: "API Gateway secured by Cognito User Pool authorizer"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer"
    Properties:
      Name: "CognitoAuthorizer"
      Type: "COGNITO_USER_POOLS"
      RestApiId: !Ref PetstoreRestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: "method.request.header.Authorization"

  PostMethod:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::Method"
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: "POST"
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PetstoreRestApi.RootResourceId
      RestApiId: !Ref PetstoreRestApi
      AuthorizationType: "COGNITO_USER_POOLS"
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - "petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read"
      Integration:
        Type: "HTTP"
        IntegrationHttpMethod: "POST"
        Uri: !Ref SampleBackendEndpoint
        PassthroughBehavior: "WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES"
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 400
      RequestModels: {}

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment"
    DependsOn:
      - PostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PetstoreRestApi
      Description: "Initial deployment"

  ApiStage:
    Type: "AWS::ApiGateway::Stage"
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      RestApiId: !Ref PetstoreRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      MethodSettings:
        - DataTraceEnabled: true
          HttpMethod: "POST"
          LoggingLevel: "INFO"
          ResourcePath: "/"
          MetricsEnabled: true
      TracingEnabled: true
      CacheClusterEnabled: false
      Variables: {}
      DocumentationVersion: ""

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Cognito User Pool"
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  ApiEndpointURL:
    Description: "API Gateway endpoint URL for the prod stage"
    Value: !Sub "https://${PetstoreRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"

  AppClientID:
    Description: "ID of the application client"
    Value: !Ref AppClient

  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the customer-managed KMS key"
    Value: !GetAtt CustomerManagedKMSKey.Arn

  UserPoolOAuthTokenEndpoint:
    Description: "OAuth2 token endpoint for the user pool"
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for AWS Backup infrastructure with tag-based backup plans, encrypted vaults, KMS key, IAM role, and Service Catalog TagOptions'
Resources:
  BackupKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for AWS Backup vault encryption'
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow AWS Backup to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: backup
          Value: 'kms-key'
  BackupKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/backup-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKMSKey
  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
      Path: '/'
      Tags:
        - Key: backup
          Value: 'iam-role'
  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: WeeklyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)'
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: MonthlyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 1 * ? *)'
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - '*'
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: StringEquals
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: daily
  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - '*'
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: StringEquals
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: weekly
  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - '*'
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: StringEquals
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly
  BackupTagOptionDaily:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
  BackupTagOptionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
  BackupTagOptionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
Outputs:
  BackupKMSKeyId:
    Description: 'KMS Key ID used for backup vault encryption'
    Value: !Ref BackupKMSKey
  BackupKMSKeyArn:
    Description: 'KMS Key ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: 'Daily backup vault ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: 'Weekly backup vault ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: 'Monthly backup vault ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  BackupRoleArn:
    Description: 'IAM role ARN for AWS Backup'
    Value: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: 'Daily backup plan ID'
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: 'Weekly backup plan ID'
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: 'Monthly backup plan ID'
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for podcastgarage.org and related services."
Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone.
  SquarespaceApexIp1:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.145
    Description: First IP address for Squarespace apex.
  SquarespaceApexIp2:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.146
    Description: Second IP address for Squarespace apex.
  SquarespaceWwwCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ext-sites.squarespace.com
    Description: CNAME target for www subdomain.
  SpfPolicy:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"
    Description: SPF policy for the apex domain.
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: "google-site-verification=PLACEHOLDER"
    Description: Google site verification token.
  GSuiteMxPri1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  GSuiteMxHost1:
    Type: String
    Default: ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
  GSuiteMxPri2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
  GSuiteMxHost2:
    Type: String
    Default: ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
  GSuiteMxPri3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
  GSuiteMxHost3:
    Type: String
    Default: ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
  GSuiteMxPri4:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  GSuiteMxHost4:
    Type: String
    Default: ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
  GSuiteMxPri5:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  GSuiteMxHost5:
    Type: String
    Default: ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
  DmarcEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc@podcastgarage.org
    Description: Email address for DMARC reports (rua).
  PrinterIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.100
    Description: Internal IP of the office printer.
  ZenDeskHelpSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: help
    Description: Subdomain for ZenDesk helpdesk.
  ZenDeskVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "zendesk-verification=PLACEHOLDER"
    Description: ZenDesk verification token (TXT value).
  ZenDeskValidationCnameLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: _zendeskverification
  ZenDeskValidationCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: verify.zendesk.com
  ZenDeskDkimCname1Label:
    Type: String
    Default: _zendeskdkim1
  ZenDeskDkimCname1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dkim1.zendesk.com
  ZenDeskDkimCname2Label:
    Type: String
    Default: _zendeskdkim2
  ZenDeskDkimCname2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dkim2.zendesk.com
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=PLACEHOLDER"
    Description: DKIM TXT value for google._domainkey.
  CampaignMonitorSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail
    Description: Subdomain for Campaign Monitor email marketing.
  CampaignMonitorDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: s1
  CampaignMonitorDkimValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=PLACEHOLDER"
    Description: DKIM TXT value for selector._domainkey.<subdomain>
  CampaignMonitorSpfPolicy:
    Type: String
    Default: "v=spf1 include:spf.createsend.com ~all"
  CampaignMonitorMxPriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  CampaignMonitorMxHost:
    Type: String
    Default: mx.campaignmonitor.com
Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceApexIp1
        - !Ref SquarespaceApexIp2
  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "www.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceWwwCnameTarget
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfPolicy}"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZenDeskVerificationValue}"'
  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${GSuiteMxPri1} ${GSuiteMxHost1}"
        - !Sub "${GSuiteMxPri2} ${GSuiteMxHost2}"
        - !Sub "${GSuiteMxPri3} ${GSuiteMxHost3}"
        - !Sub "${GSuiteMxPri4} ${GSuiteMxHost4}"
        - !Sub "${GSuiteMxPri5} ${GSuiteMxHost5}"
  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_dmarc.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:${DmarcEmail}"'
  PrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "printer.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIp
  ZenDeskValidationCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${ZenDeskValidationCnameLabel}.${ZenDeskHelpSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskValidationCnameTarget
  ZenDeskDkimCname1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${ZenDeskDkimCname1Label}.${ZenDeskHelpSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskDkimCname1Target
  ZenDeskDkimCname2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${ZenDeskDkimCname2Label}.${ZenDeskHelpSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskDkimCname2Target
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "google._domainkey.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceDkimValue}"'
  CampaignMonitorSubdomainSpfTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorSpfPolicy}"'
  CampaignMonitorSubdomainMx:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${CampaignMonitorMxPriority} ${CampaignMonitorMxHost}"
  CampaignMonitorDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorDkimSelector}._domainkey.${CampaignMonitorSubdomain}.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDkimValue}"'
Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: The ID of the hosted zone created.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  NameServers:
    Description: The name servers for the hosted zone.
    Value: !Join [", ", !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
Resources:
  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub lambda-basic-execution-${Environment}
  SQSReaderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub sqs-reader-${Environment}
  DynamoDBWriterPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub dynamodb-writer-${Environment}
  DynamoDBStreamsReaderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub dynamodb-streams-reader-${Environment}
  SNSPublisherPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub sns-publisher-${Environment}
  SQSSenderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub sqs-sender-${Environment}
  LambdaSQSProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref SQSReaderPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDBWriterPolicy
      RoleName: !Sub lambda-sqs-processor-${Environment}
  LambdaDynamoDBStreamsProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDBStreamsReaderPolicy
        - !Ref SNSPublisherPolicy
      RoleName: !Sub lambda-dynamodb-streams-processor-${Environment}
  APIGatewaySQSRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SQSSenderPolicy
      RoleName: !Sub api-gateway-sqs-${Environment}
Outputs:
  LambdaSQSProcessorRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda role for reading from SQS queue and writing to DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaSQSProcessorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSQSProcessorRoleArn
  LambdaDynamoDBStreamsProcessorRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda role for reading from DynamoDB Streams and publishing to SNS topic
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaDynamoDBStreamsProcessorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-LambdaDynamoDBStreamsProcessorRoleArn
  APIGatewaySQSRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway role for sending messages to SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewaySQSRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-APIGatewaySQSRoleArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets, NAT gateway for outbound internet access from private subnet"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "172.18.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"
  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "172.18.0.0/22"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet"
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "172.18.32.0/21"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet"
  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT"
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream-usage
    Description: The name of the Athena database containing AppStream 2.0 usage data.
  WorkGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: primary
    Description: The name of the Athena workgroup where queries will be executed.
  QueryPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "appstream-usage-"
    Description: Prefix for Athena named query names to ensure uniqueness.
Resources:
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentVsPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: >-
        Compares average session length per stack between current and previous month.
      Name: !Sub "${QueryPrefix}avg-session-length-per-stack"
      QueryString: !Sub >
        WITH current_month AS (
          SELECT
            stack_name,
            AVG(session_duration_seconds) AS avg_duration_current
          FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
          WHERE month = CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
            AND year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
          GROUP BY stack_name
        ),
        previous_month AS (
          SELECT
            stack_name,
            AVG(session_duration_seconds) AS avg_duration_previous
          FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
          WHERE month = CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD('month', -1, CURRENT_DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
            AND year = CAST(CASE
              WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE_ADD('year', -1, CURRENT_DATE))
              ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
            END AS VARCHAR)
          GROUP BY stack_name
        )
        SELECT
          COALESCE(c.stack_name, p.stack_name) AS stack_name,
          c.avg_duration_current,
          p.avg_duration_previous,
          ROUND((c.avg_duration_current - p.avg_duration_previous) / NULLIF(p.avg_duration_previous, 0) * 100, 2) AS percent_change
        FROM current_month c
        FULL OUTER JOIN previous_month p
          ON c.stack_name = p.stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
  DailySessionCounts:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: >-
        Daily session counts for the current month.
      Name: !Sub "${QueryPrefix}daily-session-counts"
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT
          session_date,
          stack_name,
          COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
        WHERE month = CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
          AND year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
        GROUP BY session_date, stack_name
        ORDER BY session_date, stack_name
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
  AllSessionDetails:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: >-
        All session details including user, stack, duration, and date.
      Name: !Sub "${QueryPrefix}all-session-details"
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT
          user_name,
          session_id,
          stack_name,
          session_date,
          session_start_time,
          session_end_time,
          session_duration_seconds,
          application_name
        FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
        ORDER BY session_date DESC, user_name
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
  StreamingHoursPerUser:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: >-
        Total streaming hours per user for the current month.
      Name: !Sub "${QueryPrefix}streaming-hours-per-user"
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT
          user_name,
          ROUND(SUM(session_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
        WHERE month = CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
          AND year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
        GROUP BY user_name
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
  UniqueUsersPerApplication:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: >-
        Unique users per application for the current month.
      Name: !Sub "${QueryPrefix}unique-users-per-application"
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT
          application_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS unique_users
        FROM ${DatabaseName}.appstream_usage
        WHERE month = CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
          AND year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR)
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
Outputs:
  DatabaseNameOutput:
    Description: The Athena database name used for queries.
    Value: !Ref DatabaseName
  WorkGroupNameOutput:
    Description: The Athena workgroup name used for queries.
    Value: !Ref WorkGroupName
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentVsPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID for average session length per stack comparison.
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentVsPreviousMonth
  DailySessionCountsQueryId:
    Description: Query ID for daily session counts.
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCounts
  AllSessionDetailsQueryId:
    Description: Query ID for all session details.
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetails
  StreamingHoursPerUserQueryId:
    Description: Query ID for streaming hours per user.
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUser
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQueryId:
    Description: Query ID for unique users per application.
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplication

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Puppet Quick Start VPC infrastructure'
Parameters:
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
  PuppetIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com
  LinuxAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com
  WindowsAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: example.com
    Description: Domain name for the Route53 hosted zone
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartIGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicSubnet
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicRT
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for Puppet Quick Start
  PuppetRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "puppet.${DomainName}."
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP
  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "linuxagent.${DomainName}."
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP
  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "windowsagent.${DomainName}."
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: The name of the environment (e.g., dev, prod)
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    Description: The name of the microservice
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: The Docker image for the container
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: The port the container listens on
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Default: "256"
    Description: CPU units for Fargate task (e.g., 256, 512)
    AllowedValues:
      - "256"
      - "512"
      - "1024"
      - "2048"
      - "4096"
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Default: "512"
    Description: Memory for Fargate task in MB
    AllowedValues:
      - "512"
      - "1024"
      - "2048"
      - "3072"
      - "4096"
      - "8192"
      - "16384"
  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of running tasks
  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN for the task (leave empty to use default execution role)
Conditions:
  UseCustomRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, ""]]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc"
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gateway"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt-1"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt-2"
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-services.local"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: Private DNS namespace for service discovery
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow container communication within VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg"
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role"
  TaskRole:
    Condition: UseCustomRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role"
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [UseCustomRole, !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          Port: !Ref ContainerPort
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: ECSService
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up-policy"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down-policy"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: -10
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: -10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -2
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
  CPUAlarmHigh:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CPU utilization >= 70%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ECSService
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
  CPUAlarmLow:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CPU utilization <= 20%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ECSService
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy
Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
    Description: The ECS Cluster name
  ServiceName:
    Value: !Ref ECSService
    Description: The ECS Service name
  ServiceDiscoveryDNS:
    Value: !Sub "${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}-services.local"
    Description: The DNS name for service discovery
  SecurityGroupId:
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
    Description: The security group ID for the containers
  LogGroupName:
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroup
    Description: The CloudWatch Log Group name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for hybrid interconnect demonstration network backbone with OCI"
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone"
    Default: "10.94.10.0/24"
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "Internal CIDR range allowed for HTTPS inbound traffic to the security group"
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "OCI backbone CIDR range for HTTPS outbound traffic and TGW route"
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
  OCIBgpCustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Description: "Public IP address of the OCI VPN (Customer Gateway)"
    Default: ""
  OCIBgpASN:
    Type: Number
    Description: "BGP ASN for the OCI Customer Gateway"
    Default: 64512
  CreateVPNResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Flag to conditionally create Customer Gateway and VPN Connection to OCI"
    Default: "false"
Conditions:
  CreateVPNResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateVPNResources, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-VPC"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-Private-Subnet"
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-Private-RT"
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGateway"
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-TGW"
  VPCTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-TGW-VPC-Attachment"
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable"
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-TGW-RT"
  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPCTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for hybrid interconnect demo"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-SG"
  SecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress"
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
      Description: "Allow HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR"
  SecurityGroupEgress:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress"
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      Description: "Allow HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone CIDR"
  KMSKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-FlowLogs-Key"
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Alias"
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/hybrid-demo-flowlogs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/hybrid-demo"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-FlowLogs-LogGroup"
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::FlowLog"
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: "VPC"
      TrafficType: "ALL"
      LogDestinationType: "cloud-watch-logs"
      LogDestination: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Hybrid-Demo-FlowLog"
  VPNCustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: "AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway"
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref OCIBgpASN
      IpAddress: !Ref OCIBgpCustomerGatewayIp
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "OCI-Customer-Gateway"
  VPNConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPNConnection"
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref VPNCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "OCI-VPN-Connection"
  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute"
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection
  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociationVPN:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: "AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute"
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  SubnetId:
    Description: "Private Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId"
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId"
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SecurityGroupId"
  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Description: "VPN Connection ID to OCI"
    Value: !Ref VPNConnection
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpnConnectionId"

        Statement:

              Service:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuicksightAdminFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: quicksight:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: glue:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:*
                Resource: "*"

  AdminS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket

      BucketName: !Sub "quicksight-admin-${AWS::AccountId}"

            - Name: sourceipaddress

            - Name: useragent

            - Name: errorcode

            - Name: errormessage

            - Name: requestparameters

            - Name: responseelements

            - Name: additionaleventData

            - Name: eventid

            - Name: resources

            - Name: eventtype

            - Name: readonly

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom Chef recipe component, lifecycle policy, and daily scheduled builds"

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomAMIPipeline"
    Description: "Name for the Image Builder pipeline"
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "ChefRecipeComponent"
    Description: "Name for the custom build component"
  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomAMIImageRecipe"
    Description: "Name for the image recipe"
  InfrastructureConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomAMIInfrastructureConfig"
    Description: "Name for the infrastructure configuration"
  DistributionConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomAMIDistributionConfig"
    Description: "Name for the distribution configuration"
  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomAMILifecyclePolicy"
    Description: "Name for the lifecycle policy"
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-image-builder-bucket"
    Description: "S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe (must exist prior to deployment)"
  S3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: "chef/recipes/default.rb"
    Description: "S3 key for the Chef recipe file"
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1"
    Description: "Target region for AMI distribution"
  RetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: "Number of days to retain AMIs before deprecation"
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "t3.medium"
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
      - t3.xlarge
      - m5.large
      - m5.xlarge
    Description: "Instance type for the build instance"
  SubnetId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional subnet ID for the build instance. Leave empty to use default VPC."
  ParentImageId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: "/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id"
    Description: "SSM parameter path to get the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMI ID"
  EnableImageScanning:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Enable image scanning (requires Amazon Inspector to be enabled for EC2)"

Conditions:
  HasSubnetId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubnetId, ""]]
  ShouldEnableScanning: !Equals [!Ref EnableImageScanning, "true"]

Resources:

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${PipelineName}-ServiceRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
