  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${PipelineName}-InstanceRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceConnect
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*"
        - PolicyName: MetadataCollectionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsPolicy

                Resource: "*"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${PipelineName}-InstanceProfile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # Custom Component
  CustomBuildComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Description: "Custom build component that updates SSM agent, downloads Chef recipe from S3, executes it, and collects metadata"
      Platform: "Linux"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Data: !Sub |
        name: CustomBuildComponent
        description: Updates SSM agent, downloads and executes Chef recipe, collects metadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                    - sudo systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - aws s3 cp s3://${S3BucketName}/${S3Key} /tmp/chef-recipe.rb
                    - echo "Chef recipe downloaded successfully"
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | sudo bash
                    - sudo /opt/chef/embedded/bin/gem install chef
              - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo chef-client --local-mode /tmp/chef-recipe.rb
                    - echo "Chef recipe executed successfully"
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      cat <<EOF > /tmp/build-metadata.json
                      {
                        "build_time": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
                        "instance_id": "$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)",
                        "instance_type": "$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-type)",
                        "ami_id": "$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ami-id)",
                        "region": "$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/region)"
                      }
                      EOF
                    - aws s3 cp /tmp/build-metadata.json s3://${S3BucketName}/metadata/build-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).json
                    - echo "Metadata collected and uploaded"

  # Image Recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Description: "Image recipe using Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMI with custom Chef component"
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref CustomBuildComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: false
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      WorkingDirectory: "/tmp"
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfrastructureConfigName
      Description: "Infrastructure configuration with terminate on failure enabled"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SubnetId: !If [HasSubnetId, !Ref SubnetId, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref S3BucketName
          S3KeyPrefix: "image-builder-logs/"

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistributionConfigName
      Description: "Distribution configuration sharing AMI with current account in target region"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{ imagebuilder:imageName }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}"
            Description: "Custom AMI built with Chef recipe"
            AmiTags:
              Environment: "Production"
              Pipeline: !Ref PipelineName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  # Lifecycle Policy
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: "Lifecycle policy that deprecates AMIs based on age and tag selection"
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: "AMI_IMAGE"
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: "Production"
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: "DEPRECATE"
          Filter:
            Type: "AGE"
            Value: !Ref RetentionDays
            Unit: "DAYS"
            RetainAtLeast: 1

  # Image Pipeline
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: "Daily scheduled pipeline with image tests and optional scanning"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: !If [ShouldEnableScanning, true, false]
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: "EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
      Status: "ENABLED"

Outputs:

    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ComponentArn:
    Description: "ARN of the custom build component"
    Value: !Ref CustomBuildComponent
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: "ARN of the image recipe"

  LifecyclePolicyArn:

    Description: "ARN of the EC2 instance profile"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PII classification scanner for S3 Access Point using Comprehend, DynamoDB, and optional SNS. Lambda code must be provided via S3 bucket.'

Parameters:

  LambdaCodeS3Bucket:

    Default: 'my-lambda-code-bucket'
    Description: 'S3 bucket containing Lambda code. Replace with actual bucket.'
  LambdaCodeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: 'lambda/pii-scanner.zip'
    Description: 'S3 key for Lambda code. Replace with actual key.'
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number

    Description: 'Memory for Lambda function in MB.'
    AllowedValues:
      - 128
      - 256
      - 512
      - 1024
      - 2048

      - 10240
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: 'Lambda timeout in seconds.'
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
  ComprehendLanguageCode:

    Default: en

      - es
      - fr
      - de
      - it
      - pt
      - ar
      - hi
      - ja
      - ko
      - zh
      - zh-TW
  MaxFilesToScan:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: 'Maximum files to scan per invocation.'
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
  VpcId:

    Description: 'VPC ID if Access Point is VPC-scoped. Empt for internet origin.'
    AllowedPattern: '^(vpc-[0-9a-f]{8}|vpc-[0-9a-f]{17})?$'
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Security group ID.'
    AllowedPattern: '^(sg-[0-9a-f]{8}|sg-[0-9a-f]{17})?$'
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Route table IDs for S3 Gateway endpoint.'
    AllowedPattern: '^(rtb-[0-9a-f]{8,17}(,rtb-[0-9a-f]{8,17})*)?$'
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: 'Set to false if VPC already has endpoints.'
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional SNS topic ARN.'
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiiClassificationReports
    Description: 'DynamoDB table name.'

  HasSubnetIds: !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref SubnetIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroupId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecuritGroupId, '']]
  IsVpcDeploymentValid: !And
    - !Condtion IsVpcDeployment
    - !Condtion HasSubnetIds
    - !Condtion HasSecuritGroupId
  CreateVpcEndpoints: !And

    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]

    Properties:

        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ScnerLambdaPolicy
        - !If

          - !Ref VpcLambdaPolicy
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If

    Condition: HasSnsTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates Glue databases and tables for property graph and RDF graph data. Database names incorporate the stack name to avoid conflicts."
Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-graph-data-bucket"
    Description: "S3 bucket for table data locations."
  DatabaseBaseNameLPG:
    Type: String
    Default: "graph-database"
    Description: "Base name for the property graph database. The stack name is appended to ensure uniqueness."
  DatabaseBaseNameRDF:
    Type: String
    Default: "graph-database-rdf"
    Description: "Base name for the RDF database. The stack name is appended to ensure uniqueness."
Resources:
  GlueDatabaseLPG:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
        Description: "Database for property graph tables (airport, country, continent, route, customairport)."
  GlueDatabaseRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}"
        Description: "Database for RDF graph tables (airport_rdf, route_rdf, route_rdf_nopfx)."
  GlueTableAirport:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "airport"
        Description: "Airport vertex table with comma separator."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "code"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "name"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "city"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "country"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "lat"
              Type: "double"
            - Name: "lon"
              Type: "double"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}/airport/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          graphLabel: "vertex"
  GlueTableCountry:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "country"
        Description: "Country vertex table with comma separator."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "code"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "name"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "continent"
              Type: "string"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}/country/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          graphLabel: "vertex"
  GlueTableContinent:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "continent"
        Description: "Continent vertex table with comma separator."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "code"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "name"
              Type: "string"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}/continent/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          graphLabel: "vertex"
  GlueTableRoute:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "route"
        Description: "Route edge table with comma separator and Gremlin traversal query."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "source"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "destination"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "distance"
              Type: "int"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}/route/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          graphLabel: "edge"
          gremlinQuery: "g.V().hasLabel('route').limit(10).project('source','destination').by('source').by('destination')"
  GlueTableCustomairport:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseLPG
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "customairport"
        Description: "Custom airport view table with comma separator."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "code"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "name"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "city"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "country"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "lat"
              Type: "double"
            - Name: "lon"
              Type: "double"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}/customairport/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          graphLabel: "view"
  GlueTableAirportRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "airport_rdf"
        Description: "RDF airport table with classuri and querymode class."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "code"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "name"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "city"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "country"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "lat"
              Type: "double"
            - Name: "lon"
              Type: "double"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}/airport_rdf/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          rdf-type: "true"
          stripPrefixes: "true"
          classuri: "class:Airport"
          querymode: "class"
          classNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/class/"
          datatypePropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/datatype/"
          objectPropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/object/"
  GlueTableRouteRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "route_rdf"
        Description: "RDF route table with sparql query mode."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "incode"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "outcode"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "dist"
              Type: "int"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}/route_rdf/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          rdf-type: "true"
          stripPrefixes: "true"
          querymode: "sparql"
          sparqlQuery: "PREFIX : <http://air-routes.org/> SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE { ?route :incode ?incode ; :outcode ?outcode ; :dist ?dist } LIMIT 10"
          classNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/class/"
          datatypePropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/datatype/"
          objectPropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/object/"
  GlueTableRouteRDFNopfx:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GlueDatabaseRDF
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}"
      TableInput:
        Name: "route_rdf_nopfx"
        Description: "RDF route table without prefix, sparql query mode."
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: "incode"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "outcode"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "dist"
              Type: "int"
          InputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"
          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "s3://${BucketName}/data/${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}/route_rdf_nopfx/"
        PartitionKeys: []
        Parameters:
          rdf-type: "true"
          stripPrefixes: "true"
          querymode: "sparql"
          sparqlQuery: "SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE { ?route <http://air-routes.org/incode> ?incode ; <http://air-routes.org/outcode> ?outcode ; <http://air-routes.org/dist> ?dist } LIMIT 10"
          classNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/class/"
          datatypePropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/datatype/"
          objectPropertyNamespace: "http://air-routes.org/object/"
Outputs:
  DatabaseNames:
    Description: "Names of the created Glue databases."
    Value: !Sub "${DatabaseBaseNameLPG}-${AWS::StackName}, ${DatabaseBaseNameRDF}-${AWS::StackName}"
  TableNamesLPG:
    Description: "Tables in the property graph database."
    Value: "airport, country, continent, route, customairport"
  TableNamesRDF:
    Description: "Tables in the RDF database."
    Value: "airport_rdf, route_rdf, route_rdf_nopfx"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for PiBot Cognito authentication infrastructure - creates separate Main Web App and IoT Provisioning authentication setups with IAM roles and identity pools"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: "Environment name used for resource naming"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: "Project name used for resource naming"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"
Resources:
  MainWebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-${EnvironmentName}"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
  MainWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-${EnvironmentName}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
  MainWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-${EnvironmentName}"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainWebAppUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
  MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-Auth-${EnvironmentName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-AuthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - iot:ListThings
                  - iot:DescribeThing

                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream

                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectFaces
                  - rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
  MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-Unauth-${EnvironmentName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-UnauthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
  MainWebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:

      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn

    Description: "Identity Pool ID for IoT Trusted User Provisioning"
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Route 53 hosted zone and DNS records for radiotopia.fm"

Parameters:
  SpfPolicy:
    Type: String
    Description: "SPF record value (e.g., v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all)"
    Default: "\"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:_spf.zendesk.com include:spf.mandrillapp.com ~all\""
  DmarcPolicy:
    Type: String
    Description: "DMARC record value"
    Default: "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm; ruf=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm\""
  DomainVerificationToken1:
    Type: String
    Description: "First domain ownership verification token"
    Default: "\"google-site-verification=token1\""
  DomainVerificationToken2:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second domain ownership verification token"
    Default: "\"ms=abc123\""
  MxServer:
    Type: String
    Description: "Mail exchange server FQDN"
    Default: "aspmx.l.google.com"
  MxPriority:
    Type: Number
    Description: "MX priority"
    Default: 1
  ApexIPs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Comma-separated list of static IPs for apex A records"
    Default: "192.0.2.1,192.0.2.2"
  WwwCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for www"
    Default: "radiotopia.fm.s3-website-us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
  MediaDistributionDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: "CloudFront domain for media.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
  TowerDistributionDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: "CloudFront domain for tower.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "d456.cloudfront.net"
  V1DistributionDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: "CloudFront domain for v1.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "d789.cloudfront.net"
  PlusDistributionDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: "CloudFront domain for plus.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "d012.cloudfront.net"
  PodcastFeedTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME target for feed.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "feeds.feedproxy.com"
  SpecialEventIP:
    Type: String
    Description: "IP for event.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "198.51.100.1"
  AcmMediaValidationCnameName:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME name for ACM validation of media.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "_acme-challenge.media"
  AcmMediaValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME value for ACM validation of media.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "acm-validations.aws"
  AcmTowerValidationCnameName:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME name for ACM validation of tower.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "_acme-challenge.tower"
  AcmTowerValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME value for ACM validation of tower.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "acm-validations.aws"
  AcmV1ValidationCnameName:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME name for ACM validation of v1.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "_acme-challenge.v1"
  AcmV1ValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME value for ACM validation of v1.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "acm-validations.aws"
  AcmPlusValidationCnameName:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME name for ACM validation of plus.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "_acme-challenge.plus"
  AcmPlusValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "CNAME value for ACM validation of plus.radiotopia.fm"
    Default: "acm-validations.aws"
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: "Zendesk domain verification TXT record value"
    Default: "\"zendesk-verification=token123\""
  MailChimpVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: "MailChimp domain verification TXT record value"
    Default: "\"mailchimp-verification=token456\""
  SquarespaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: "Squarespace domain verification TXT record value"
    Default: "\"squarespace-verification=token789\""
  CampaignMonitorVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: "Campaign Monitor domain verification TXT record value"
    Default: "\"cm-verification=token012\""
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: "Google Workspace domain verification TXT record value"
    Default: "\"google-site-verification=token345\""
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimRecord:
    Type: String
    Description: "Google Workspace DKIM TXT record value"
    Default: "\"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQC...\""
  ZendeskCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "Zendesk CNAME target"
    Default: "zendesk.com"
  SquarespaceCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: "Squarespace CNAME target"
    Default: "squarespace.com"

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: "Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm"

  # Combined TXT record for apex: SPF + two verification tokens
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpfPolicy
        - !Ref DomainVerificationToken1
        - !Ref DomainVerificationToken2

  # DMARC TXT record
  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DmarcPolicy

  # MX record
  MxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Join [" ", [!Ref MxPriority, !Ref MxServer]]

  # Apex A records
  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords: !Ref ApexIPs

  # www CNAME
  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: www.radiotopia.fm
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WwwCnameTarget

  # media.radiotopia.fm A and AAAA alias to CloudFront
  MediaAliasA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref MediaDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  MediaAliasAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref MediaDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # tower.radiotopia.fm A and AAAA alias to CloudFront
  TowerAliasA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref TowerDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  TowerAliasAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref TowerDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # v1.radiotopia.fm A and AAAA alias to CloudFront
  V1AliasA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: v1.radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref V1DistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  V1AliasAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: v1.radiotopia.fm
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref V1DistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # plus.radiotopia.fm A and AAAA alias to CloudFront
  PlusAliasA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: plus.radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref PlusDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  PlusAliasAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: plus.radiotopia.fm
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref PlusDistributionDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # podcast feed CNAME
  PodcastFeedCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: feed.radiotopia.fm
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PodcastFeedTarget

  # special event A record
  SpecialEventARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: event.radiotopia.fm
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpecialEventIP

  # ACM validation CNAME records for CloudFront subdomains
  AcmMediaValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref AcmMediaValidationCnameName, "radiotopia.fm"]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmMediaValidationCnameValue
  AcmTowerValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref AcmTowerValidationCnameName, "radiotopia.fm"]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmTowerValidationCnameValue
  AcmV1Validation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref AcmV1ValidationCnameName, "radiotopia.fm"]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmV1ValidationCnameValue
  AcmPlusValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref AcmPlusValidationCnameName, "radiotopia.fm"]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmPlusValidationCnameValue

  # Third-party verification records
  # Zendesk CNAME and TXT verification
  ZendeskCnameVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_zendesk-challenge.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskCnameTarget
  ZendeskTxtVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_zendesk-verification.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskVerificationToken

  # MailChimp TXT verification
  MailChimpTxtVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_mailchimp-verification.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref MailChimpVerificationToken

  # Squarespace CNAME and TXT verification
  SquarespaceCnameVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_squarespace-challenge.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceCnameTarget
  SquarespaceTxtVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_squarespace-verification.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationToken

  # Campaign Monitor TXT verification
  CampaignMonitorTxtVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_cm-verification.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorVerificationToken

  # Google Workspace verification and DKIM
  GoogleWorkspaceTxtVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "_google-domain-verification.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref GoogleWorkspaceVerificationToken
  GoogleWorkspaceDkim:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: "google._domainkey.radiotopia.fm"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref GoogleWorkspaceDkimRecord

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: "Route 53 Hosted Zone ID"
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  NameServers:
    Description: "Name servers for the hosted zone"
    Value: !Join [",", !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration with protein variant effect prediction.'
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: 'Project name used for resource naming and default SSM paths.'
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Gateway for protein variant effect prediction using MCP'
    Description: 'Description for the AgentCore Gateway.'
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional name for the gateway. If left blank, it auto-generates from the project name.'
  LambdaArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:placeholder-lambda'
    Description: 'ARN of the Lambda function to invoke for MCP operations. Provide a valid ARN or update after stack creation.'
  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://accounts.google.com'
    Description: 'OIDC discovery URL for the JWT authorizer. For Cognito, use https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<userPoolId>.'
  CognitoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'placeholder-client-id'
    Description: 'Client ID (audience) for the JWT authorizer. Provide a valid client ID or update after stack creation.'
  RoleArnSSMPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/agentcore-gateway-role-arn
    Description: 'SSM parameter path where the new IAM role ARN will be stored.'
Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameEmpty: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']
  IsLambdaReal: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaArn, 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:placeholder-lambda']]
Resources:
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/lambda-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref LambdaArn
      Description: 'Lambda function ARN for MCP integration.'
  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito-discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl
      Description: 'Cognito JWT discovery URL for the authorizer.'
  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoClientId
      Description: 'Cognito client ID for the JWT authorizer.'
  LambdaPermissionForBedrock:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: IsLambdaReal
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaArn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
  AgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Ref LambdaArn
  RoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref RoleArnSSMPath
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreRole.Arn
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - IsGatewayNameEmpty
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins:
          - '*'
        AllowMethods:
          - GET
          - POST
          - OPTIONS
        AllowHeaders:
          - '*'
  JWTAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - '$request.header.Authorization'
      JwtConfiguration:
        Issuer: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl
        Audience:
          - !Ref CognitoClientId
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-jwt-authorizer'
  Integration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Ref LambdaArn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
  RouteInvokeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      RouteKey: 'POST /invoke_endpoint'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref JWTAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${Integration}'
  RouteGetResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      RouteKey: 'GET /get_results'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref JWTAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${Integration}'
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      StageName: '$default'
      AutoDeploy: true
  LambdaPermissionForApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: IsLambdaReal
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaArn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AgentCoreGateway}/*/*'
  MCPToolSchemaParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/mcp-tool-schema'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub |
        {"toolName":"${ProjectName}-tool","operations":[{"name":"invoke_endpoint","method":"POST","path":"/invoke_endpoint"},{"name":"get_results","method":"GET","path":"/get_results"}]}
      Description: 'MCP tool schema for protein variant effect prediction.'
Outputs:
  GatewayEndpoint:
    Description: 'HTTP API Gateway endpoint URL.'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AgentCoreGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
  AgentCoreRoleArn:
    Description: 'IAM Role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore.'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreRole.Arn
  MCPToolSchemaParameterName:
    Description: 'SSM parameter storing the MCP tool schema.'
    Value: !Ref MCPToolSchemaParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC infrastructure with ALB subnets, Lambda subnet, optional NAT Gateway, KMS key, and S3 bucket for artifact storage.
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  AlbSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for private ALB subnet 1 (AZ1).
  AlbSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for private ALB subnet 2 (AZ2).
  LambdaSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for private Lambda subnet (AZ1).
  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable NAT Gateway for internet egress from private subnets.
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First availability zone for ALB subnet and Lambda subnet.
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second availability zone for ALB subnet.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC-IGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALB-Private-Subnet-1
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALB-Private-Subnet-2
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lambda-Private-Subnet
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateVPC-NAT
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Private-Route-Table
  DefaultPrivateRoute:
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  AlbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  ArtifactBucketKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting artifact storage bucket
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable full access for root account
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ArtifactBucketKMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ArtifactStorageBucket
Conditions:
  NatEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, 'true']
Outputs:
  VpcId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Step Functions state machine with two API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) each exposing an endpoint to start executions.'
Parameters:
  GetApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage name for the GET API
  PostApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage name for the POST API
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name for the state machine; if empty, uses stack name
Conditions:
  IsStateMachineNameProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StateMachineName, '']]
Resources:
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !If [IsStateMachineNameProvided, !Ref StateMachineName, !Ref 'AWS::StackName']
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "A simple two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "FirstStep",
          "States": {
            "FirstStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Step 1 completed",
              "Next": "SecondStep"
            },
            "SecondStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Step 2 completed",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-api'
      Description: 'REST API with GET endpoint to start state machine execution'
  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start
  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GetApiStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "{\"method\": \"GET\", \"timestamp\": \"$context.requestTime\"}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"executionId": "$input.path(\"$.executionArn\")"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref GetApiStageName
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-api'
      Description: 'REST API with POST endpoint to start state machine execution'
  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start
  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostApiStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "{\"method\": \"POST\", \"timestamp\": \"$context.requestTime\", \"body\": $input.json('$')}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"executionId": "$input.path(\"$.executionArn\")"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref PostApiStageName
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  GetApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET API
    Value: !Sub 'https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${GetApiStageName}/start'
  PostApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST API
    Value: !Sub 'https://${PostApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PostApiStageName}/start'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for audit SQS queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ, CloudWatch alarms, and SNS notifications'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - stg
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment. DLQ is only created for non-dev environments.

  QueueName:
    Type: String
    Default: audit-queue
    Description: Name of the primary SQS queue.

  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Retention period for messages in seconds (default 4 days).

  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 43200
    Description: Visibility timeout in seconds (default 30).

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Max receive count before message is sent to DLQ (if DLQ exists).

  DLQRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1209600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Retention period for DLQ messages in seconds (default 14 days).

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications.

  OldMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    Description: Threshold in seconds for ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage alarm.

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]

Resources:
  AuditKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS encryption with rotation enabled
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  AuditKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${QueueName}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey

  DLQ:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${QueueName}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref DLQRetentionPeriod
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditKMSKey.Arn
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Ref QueueName
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        !If
        - IsNotDev
        -
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  AlarmSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${QueueName}-alarms'
      Subscription:
        - Protocol: email
          Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  OldMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${QueueName}-old-messages'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when oldest message in queue exceeds threshold'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref OldMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

  DLQActivityAlarm:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${QueueName}-dlq-activity'
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when messages appear in DLQ'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueURL:
    Description: URL of the audit queue
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueARN:
    Description: ARN of the audit queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  DLQURL:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the dead letter queue (if created)
    Value: !Ref DLQ
  DLQARN:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the dead letter queue (if created)
    Value: !GetAtt DLQ.Arn
  KMSKeyID:
    Description: KMS key ID
    Value: !Ref AuditKMSKey
  KMSKeyARN:
    Description: KMS key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKMSKey.Arn
  SNSTopicARN:
    Description: ARN of SNS topic for alarms
    Value: !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito User Pool with MFA, groups, clients, and SSM parameters"

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: templategatewaypool
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$"
    Description: "Name of the Cognito User Pool (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only)"
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: "Name of the machine-to-machine app client"
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: "Name of the web app client"

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda function
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUserGroupManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:ListGroups
                  - cognito-idp:AdminListGroupsForUser
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda function to add users to customer group
  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-add-to-customer-group"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              user_pool_id = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
              group_name = 'customer'
              
              # This function is not wired as a trigger; it's a standalone function
              # that can be invoked to add users to the customer group
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Function ready to add users to customer group')
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Description: "Lambda function to add new users to the customer group (not wired as trigger)"

  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  # User Pool Domain
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource Server
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: researchapp
      Name: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-resource-server"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to resources
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # User Pool Groups
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Web App Client (Authorization Code Flow)
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp/read
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - preferred_username
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - preferred_username

  # Machine-to-Machine Client (Client Credentials Flow)
  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # SSM Parameters
  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  WebAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-app-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web App Client ID

  MachineAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-app-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Machine App Client ID

  MachineAppClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-app-client-secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine App Client Secret

  OAuthScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth-scopes
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp/read
      Description: OAuth Scopes

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: OIDC Discovery URL

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Description: Token URL

  AuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: Authorize URL

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito-domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: Cognito Domain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web App Client ID
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Description: Machine App Client ID
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Cognito Domain
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CryptoTickerAPI: AWS AppSync GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data with DynamoDB backend'
Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
  AppSyncSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float!
          timestamp: String!
        }
        type PriceHistoryResult {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float!
          timestamp: String!
        }
        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
          priceHistory(ticker: String!, limit: Int = 25, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryResult
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
        }
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
  AppSyncHTTPRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncHTTPAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: '*'
  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncHTTPRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3
  GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      Name: GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$context.arguments.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          },
          "resourcePath": "/simple/price"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($result = $util.parseJson($context.result.body))
        #if ($result.containsKey($context.arguments.ticker))
          #set($priceData = $result.get($context.arguments.ticker))
          #if ($priceData.containsKey("usd"))
            $util.toJson({
              "ticker": "$context.arguments.ticker",
              "price": $util.toJson($priceData.usd),
              "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
            })
          #else
            $util.error("USD price not available for ticker", "PRICE_NOT_FOUND")
          #end
        #else
          $util.error("Ticker not found on CoinGecko", "TICKER_NOT_FOUND")
        #end
  SavePriceToDynamoDBFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: SavePriceToDynamoDBFunction
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": { "S": "$context.prev.result.ticker" },
            "sk": { "S": "$context.prev.result.timestamp" }
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": { "S": "$context.prev.result.ticker" },
            "price": { "N": "$context.prev.result.price" },
            "timestamp": { "S": "$context.prev.result.timestamp" }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "ticker": "$context.result.ticker.S",
          "price": $context.result.price.N,
          "timestamp": "$context.result.timestamp.S"
        }
  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query

        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction.FunctionId

        {
          "version": "2018-05-29"
