              ":hk": { "S": "$context.arguments.ticker" }
            }
          },
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($context.arguments.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": "$util.defaultIfNullOrEmpty($context.arguments.nextToken, null)",
          "scanIndexForward": false
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "items": $util.toJson($context.result.items),
          "nextToken": "$util.toJson($context.result.nextToken)"
        }
  DefaultApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: AppSyncSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, optional live-to-VOD and VOD workflows"
Parameters:
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, origin endpoints origination is set to DENY and IAM permissions are granted."
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional S3 bucket name for VOD source content. If provided, IAM permissions are granted for MediaPackage to access this bucket."
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: "Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint."
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 300
    MaxValue: 604800
    Description: "Startover window in seconds for both endpoints. Must be at least 300."
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: "index"
    Description: "Manifest name for the origin endpoints."
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: "Output type for the origin endpoints. APPLE_HLS creates only HLS, ISO_DASH creates only DASH, ALL creates both."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "production"
    Description: "Environment tag value for all resources."
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag key."
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag value."
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Prefix for logical resource naming (e.g., 'prod-')."
Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, ""]]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, ""]]
  UseDenyOrigination: !Condition HasArchiveBucket
  NeedMediaPackageRole: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  HasCustomTag: !And [!Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, ""]], !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagValue, ""]]]
  IsAllOutput: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ALL"]
  IsHlsOutput: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, "APPLE_HLS"], !Condition IsAllOutput]
  IsDashOutput: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ISO_DASH"], !Condition IsAllOutput]
Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}live-channel"
      Description: !Sub "Live streaming channel ${LogicalNamePrefix}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  MediaPackageHlsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: IsHlsOutput
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}hls-endpoint"
      Description: !Sub "HLS origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [UseDenyOrigination, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 60
        AdMarkers: NONE
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  MediaPackageDashEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: IsDashOutput
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}dash-endpoint"
      Description: !Sub "DASH origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [UseDenyOrigination, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        Profile: NONE
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 30
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        PeriodTriggers:
          - ADS
        AdTriggers:
          - SPLICE_INSERT
          - BREAK
          - PROVIDER_ADVERTISEMENT
          - DISTRIBUTOR_ADVERTISEMENT
          - PROVIDER_PLACEMENT_OPPORTUNITY
          - DISTRIBUTOR_PLACEMENT_OPPORTUNITY
          - PROVIDER_OVERLAY_PLACEMENT_OPPORTUNITY
          - DISTRIBUTOR_OVERLAY_PLACEMENT_OPPORTUNITY
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        UtcTiming: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: NeedMediaPackageRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}mediapackage-bucket-access"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
Outputs:
  MediaPackageChannelId:
    Description: "MediaPackage channel ID"
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  MediaPackageChannelArn:
    Description: "MediaPackage channel ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn
  MediaPackageHlsEndpointUrl:
    Description: "HLS origin endpoint URL"
    Condition: IsHlsOutput
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageHlsEndpoint.Url
  MediaPackageDashEndpointUrl:
    Description: "DASH origin endpoint URL"
    Condition: IsDashOutput
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageDashEndpoint.Url
  MediaPackageRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM role ARN for MediaPackage bucket access"
    Condition: NeedMediaPackageRole
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM roles, instance profiles, and policies for Cluster API Provider AWS"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    Description: Prefix for resource names
  KMSAliasPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: "alias/capi-*"
    Description: KMS alias pattern for conditional permissions
Resources:
  ControlPlaneCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controlplane-policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:*"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:*"
              - "autoscaling:*"
              - "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
  ControllersCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controllers-policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:CreateVpc"
              - "ec2:DeleteVpc"
              - "ec2:CreateSubnet"
              - "ec2:DeleteSubnet"
              - "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup"
              - "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup"
              - "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress"
              - "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress"
              - "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress"
              - "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress"
              - "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate"
              - "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate"
              - "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion"
              - "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions"
              - "ec2:Describe*"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:*"
              - "autoscaling:*"
              - "eks:CreateAccessEntry"
              - "eks:DeleteAccessEntry"
              - "eks:AssociateAccessPolicy"
              - "eks:ListAccessEntries"
              - "eks:DescribeAccessEntry"
              - "eks:UpdateAccessEntry"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole"
            Resource: "arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*"
  ControllersEksCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controllers-eks-policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "eks:DescribeCluster"
              - "eks:CreateCluster"
              - "eks:DeleteCluster"
              - "eks:UpdateClusterConfig"
              - "eks:UpdateClusterVersion"
              - "eks:CreateNodegroup"
              - "eks:DeleteNodegroup"
              - "eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig"
              - "eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion"
              - "eks:TagResource"
              - "eks:UntagResource"
              - "eks:ListClusters"
              - "eks:ListNodegroups"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ssm:GetParameter"
              - "ssm:GetParametersByPath"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "iam:GetRole"
              - "iam:GetPolicy"
              - "iam:ListPolicies"
              - "iam:ListRoles"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:RequestAlias: !Ref KMSAliasPattern
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole"
            Resource:
              - "arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS"
              - "arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup"
              - "arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSFargatePods"
  NodesCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-nodes-policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:DescribeInstances"
              - "ec2:DescribeTags"
              - "ec2:DescribeVolumes"
              - "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
              - "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups"
              - "ec2:DescribeSubnets"
              - "ec2:DescribeVpcs"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
              - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
              - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
              - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
              - "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
            Resource: "arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ssm:DescribeAssociation"
              - "ssm:GetDocument"
              - "ssm:PutInventory"
              - "ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation"
              - "ssm:ListAssociations"
              - "ssm:GetCommandInvocation"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "s3:GetObject"
            Resource: "*"
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controlplane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneCustomPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksCustomPolicy
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controllers-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersCustomPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksCustomPolicy
  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-nodes-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Ref NodesCustomPolicy
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-eks-controlplane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controlplane-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-controllers-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-capi-nodes-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole
Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI controllers role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI nodes role
    Value: !GetAtt NodesRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS cluster control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI control plane instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn
  ControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI controllers instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersInstanceProfile.Arn
  NodesInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPI nodes instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt NodesInstanceProfile.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications.'
Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition key.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the partition key (S, N, or B).
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the sort key. Leave empty to disable sort key.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the sort key (S, N, or B). Only used if SortKeyName is provided.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: Billing mode for the table.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery for the table.
  EnableEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable server-side encryption. If true, you can optionally provide a KMS key ARN.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for encryption. Leave empty to use AWS managed key (only used if EnableEncryption is true).
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and error rates.
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications (only used if EnableAlarms is true).
  AlarmSnsTopicName:
    Type: String
    Default: DynamoDB-Alarms
    Description: Name of the SNS topic for alarms (only used if EnableAlarms is true).
  ThrottleThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Threshold for throttling alarms (sum of events in evaluation period).
  ErrorThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Threshold for error alarms (sum of events in evaluation period).
  EvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of evaluation periods for alarms.
Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  EnableEncryption: !Equals [!Ref EnableEncryption, 'true']
  UseCustomKmsKey: !And [!Condition EnableEncryption, !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]]
  EnableAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']
  HasAlarmEmail: !And [!Condition EnableAlarms, !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]]
Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableEncryption
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !If
            - UseCustomKmsKey
            - !Ref KmsKeyArn
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  SNSAlarmTopic:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Ref AlarmSnsTopicName
      Subscription:
        - !If
          - HasAlarmEmail
          - Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
            Protocol: email
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  SNSAlarmTopicPolicy:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-ReadThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm for read throttle events on DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm for write throttle events on DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
  SystemErrorAlarm:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm for system errors on DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
  UserErrorAlarm:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm for user errors on DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref SNSAlarmTopic
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  SnsTopicArn:
    Condition: EnableAlarms
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarms
    Value: !Ref SNSAlarmTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "EC2 Image Builder pipeline for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs with Docker, Python packages, and SSM sudo access"

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    Description: Version of the AMI (e.g., 1.0.0)
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root volume size in GB
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: "o-xxxxxxxxxx"
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share AMIs with

Resources:
  # VPC and networking resources for the build instance
  ImageBuilderVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: ImageBuilderVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for Image Builder build instance"
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # IAM Role for the EC2 instance used by Image Builder
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceConnect
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:AttachVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LogsBucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LogsBucket}/*"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # IAM Role for the Image Builder pipeline
  ImageBuilderPipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSImageBuilderFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPipelinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LogsBucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LogsBucket}/*"

  # S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Component for software installation and testing
  SoftwareInstallAndTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-software-install-test"
      Platform: "Linux"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: "Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, enables SSM sudo, and verifies"
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallAndTest
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y docker
                    - sudo systemctl enable docker
                    - sudo systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo curl -L "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "ec2-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/ec2-user
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')"

  # Image Recipe for x86
  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallAndTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: "/tmp"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Image Recipe for arm64
  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallAndTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: "/tmp"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Infrastructure Configuration (shared)
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infra-config"
      Description: "Shared infrastructure configuration for Image Builder"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.micro
        - t4g.micro
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: "image-builder-logs"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Distribution Configuration with organization-level sharing
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dist-config"
      Description: "Distribution configuration with organization sharing"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "custom-amazon-linux-2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}"
            Description: "Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI with Docker and Python packages"
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - Fn::Join:
                    - ""
                    - - "arn:aws:organizations::"
                      - Ref: "AWS::AccountId"
                      - ":organization/"
                      - Ref: "OrganizationId"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Lambda role for making AMI public after build
  MakePublicLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MakePublicPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda function to make AMI public
  MakePublicLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MakePublicLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  # Extract the Image Builder ARN from the event
                  image_arn = event['detail']['imageBuildVersionArn']
                  region = event['region']
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=region)
                  ib = boto3.client('imagebuilder', region_name=region)

                  # Get the built AMI ID
                  resp = ib.get_image(imageBuildVersionArn=image_arn)
                  ami_id = None
                  for ami in resp['image']['outputResources']['amis']:
                      if ami['region'] == region:
                          ami_id = ami['image']
                          break

                  if not ami_id:
                      raise Exception('No AMI found for region ' + region)

                  # Make the AMI public
                  ec2.modify_image_attribute(
                      ImageId=ami_id,
                      LaunchPermission={'Add': [{'Group': 'all'}]}
                  )
                  print(f"AMI {ami_id} is now public")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

  # EventBridge rule to trigger when Image Builder finishes building an image
  ImageBuilderEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.imagebuilder
        detail-type:
          - "EC2 Image Builder Image Build State Change"
        detail:
          state:
            status:
              - AVAILABLE
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt MakePublicLambda.Arn
          Id: MakePublicLambdaTarget

  # Permission for EventBridge to invoke the Lambda
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MakePublicLambda
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt ImageBuilderEventRule.Arn

  # Image Pipeline for x86
  ImagePipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline"
      Description: "Pipeline to build custom Amazon Linux 2023 x86 AMIs"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 1 1 ? *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: "EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
      Status: "ENABLED"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Image Pipeline for arm64
  ImagePipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline"
      Description: "Pipeline to build custom Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMIs"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 1 1 ? *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: "EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE"
      Status: "ENABLED"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  PipelineX86Arn:
    Description: "ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineX86
  PipelineArm64Arn:
    Description: "ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineArm64
  ImageRecipeX86Arn:
    Description: "ARN of the x86 image recipe"
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
  ImageRecipeArm64Arn:
    Description: "ARN of the arm64 image recipe"
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
  ComponentArn:
    Description: "ARN of the software install and test component"
    Value: !Ref SoftwareInstallAndTestComponent
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: "ARN of the distribution configuration"
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: "ARN of the infrastructure configuration"
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Resources:
  AgentOpsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      Schema:
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  AgentOpsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  SeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeedingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${AgentOpsUserPool}"

  SeederLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def create_or_update_user(user_pool_id, username, password, role, group_name):
              try:
                  cognito.admin_create_user(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      TemporaryPassword=password,
                      MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                  )
                  logger.info(f"Created user {username}")
              except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                  logger.info(f"User {username} already exists")

              cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  Password=password,
                  Permanent=True
              )

              # Set email (required for login) and custom:role attribute
              cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': username},
                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                  ]
              )

              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  GroupName=group_name,
                  Username=username
              )
              logger.info(f"Added user {username} to group {group_name}")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
              password = 'Demo1234!'

              users = [
                  ('alice@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'member'),
                  ('bob@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'member'),
                  ('charlie@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'team_admin'),
                  ('dave@demo.local', 'team-beta', 'member'),
                  ('eve@demo.local', 'team-beta', 'team_admin'),
                  ('admin@demo.local', 'admin', 'admin'),
              ]

              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      for username, group_name, role in users:
                          create_or_update_user(user_pool_id, username, password, role, group_name)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {str(e)}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  SeederLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt SeederLambdaFunction.Arn
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com

  SeederCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::UserPoolSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederLambdaFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: The AWS region where the resources are deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Lambda function used for seeding users
    Value: !GetAtt SeederLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for AWS Client VPN usage reporting with CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and dashboard'
Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Optional folder path to organize the queries
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: The CloudWatch Log Group name for Client VPN logs
Resources:
  QueryUsagePerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/usage-per-endpoint'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"endpoint_id":"(?<endpoint_id>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count() as total_connections by endpoint_id
        | sort total_connections desc
        | display endpoint_id, total_connections
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  QueryPerAuthType:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/per-auth-type'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"auth_method":"(?<auth_method>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count() as total_connections by auth_method
        | sort total_connections desc
        | display auth_method, total_connections
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  QueryDistinctUsers:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/distinct-users'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"user_name":"(?<user_name>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count_distinct(user_name) as distinct_users
        | display distinct_users
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/connection-durations'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"connection_duration":(?<connection_duration>\d+)/
        | stats avg(connection_duration) as avg_duration, max(connection_duration) as max_duration, min(connection_duration) as min_duration by endpoint_id
        | sort avg_duration desc
        | display endpoint_id, avg_duration, max_duration, min_duration
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client-vpn-usage'
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - '{"widgets":[{"type":"log","x":0,"y":0,"width":12,"height":9,"properties":{"query":"source ${LogGroupName} | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /\"endpoint_id\":\"(?<endpoint_id>[^\"]+)\"/ | stats count() as total_connections by endpoint_id | sort total_connections desc | display endpoint_id, total_connections","region":"${AWS::Region}","title":"Total Usage Per Endpoint","view":"table"}},{"type":"log","x":12,"y":0,"width":12,"height":9,"properties":{"query":"source ${LogGroupName} | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /\"auth_method\":\"(?<auth_method>[^\"]+)\"/ | stats count() as total_connections by auth_method | sort total_connections desc | display auth_method, total_connections","region":"${AWS::Region}","title":"Usage Per Authentication Type","view":"table"}},{"type":"log","x":0,"y":9,"width":12,"height":9,"properties":{"query":"source ${LogGroupName} | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /\"user_name\":\"(?<user_name>[^\"]+)\"/ | stats count_distinct(user_name) as distinct_users | display distinct_users","region":"${AWS::Region}","title":"Distinct Users","view":"table"}},{"type":"log","x":12,"y":9,"width":12,"height":9,"properties":{"query":"source ${LogGroupName} | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /\"connection_duration\":(?<connection_duration>\\d+)/ | stats avg(connection_duration) as avg_duration, max(connection_duration) as max_duration, min(connection_duration) as min_duration by endpoint_id | sort avg_duration desc | display endpoint_id, avg_duration, max_duration, min_duration","region":"${AWS::Region}","title":"Connection Durations","view":"table"}}]}'
        - LogGroupName: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
Outputs:
  QueryUsagePerEndpointId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for usage per endpoint
    Value: !Ref QueryUsagePerEndpoint
  QueryPerAuthTypeId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for per authentication type
    Value: !Ref QueryPerAuthType
  QueryDistinctUsersId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for distinct users
    Value: !Ref QueryDistinctUsers
  QueryConnectionDurationsId:
    Description: Query Definition ID for connection durations
    Value: !Ref QueryConnectionDurations
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client-vpn-usage'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for AnyCompany Hotel Cognito User Pool with advanced security, custom attributes, groups, OAuth2 client, and domain.'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: 'Environment for the stack (dev, staging, prod).'

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'AnyCompanyHotel-${Environment}-UserPool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:

    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-resource-server'
      Name: !Sub 'AnyCompanyHotel-${Environment}-ResourceServer'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: 'Read access'
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: 'Write access'
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: 'Admin access'

  SPAUserPoolClient:

      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'AnyCompanyHotel-${Environment}-Admin-Client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      SupportedIdentityProviders:

  M2MUserPoolClient:

        - client_credentials

        - !Sub '${ResourceServer}/read'
        - !Sub '${ResourceServer}/write'
        - !Sub '${ResourceServer}/admin'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1

  AdminGroup:

  ManagerGroup:

    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: 'Regional Managers'

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk

Outputs:

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: 'The ARN of the user pool'
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'
  SPAUserPoolClientId:
    Description: 'Client ID for the SPA client'
    Value: !Ref SPAUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SPAUserPoolClientId'
  AdminUserPoolClientId:
    Description: 'Client ID for the admin client'
    Value: !Ref AdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminUserPoolClientId'
  AdminUserPoolClientSecret:
    Description: 'Client secret for the admin client'
    Value: !GetAtt AdminUserPoolClient.ClientSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminUserPoolClientSecret'
  M2MUserPoolClientId:
    Description: 'Client ID for the M2M client'
    Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-M2MUserPoolClientId'
  M2MUserPoolClientSecret:
    Description: 'Client secret for the M2M client'
    Value: !GetAtt M2MUserPoolClient.ClientSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-M2MUserPoolClientSecret'

    Description: 'The domain URL for the user pool'

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomain'
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: 'The resource server identifier'
    Value: !Ref ResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier'
  AdminGroupName:
    Description: 'Admin group name'

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Hospitality Insights prod Cognito user pool with SSO and groups
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name for resource naming
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name for the SSO identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)
  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Login URL for the SSO identity provider
  CustomDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain
  OidcClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: OIDC client ID for SSO (required if SSOProviderName is set)
  OidcClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    NoEcho: true
    Description: OIDC client secret for SSO (required if SSOProviderName is set)
Conditions:
  HasSSO: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
  HasSSOFullConfig: !And
    - Condition: HasSSO
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OidcClientId, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OidcClientSecret, '']]
Resources:
  PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateLastLoginAttribute
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:UpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  PostAuthLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, time
          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {'Name': 'custom:last_login', 'Value': str(int(time.time()))}
                  ]
              )
              return event
  PostAuthLambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool"
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: Number
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "hospitality-insights-${EnvironmentName}-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !If [HasSSO, !Ref SSOProviderName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CustomDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  IdentityProviderSSO:
    Condition: HasSSOFullConfig
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OidcClientId
        client_secret: !Ref OidcClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: openid email
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SSOLoginURL
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the user pool client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Domain of the hosted UI
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
  PostAuthLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for WebSocket API with session management using DynamoDB and Lambda'
Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: WebSocketSessions
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManagementApiAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/api/@connections/*'
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketHandler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          WEBSOCKET_API_ENDPOINT: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/api'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          api_endpoint = os.environ['WEBSOCKET_API_ENDPOINT']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
          apigw_management = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=api_endpoint)

          def handler(event, context):
              route_key = event['requestContext']['routeKey']
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              if route_key == '$connect':
                  # Store connection ID with TTL (e.g., 1 hour)
                  ttl = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()) + 3600
                  table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id, 'ttl': ttl})
                  return {'statusCode': 200}
              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200}
              elif route_key == '$default':
                  # Echo the message back to the client
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  message = body.get('message', '')
                  try:
                      apigw_management.post_to_connection(
                          Data=json.dumps({'message': message}),
                          ConnectionId=connection_id
                      )
                  except apigw_management.exceptions.GoneException:
                      # Connection no longer exists, clean up
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200}
              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 400}
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketSessionApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'
  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LambdaIntegration}'
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: api
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'
Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WebSocket API URL
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/api'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for a basic VPC with a single public subnet, Internet Gateway, route table, and network ACL."
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC (must be a /16 range between 172.18.0.0/16 and 172.23.0.0/16)"
    Type: String
    Default: "172.18.0.0/16"
    AllowedValues:
      - "172.18.0.0/16"
      - "172.19.0.0/16"
      - "172.20.0.0/16"
      - "172.21.0.0/16"
      - "172.22.0.0/16"
      - "172.23.0.0/16"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be one of the allowed /16 CIDR blocks."
Conditions:
  Is17218: !Equals [!Ref VpcCIDR, "172.18.0.0/16"]
  Is17219: !Equals [!Ref VpcCIDR, "172.19.0.0/16"]
  Is17220: !Equals [!Ref VpcCIDR, "172.20.0.0/16"]
  Is17221: !Equals [!Ref VpcCIDR, "172.21.0.0/16"]
  Is17222: !Equals [!Ref VpcCIDR, "172.22.0.0/16"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "TestVPC"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "TestIGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !If
        - Is17218
        - "172.18.0.0/22"
        - !If
          - Is17219
          - "172.19.0.0/22"
          - !If
            - Is17220
            - "172.20.0.0/22"
            - !If
              - Is17221
              - "172.21.0.0/22"
              - !If
                - Is17222
                - "172.22.0.0/22"
                - "172.23.0.0/22"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "PublicSubnet"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "PublicRouteTable"
  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "PublicNetworkAcl"
  InboundTCPRule:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
  InboundUDPRule:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
  OutboundTCPRule:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
  OutboundUDPRule:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: "ID of the public subnet"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: "ID of the Internet Gateway"
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: "ID of the public route table"
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NetworkAclId:
    Description: "ID of the network ACL"
    Value: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
