AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for AWS FIS experiment to block cross-region traffic and pause replication for chaos engineering testing"

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: "The target AWS region to block traffic to"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid AWS region code (e.g., us-west-2)"

  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Duration of the experiment in minutes"
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 120

  ChaosTagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "Tag value for ChaosAllowed tag to filter resources"
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

Resources:
  FISKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment logs"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false

  FISKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: "alias/fis-experiment-logs"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FISKMSKey

  FISLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/fis/chaos-experiments"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FISKMSKey.Arn

  FISRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "AWSFISChaosExperimentRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "fis.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "FISChaosExperimentInlinePolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowFISLogging"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:createlogstream"
                  - "logs:putlogevents"
                  - "logs:describeloggroups"
                  - "logs:describelogstreams"
                Resource: !GetAtt FISLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: "AllowFISDescribeResources"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:describetransitgateways"
                  - "ec2:describesubnets"
                  - "ec2:describeroutetables"
                  - "s3:listallmybuckets"
                  - "s3:getbuckettagging"
                  - "dynamodb:listtables"
                  - "dynamodb:describetable"
                  - "dynamodb:describeglobaltable"
                  - "tag:getresources"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: "AllowFISDisruptTransitGateway"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:disabletransitgatewayroutetablepropagation"
                  - "ec2:deletetransitgatewayroute"
                  - "ec2:disassociatetransitgatewayroutetable"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed": !Ref ChaosTagValue
              - Sid: "AllowFISDisruptRouteTable"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:disassociateroutetable"
                  - "ec2:deleteroute"
                  - "ec2:replaceroute"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed": !Ref ChaosTagValue
              - Sid: "AllowFISPauseS3Replication"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:pausereplication"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed": !Ref ChaosTagValue
              - Sid: "AllowFISPauseDynamoDBReplication"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:updateglobaltable"
                  - "dynamodb:describeglobaltable"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed": !Ref ChaosTagValue
              - Sid: "AllowFISPassRole"
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "iam:passrole"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: ChaosAllowed
          Value: !Ref ChaosTagValue

  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: "Chaos engineering experiment to block cross-region traffic and pause replication"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
      LogConfiguration:
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FISLogGroup.Arn
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: "aws:ec2:transit-gateway"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: "aws:ec2:subnet"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: "aws:s3:bucket"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        DynamoDBTables:
          ResourceType: "aws:dynamodb:table"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
      Actions:
        blockTransitGatewayTraffic:
          ActionId: "aws:ec2:disrupt-transit-gateway-connectivity"
          Description: "Block traffic to target region via transit gateway"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "${ExperimentDuration}M"
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: "TransitGateways"
        blockSubnetTraffic:
          ActionId: "aws:ec2:disrupt-route-table-connectivity"
          Description: "Block traffic to target region via subnet route tables"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "${ExperimentDuration}M"
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Subnets: "Subnets"
        pauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: "aws:s3:pause-replication"
          Description: "Pause S3 cross-region replication"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "${ExperimentDuration}M"
          Targets:
            S3Buckets: "S3Buckets"
        pauseDynamoDBReplication:
          ActionId: "aws:dynamodb:pause-replication"
          Description: "Pause DynamoDB global table replication"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub "${ExperimentDuration}M"
          Targets:
            DynamoDBTables: "DynamoDBTables"

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: "ID of the FIS experiment template"
    Value: !Ref FISExperimentTemplate
  IAMRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role for FIS"
    Value: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch log group"
    Value: !Ref FISLogGroup
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: "ID of the KMS key"
    Value: !Ref FISKMSKey

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow VPC Flow Logs to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-on-eks-flow-log-key

  FlowLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/emr-on-eks-flow-log-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'VPCFlowLogsPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-on-eks-flow-log-role

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::Logs::LogGroup'
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: emr-on-eks-flow-log-group

  VPCFlowLog:

        - Key: Name

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, workflow, recipe, infrastructure, distribution, pipeline, lifecycle policy, and IAM roles.'
Resources:
  CustomComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using WebDownload
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: WebDownload
                name: DownloadChef
                inputs:
                  - name: url
                    value: 'https://packages.chef.io/files/stable/chef/16.10.17/el/7/chef-16.10.17-1.el7.x86_64.rpm'
                  - name: path
                    value: '/tmp/chef.rpm'
              - action: Shell
                name: InstallChef
                inputs:
                  - name: commands
                    value:
                      - 'sudo rpm -i /tmp/chef.rpm'
                      - 'chef-client --version'
  CustomWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Updates SSM agent and builds AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: UpdateSSMAgent
            inputs:
              - name: includeAfterBuild
                value: false
          - name: BuildImage
            action: BuildImage
            inputs:
              - name: image
                value: 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/2024.03.01'
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/2024.03.01'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref CustomComponent
        - ComponentArn: 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for Environment=Dev
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: 1
          ResourceSelection:
            TagValues:
              - Key: Environment
                Value: Dev
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /
  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /
  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /
Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the image pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  CustomComponentArn:

  CustomWorkflowArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom workflow
    Value: !Ref CustomWorkflow
  LifecyclePolicyArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito authentication layer with Lex bot integration"

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "identity pool"
    
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: "OrderFlowers"
    
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    
  LiveChatApiEndpointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Full ARN for execute-api, e.g., 'arn:aws:execute-api:us-east-1:123456789012:api-id'"
    AllowedPattern: "^(arn:(aws[A-Za-z\\-]*?):execute-api:.*:\\d{12}:.*|)$"

Conditions:
  LexV2Mode: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotAliasId, ""]]
    
  ForceLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, "true"]
  
  EnableLiveChat: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, "true"]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LiveChatApiEndpointArn, ""]]

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}"
          ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-authenticated-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-authenticated-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - !If
                - LexV2Mode
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}"
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - EnableLiveChat
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub "${LiveChatApiEndpointArn}/*/*/*"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-unauthenticated-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-unauthenticated-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "lex:PostText"
                  - "lex:PostContent"
                  - "lex:RecognizeText"
                  - "lex:RecognizeUtterance"
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - ForceLogin
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - "lex:PostText"
                    - "lex:PostContent"
                    - "lex:RecognizeText"
                    - "lex:RecognizeUtterance"
                  Resource: "*"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - !If
                - EnableLiveChat
                - !If
                  - ForceLogin
                  - Effect: Deny
                    Action: execute-api:Invoke
                    Resource: !Sub "${LiveChatApiEndpointArn}/*/*/*"
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action: execute-api:Invoke
                    Resource: !Sub "${LiveChatApiEndpointArn}/*/*/*"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: "*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolID:
    Description: "Cognito Identity Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolID"
  UserPoolID:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolID"
  UserPoolClientID:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool Client ID"
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientID"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Authentication infrastructure for customer support system using Amazon Cognito'
Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed callback URLs for the web application client (authorization code grant)
    Default: 'https://example.com/callback'
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed logout URLs for the web application client
    Default: 'https://example.com/logout'
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito domain (used to create domain.auth.region.amazoncognito.com). Must be globally unique within the region.
    Default: 'customersupport-domain'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Domain prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and must start and end with an alphanumeric character'
  LambdaRuntime:
    Type: String
    Description: Runtime for the Lambda function that adds users to the customer group
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.10
      - python3.11
      - python3.12
      - python3.13
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Identifier for the Cognito resource server
    Default: customersupport-api
  ScopeName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the custom read scope
    Default: read
Resources:
  PostConfirmationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoGroupManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminListGroupsForUser
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: CustomerSupport
        - Key: Component
          Value: Authentication
  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: !Ref LambdaRuntime
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']

              logger.info(f'Adding user {username} to customer group in pool {user_pool_id}')

              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName='customer'
                  )
                  logger.info(f'Successfully added {username} to customer group')
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Failed to add user {username} to customer group: {str(e)}')
                  raise

              return event
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: CustomerSupport
        - Key: Component
          Value: Authentication
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${CognitoUserPool}'
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CustomerSupportUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: CustomerSupportAPI
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: !Ref ScopeName
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support data
  CognitoUserPoolClientWeb:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: CustomerSupportWebApp
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - phone
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ScopeName}'
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
  CognitoUserPoolClientM2M:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: CustomerSupportM2M
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ScopeName}'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      GenerateSecret: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
  CognitoUserPoolGroupAdmin:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators with full access to customer support system
      Precedence: 50
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoUserPoolGroupCustomer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers with standard access to customer support system
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/UserPoolId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/WebClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientWeb
      Description: Cognito web application client ID for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/M2MClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientM2M
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/OAuthScope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ScopeName}'
      Description: OAuth scope for customer support API access
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/DiscoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery URL for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/TokenEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth token endpoint for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/AuthorizeEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth authorize endpoint for customer support system
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
  SSMDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/Domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito domain for customer support hosted UI
      Tags:
        Service: CustomerSupport
        Component: Authentication
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
  WebClientId:
    Description: The ID of the web application client
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientWeb
  M2MClientId:
    Description: The ID of the machine-to-machine client
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientM2M

    Description: The custom read scope for the resource server

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: VPC with Public/Private Subnets, Internet Gateway, and NAT Gateways
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    Public1:
      Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
      AZIndex: 0
    Public2:
      Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
      AZIndex: 1
    Private1:
      Cidr: 10.10.10.0/24
      AZIndex: 0
    Private2:
      Cidr: 10.10.11.0/24
      AZIndex: 1
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az2'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Private1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Private2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az2'
  ElasticIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  ElasticIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw-az1'
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw-az2'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1'
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Route 53 hosted zone for prxu.org with Google Workspace, CloudFront aliases, legacy CNAMEs, feed proxy, router, and ACM DNS validation records

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone (e.g., prxu.org)

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment name for the stack

  GoogleVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=CHANGE_ME
    Description: Google Workspace domain verification TXT value

  CloudFrontDovetailCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for dovetail-cdn subdomain

  CloudFrontDovetailCdnStagingDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for dovetail-cdn-staging subdomain

  CloudFrontFeederCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f subdomain (feeder CDN)

  CloudFrontFeederCdnStagingDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f-staging subdomain

  CloudFrontFeederCdnDevelopmentDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f.development subdomain

  CloudFrontAdFilesCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for a subdomain (ad files CDN)

  CloudFrontRyanCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for ryan-cdn subdomain

  LegacyDovetailCdnTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
    Description: Target subdomain for legacy dovetail-cdn CNAME

  LegacyDovetailCdnStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
    Description: Target subdomain for legacy dovetail-cdn-staging CNAME

  LegacyFeederCdnTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: f.prxu.org
    Description: Target subdomain for legacy feeder CDN CNAME

  FeedProxyProductionTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feed-proxy-production.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for authenticated feed proxy production subdomain

  FeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feed-proxy-staging.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for authenticated feed proxy staging subdomain

  RouterProductionTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-production.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for dovetail router production subdomain

  RouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-staging.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for dovetail router staging subdomain

  DnsValidationCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _acme-challenge.validation.com
    Description: Placeholder value for ACM DNS validation CNAME records

Resources:
  # ===================== Route 53 Hosted Zone =====================
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub "Hosted zone for ${DomainName} - ${Environment} environment"

  # ===================== Google Workspace Records =====================
  GoogleVerificationTXTRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleVerificationValue}"'

  GoogleMX1Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."
        - "10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."

  # ===================== Alias A Records for CloudFront =====================
  DovetailCdnAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDovetailCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDovetailCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDovetailCdnStagingDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDovetailCdnStagingDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnStagingDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnStagingDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevelopmentAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f.development.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnDevelopmentDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevelopmentAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "f.development.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontFeederCdnDevelopmentDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  AdFilesCdnAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "a.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontAdFilesCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  AdFilesCdnAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "a.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontAdFilesCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  RyanCdnAliasARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontRyanCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  RyanCdnAliasAAAARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontRyanCdnDnsName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # ===================== Legacy CNAME Records =====================
  LegacyDovetailCdnCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "legacy-dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LegacyDovetailCdnTarget

  LegacyDovetailCdnStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "legacy-dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LegacyDovetailCdnStagingTarget

  LegacyFeederCdnCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "legacy-f.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LegacyFeederCdnTarget

  # ===================== Authenticated Feed Proxy CNAME Records =====================
  FeedProxyProductionCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "feed-proxy-production.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref FeedProxyProductionTarget

  FeedProxyStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "feed-proxy-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref FeedProxyStagingTarget

  # ===================== Dovetail Router CNAME Records =====================
  RouterProductionCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "router-production.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 30
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref RouterProductionTarget

  RouterStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "router-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 30
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref RouterStagingTarget

  # ===================== ACM DNS Validation CNAME Records (Static) =====================
  WildcardDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  DovetailCdnDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  DovetailCdnStagingDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  FeederCdnDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.f.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  FeederCdnStagingDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.f-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  FeederCdnDevelopmentDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.f.development.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  AdFilesCdnDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.a.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

  RyanCdnDnsValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_acme-challenge.ryan-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DnsValidationCnameValue

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route53 Hosted Zone ID
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-HostedZoneId"

  HostedZoneNameServers:
    Description: Name servers for the hosted zone
    Value: !Join [", ", !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Parameters:
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create an Internet Gateway
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create a public subnet
  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create a route table
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to create a security group
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix for naming resources
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
  SourceIPRange:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: IP range allowed for HTTP and HTTPS traffic
Conditions:
  CreateIGW:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateInternetGateway
      - true
  CreateSubnet:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreatePublicSubnet
      - true
  CreateRT:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateRouteTable
      - true
  CreateSG:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateSecurityGroup
      - true
  CreateRouteCondition:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: CreateIGW
      - Condition: CreateRT
  CreateAssociation:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: CreateSubnet
      - Condition: CreateRT
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${NamePrefix}-vpc
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateIGW
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${NamePrefix}-igw
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateIGW
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      InternetGatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateSubnet
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PublicSubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${NamePrefix}-public-subnet
  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateRT
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${NamePrefix}-route-table
  InternetRoute:
    Condition: CreateRouteCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: RouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateAssociation
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: RouteTable
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet
  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateSG
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group allowing HTTP and HTTPS traffic
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp:
            Ref: SourceIPRange
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
        - CidrIp:
            Ref: SourceIPRange
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${NamePrefix}-security-group
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the newly created VPC
    Value:
      Ref: VPC

Description: "CloudFormation template for a landing zone hub VPC with Transit Gateway, VPC endpoints, and flow logs"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "landing-zone"
    Description: "A prefix for naming resources and tagging"
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in first AZ"
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in second AZ"
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.10.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in first AZ"
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.11.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in second AZ"
  PrivateRouteCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: "CIDR for private route to Transit Gateway (spoke traffic)"
  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: "Private ASN for the Transit Gateway"

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnet2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR, ""]]
  HasPrivateSubnet2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR, ""]]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnet2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ElasticIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ElasticIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet2
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet2
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet2
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnet2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref PrivateRouteCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnet2
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref PrivateRouteCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnet2
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !If [HasPrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "The ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-id"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: "Public subnet in first AZ"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id"

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: "Public subnet in second AZ"
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: "Private subnet in first AZ"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: "Private subnet in second AZ"
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnet2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id"

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "The ID of the Transit Gateway"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-id"

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group for VPC flow logs"
    Value: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group"

  SSMEndpointId:
    Description: "VPC Endpoint ID for SSM"
    Value: !Ref SSMEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint-id"

  S3EndpointId:
    Description: "VPC Endpoint ID for S3"
    Value: !Ref S3Endpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint-id"

Description: Student Services Agent Infrastructure - Self-contained Bedrock AgentCore with Cognito OAuth2 and IAM execution roles
Resources:
  BaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Description: Base policy granting Bedrock model invocation, CloudWatch logging/metrics under bedrock-agentcore namespace, X-Ray tracing, and SSM parameter access for student-services path
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:Namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              Fn::Sub: arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount:
                  Ref: AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - Ref: BaseManagedPolicy

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 30
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log Monitoring Controls"
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/cloudtrail/management-events"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail management events"
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "CISBenchmarkKey"
    Description: "Alias for the KMS customer managed key"
  SNSTopicName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CISBenchmarkAlarms"
    Description: "Name of the SNS topic for alarm notifications"
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS topic"
  LogGroupRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: "Retention period for the log group in days"
Conditions:
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, ""]]
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting SNS topic and CloudWatch Logs"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow SNS to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "sns.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
  KMSKeyAliasResource:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${KMSKeyAlias}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Ref SNSTopicName
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSSubscription:
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref SNSTopic
  # Metric Filters and Alarms
  UnauthorizedAPICallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "UnauthorizedAPICalls"
  UnauthorizedAPICallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "UnauthorizedAPICallsAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when unauthorized API calls are detected"
      MetricName: "UnauthorizedAPICalls"
      Namespace: "CISBenchmark"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMFAAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when console sign-in occurs without MFA"
      MetricName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
      Namespace: "CISBenchmark"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "RootAccountUsage"
  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RootAccountUsageAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when root account is used"
      MetricName: "RootAccountUsage"
      Namespace: "CISBenchmark"
      Statistic: Sum
