AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Automated Security Hub deployment across AWS Organization using Control Tower - Event-driven SSM Automation for cross-account enablement, member invitation, and acceptance'
Parameters:
  pAutomationRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: SuperwerkerSecurityHubAutomationRole
    Description: Name for the SSM Automation IAM role
  pEventBridgeRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: SuperwerkerSecurityHubEventBridgeRole
    Description: Name for the EventBridge IAM role
  pSecurityHubSetupDocumentName:
    Type: String
    Default: SuperwerkerSecurityHubSetup
    Description: Name for the SSM Automation document handling initial setup and landing zone updates
  pSecurityHubNewAccountDocumentName:
    Type: String
    Default: SuperwerkerSecurityHubNewAccount
    Description: Name for the SSM Automation document handling new account provisioning
  pParameterStoreAuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: /superwerker/audit_account_id
    Description: Parameter Store path for the audit account ID
  pParameterStoreLogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
    Description: Parameter Store path for the log archive account ID
Resources:
  rAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref pAutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SuperwerkerSecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${pParameterStoreAuditAccountId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${pParameterStoreLogArchiveAccountId}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:UpdateSecurityHubConfiguration
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:ListInvitations
                  - securityhub:DisassociateMembers
                  - securityhub:DeleteMembers
                  - securityhub:BatchEnableStandards
                  - securityhub:BatchDisableStandards
                  - securityhub:GetEnabledStandards
                  - securityhub:DescribeHub
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSSMAutomationRole
  rEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref pEventBridgeRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SuperwerkerSecurityHubEventBridgePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${pSecurityHubSetupDocumentName}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${pSecurityHubNewAccountDocumentName}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
  rSecurityHubSetupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Ref pSecurityHubSetupDocumentName
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Automation to enable Security Hub in the audit account as delegated administrator and in the log archive account, triggered by Control Tower landing zone setup or update events'
        assumeRole: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pAutomationRoleName}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.'
            default: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pAutomationRoleName}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReadAccountIdsFromParameterStore
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                auditParamPath: !Ref pParameterStoreAuditAccountId
                logArchiveParamPath: !Ref pParameterStoreLogArchiveAccountId
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def lambda_handler(payload, context):
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                    audit_response = ssm.get_parameter(Name=payload['auditParamPath'])
                    log_response = ssm.get_parameter(Name=payload['logArchiveParamPath'])
                    return {
                        'AuditAccountId': audit_response['Parameter']['Value'],
                        'LogArchiveAccountId': log_response['Parameter']['Value']
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                Type: String
              - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.LogArchiveAccountId
                Type: String
          - name: RegisterDelegatedAdminInAudit
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                auditAccountId: '{{ ReadAccountIdsFromParameterStore.AuditAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def lambda_handler(payload, context):
                    audit_id = payload['auditAccountId']
                    org = boto3.client('organizations')
                    try:
                        org.register_delegated_administrator(
                            AccountId=audit_id,
                            ServicePrincipal='securityhub.amazonaws.com'
                        )
                    except org.exceptions.AlreadyRegisteredException:
                        pass
                    return {'AuditAccountId': audit_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                Type: String
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAccount
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                auditAccountId: '{{ RegisterDelegatedAdminInAudit.AuditAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def lambda_handler(payload, context):
                    audit_id = payload['auditAccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubSetupAudit'
                    )['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    return {'AuditAccountId': audit_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                Type: String
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInLogArchive
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                logArchiveAccountId: '{{ ReadAccountIdsFromParameterStore.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                def lambda_handler(payload, context):
                    log_id = payload['logArchiveAccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{log_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubSetupLogArchive'
                    )['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    try:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    return {'LogArchiveAccountId': log_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                Selector: $.Payload.LogArchiveAccountId
                Type: String
          - name: CreateAndInviteLogArchiveMember
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                auditAccountId: '{{ RegisterDelegatedAdminInAudit.AuditAccountId }}'
                logArchiveAccountId: '{{ ReadAccountIdsFromParameterStore.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json
                import time
                def lambda_handler(payload, context):
                    audit_id = payload['auditAccountId']
                    log_id = payload['logArchiveAccountId']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    audit_creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubSetupAuditMember'
                    )['Credentials']
                    log_creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{log_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubSetupLogArchiveAccept'
                    )['Credentials']
                    sh_audit = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=audit_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=audit_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=audit_creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    sh_log = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=log_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=log_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=log_creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    try:
                        sh_audit.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_id}])
                    except sh_audit.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    try:
                        sh_audit.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_id])
                    except sh_audit.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        pass
                    time.sleep(2)
                    invitations = sh_log.list_invitations()
                    for inv in invitations.get('Invitations', []):
                        if inv['AccountId'] == log_id:
                            try:
                                sh_log.accept_invitation(InvitationId=inv['InvitationId'], MasterId=inv['MasterId'])
                            except sh_log.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                                pass
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
  rSecurityHubNewAccountDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document

      Targets:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and GuardDuty configuration for EKS deployments
Parameters:

    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for all resource names
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$
  Hash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional hash suffix for naming
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name for bastion role access
    Default: my-eks-bastion-bucket
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of permissions boundary policy
  ActivateResourceTypes:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to activate CloudFormation resource types (may fail if types not available)
Conditions:
  HasHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Hash, '']]
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]
  ShouldActivateTypes: !Equals [!Ref ActivateResourceTypes, 'true']
Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:

  LambdaExecutionRoleReadOnly:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-readonly-${Hash}
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-readonly
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn

  LambdaRoleGetCallerIdentity:

        - HasHash

        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-identity

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn

  EKSNodeGroupDescribeRole:

        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-node-describer

        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-execution

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

      Policies:

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn

  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !If

        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-logging-delivery
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

      Policies:

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups

      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  CodeBuildEKSServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-${Hash}
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECRS3EKS
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:*
                  - s3:*
                  - eks:*
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  CloudFormationExtensionHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-extension-${Hash}
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-extension
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ExtensionHookPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - s3:*
                  - sts:*
                  - iam:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasHash
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-${Hash}
        - !Sub ${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BastionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - eks:*
                  - codebuild:*
                  - codepipeline:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                Resource: '*'
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasPermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

    Condition: ShouldActivateTypes
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      PublisherId: aws-quickstart

      LoggingConfig:

        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      VersionBump: MAJOR
  KubernetesHelmTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    Condition: ShouldActivateTypes
    Properties:

      PublisherId: aws-quickstart
      Type: RESOURCE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
        LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      VersionBump: MAJOR
  EKSClusterTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    Condition: ShouldActivateTypes
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::EKS::Cluster
      PublisherId: aws-quickstart
      Type: RESOURCE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      VersionBump: MAJOR
Outputs:

  LambdaExecutionRoleReadOnlyArn:

  LambdaRoleGetCallerIdentityArn:
    Description: Lambda role ARN for get caller identity
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaRoleGetCallerIdentity.Arn

    Description: EKS node group describer role ARN

  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: CloudFormation execution role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  LoggingDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: Logging delivery role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
  CodeBuildEKSServiceRoleArn:
    Description: CodeBuild/EKS service role ARN

  CloudFormationExtensionHookRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt BastionInstanceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  FIFOQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFifoQueueNoDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn

    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFifoQueueWithDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FIFODLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 3

    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFifoDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: false
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
  StandardQueue:

      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
  StandardQueueNumberOfMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueueNumberOfMessagesSent
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when number of messages sent on standard queue >= 1
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmActions: []
      OKActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
  FIFOQueueWithDLQAverageNumberOfMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: FIFOQueueWithDLQAverageNumberOfMessagesSentAnomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection alarm on average number of messages sent on FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmActions: []
      OKActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1

              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName

            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: AnomalyDetectionBand
          ReturnData: true
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:

      ActionsEnabled: false

      OKActions: []
      InsufficientDataActions: []

      Statistic: Maximum

        - Name: QueueName

      Period: 300

      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  SeparateFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:

  StandardDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Private ROSA networking infrastructure with egress VPC and Transit Gateway"

Parameters:
  RosaVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the ROSA VPC"
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    AllowedValues: [1, 3]
    Description: "Number of Availability Zones for ROSA subnets (1 or 3)"
  RosaSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA subnet in AZ1"
  RosaSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA subnet in AZ2 (only used if NumberOfAZs = 3)"
  RosaSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA subnet in AZ3 (only used if NumberOfAZs = 3)"
  EgressVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the egress VPC"
  EgressPublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the egress public subnet"
  EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the egress private subnet"
  CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to create the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role"
  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs"

Conditions:
  Is3AZs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]
  CreateELBRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateELBServiceLinkedRole, "true"]
  FlowLogsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, "true"]

Resources:
  # VPCs
  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA VPC"

  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress VPC"

  # ROSA Subnets
  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Subnet 1"

  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Subnet 2"

  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Subnet 3"

  # Egress Subnets
  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress Public Subnet"

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress Private Subnet"

  # Internet Gateway and Attachment
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress IGW"

  IGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Elastic IP and NAT Gateway
  EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress NAT Gateway"

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: "disable"
      Description: "Transit Gateway for ROSA and Egress VPCs"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Egress TGW"

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Egress TGW Route Table"

  # TGW Attachments
  TGWAttachmentRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - Is3AZs
          - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
            - !Ref RosaSubnet2
            - !Ref RosaSubnet3
          - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA VPC Attachment"

  TGWAttachmentEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress VPC Attachment"

  # TGW Route Table Associations
  TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentRosa

  TGWRouteTableAssociationEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentEgress

  # TGW Routes - depend on associations
  TGWRouteToRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationEgress
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentRosa

  TGWRouteToDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationEgress
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachmentEgress

  # ROSA VPC Route Tables and Routes
  RosaRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Route Table 1"

  RosaRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Route Table 2"

  RosaRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA Route Table 3"

  RosaSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable1

  RosaSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable2

  RosaSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable3

  RosaRouteToTGW1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa
      - TGWAttachmentRosa
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaRouteToTGW2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: Is3AZs
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa
      - TGWAttachmentRosa
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaRouteToTGW3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: Is3AZs
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationRosa
      - TGWAttachmentRosa
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # Egress VPC Route Tables and Routes
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress Public Route Table"

  EgressPublicRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: IGWAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress Private Route Table"

  EgressPrivateRouteToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteToRosaViaTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TGWRouteTableAssociationEgress
      - TGWAttachmentEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # Flow Logs Resources (conditional)
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "FlowLogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogsLogGroupRosa:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/rosa-vpc"
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogsLogGroupEgress:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/egress-vpc"
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: "VPC"
      TrafficType: "ALL"
      LogDestinationType: "cloud-watch-logs"
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroupRosa
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  FlowLogEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: "VPC"
      TrafficType: "ALL"
      LogDestinationType: "cloud-watch-logs"
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroupEgress
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  # ELB Service-Linked Role (conditional)
  ELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateELBRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: "elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com"
      Description: "Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing"

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: "ROSA VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref RosaVPC
  EgressVpcId:
    Description: "Egress VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC
  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Description: "ROSA Subnet 1 ID"
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1
  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Description: "ROSA Subnet 2 ID (only if 3 AZs)"
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet2
  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Description: "ROSA Subnet 3 ID (only if 3 AZs)"
    Condition: Is3AZs
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet3
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: "Egress Public Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: "Egress Private Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: "Internet Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates prerequisite resources and nine SSM Automation documents for PCI DSS remediation."
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "PCI-CloudTrail-Logs"
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: "alias/pci-remediation-key"
  SSMAutomationRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: "SSM-Automation-Role"
  CloudTrailLogsRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CloudTrail-Logs-Role"
Resources:
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 1827
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for PCI DSS remediation"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: "key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
  KmsKeyAliasResource:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsKeyAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "ssm.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess"
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
  CloudTrailLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref CloudTrailLogsRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CloudTrailLogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource: "*"
  DocEncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: "String"
            description: "Name of the CloudTrail trail to update."
          KmsKeyId:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN or ID of the KMS key."
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group."
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail to write logs."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "cloudtrail"
              Api: "UpdateTrail"
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              KmsKeyId: "{{ KmsKeyId }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
  DocEnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable key rotation for a specified KMS key."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN or ID of the KMS key."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "EnableKeyRotation"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "kms"
              Api: "EnableKeyRotation"
              KeyId: "{{ KeyId }}"
  DocIntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: "String"
            description: "Name of the CloudTrail trail to update."
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group."
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail to write logs."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "cloudtrail"
              Api: "UpdateTrail"
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
  DocUpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Update IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS requirements."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdatePasswordPolicy"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "iam"
              Api: "UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy"
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
  DocEnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable log file validation and multi-region for a CloudTrail trail, and integrate with CloudWatch."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: "String"
            description: "Name of the CloudTrail trail to update."
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group."
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail to write logs."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "UpdateTrail"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "cloudtrail"
              Api: "UpdateTrail"
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
  DocRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security group."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: "String"
            description: "ID of the default security group."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "RevokeRules"
            action: "aws:executeScript"
            inputs:
              Runtime: "python3.10"
              Handler: "revoke_rules"
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def revoke_rules(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    if sg['IpPermissions']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                    if sg['IpPermissionsEgress']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {'Success': True}
  DocDeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Delete a specified security group."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: "String"
            description: "ID of the security group to delete."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "DeleteSecurityGroup"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "ec2"
              Api: "DeleteSecurityGroup"
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
  DocReleaseElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Release an unused Elastic IP address."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: "String"
            description: "Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "ReleaseAddress"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: "ec2"
              Api: "ReleaseAddress"
              AllocationId: "{{ AllocationId }}"
  DocRemoveCodeBuildEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables from a CodeBuild project."
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: "String"
            description: "Name of the CodeBuild project."
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: "String"
            description: "ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions."
        mainSteps:
          - name: "RemoveEnvVars"
            action: "aws:executeScript"
            inputs:
              Runtime: "python3.10"
              Handler: "remove_env_vars"
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: "{{ ProjectName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def remove_env_vars(events, context):
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    project = response['projects'][0]
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    filtered_vars = [v for v in env_vars if v['name'] not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')]
                    if len(filtered_vars) != len(env_vars):
                        env['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
                        codebuild.update_project(name=project_name, environment=env)
                    return {'Success': True}
Outputs:
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: "ARN of the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group"
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupArn"
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: "KMS key ID"
    Value: !Ref KmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId"
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: "KMS key alias name"
    Value: !Ref KmsKeyAliasResource
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAliasName"
  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role for SSM automations"
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SSMAutomationRoleArn"
  CloudTrailLogsRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration"
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogsRoleArn"
  DocEncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatchName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to encrypt and integrate CloudTrail"
    Value: !Ref DocEncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocEncryptCloudTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch"
  DocEnableKMSKeyRotationName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to enable KMS key rotation"
    Value: !Ref DocEnableKMSKeyRotation
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocEnableKMSKeyRotation"
  DocIntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to integrate CloudTrail with CloudWatch"
    Value: !Ref DocIntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocIntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch"
  DocUpdateIAMPasswordPolicyName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to update IAM password policy"
    Value: !Ref DocUpdateIAMPasswordPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocUpdateIAMPasswordPolicy"
  DocEnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegionName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to enable log file validation and multi-region"
    Value: !Ref DocEnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocEnableLogFileValidationAndMultiRegion"
  DocRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to revoke default security group rules"
    Value: !Ref DocRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DocRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules"
  DocDeleteSecurityGroupName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM document to delete a security group"
    Value: !Ref DocDeleteSecurityGroup
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CDK Bootstrap Environment - Creates encrypted S3 bucket, immutable ECR repository, KMS key, IAM roles, and SSM parameter for CDK application deployment"

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Description: "Short qualifier string to uniquely identify stack components in the same AWS account and region"
    Default: "cdk-toolkit"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be alphanumeric lowercase with hyphens, max 32 characters"

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: "Version of the bootstrap stack to track in SSM parameter"
    Default: "1"

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional custom name for the file assets S3 bucket. If not provided, a name will be auto-generated"
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9.-]{3,63}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: "Alias for the KMS key used for bucket encryption"
    Default: "cdk-bootstrap"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9/_+=,.@-]{1,256}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid KMS alias"

  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional existing KMS key ID, ARN, or alias to use for S3 bucket encryption"
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-f0-9-]{36,}|^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-f0-9-]{36,}|^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_+=,.@-]+|^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_+=,.@-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid KMS key identifier or empty"

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "List of trusted AWS account IDs that can assume the created IAM roles"
    Default: ""

  FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Optional managed policy ARNs to attach to the file publishing role"
    Default: ""

  ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Optional managed policy ARNs to attach to the image publishing role"
    Default: ""

  AccountLookupManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Optional managed policy ARNs to attach to the account lookup role"
    Default: ""

  DeploymentActionManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Optional managed policy ARNs to attach to the deployment action role"
    Default: ""

  CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: "Optional managed policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role"
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  UseExistingKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]]
  CreateKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]
  CreateCustomBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, ""]]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  AttachFilePublishingPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns], ""]]
  AttachImagePublishingPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns], ""]]
  AttachAccountLookupPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref AccountLookupManagedPolicyArns], ""]]
  AttachDeploymentActionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref DeploymentActionManagedPolicyArns], ""]]
  AttachCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns], ""]]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap environment - ${Qualifier}"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${KmsKeyAlias}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - CreateCustomBucket
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub "${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - UseExistingKmsKey
                - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                - !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DenyInsecureConnections"
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"

  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-container-assets"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images older than 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  BootstrapVersionParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap version for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      Tags:
        "cdk-bootstrap": !Ref Qualifier

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Path: "/"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-file-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${ExistingKmsKeyId}"
                  - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - AttachFilePublishingPolicies
        - !Ref FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Path: "/"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-image-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                Resource: "*"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - AttachImagePublishingPolicies
        - !Ref ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  AccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - !If

              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Path: "/"

                Resource: "*"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - AttachAccountLookupPolicies

      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment support. Creates a blue environment with optional new application or references existing application. Supports sample application deployment from default S3 bucket (region appended) or custom bucket."

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Set to true to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application; false to use an existing application."

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "DefaultApp"
    Description: "Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application. If CreateNewApplication is true, this will be the new application name; otherwise, it must reference an existing application."

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "DefaultEnv"
    Description: "Name of the Elastic Beanstalk environment (blue environment)."

  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.8.0 running Node.js 14"
    Description: "Solution stack name for the Elastic Beanstalk environment. Use a modern supported stack."

  UseDefaultBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Set to true to use the default Elastic Beanstalk sample application bucket (region appended); false to provide a custom bucket."

  SampleAppBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-sample-bucket"
    AllowedPattern: "^(?![.\\-])(?!.*\\.\\.)(?!.*\\-\\.)(?!.*\\.\\-)[a-z0-9.\\-]{3,63}(?<![.\\-])$"
    Description: "S3 bucket name for the sample application. Required if UseDefaultBucket is false. Must be a valid S3 bucket name."

  SampleAppKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "nodejs-example.zip"
    Description: "S3 key for the sample application zip file. Default uses a Node.js sample; change to php-example.zip or others as needed."

Conditions:
  IsCreateNewApplication: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, "true"]
  IsUseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref UseDefaultBucket, "true"]

Resources:
  # IAM Service Role for Elastic Beanstalk
  ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "S3AccessForSampleBucket"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "s3:GetObject"
                Resource: !If
                  - IsUseDefaultBucket
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}/${SampleAppKey}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${SampleAppBucket}/${SampleAppKey}"
      Path: "/"

  # IAM Instance Profile for EC2 instances
  ElasticBeanstalkInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
      Path: "/"

  # Application (created only if CreateNewApplication is true)
  Application:
    Condition: IsCreateNewApplication
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: "Application for blue-green deployment"

  # Application Version (always created, references either new or existing application)
  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - IsCreateNewApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - IsUseDefaultBucket
          - !Sub "elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}"
          - !Ref SampleAppBucket
        S3Key: !Ref SampleAppKey
      Description: "Sample application version for blue environment"

  # Elastic Beanstalk Environment (blue)
  Environment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - IsCreateNewApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: "aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration"
          OptionName: "IamInstanceProfile"
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: "aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment"
          OptionName: "ServiceRole"
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: "EnvironmentType"
          Value: "blue"

Outputs:
  EnvironmentURL:
    Description: "URL of the Elastic Beanstalk environment (blue)"
    Value: !GetAtt Environment.EndpointURL
  ApplicationName:
    Description: "Elastic Beanstalk application name"
    Value: !Ref ApplicationName
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: "Elastic Beanstalk environment name"
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
