AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Description: Environment type for the VPC (staging or production)
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
  NatGatewayEnabled:
    Description: Whether to create a NAT Gateway for private subnets
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: "10.0.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnetCidr1: "10.0.0.0/20"
      PublicSubnetCidr2: "10.0.16.0/20"
      PublicSubnetCidr3: "10.0.32.0/20"
      PrivateSubnetCidr1: "10.0.48.0/20"
      PrivateSubnetCidr2: "10.0.64.0/20"
      DomainName: "staging.example.com"
    production:
      VpcCidr: "172.16.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnetCidr1: "172.16.0.0/20"
      PublicSubnetCidr2: "172.16.16.0/20"
      PublicSubnetCidr3: "172.16.32.0/20"
      PrivateSubnetCidr1: "172.16.48.0/20"
      PrivateSubnetCidr2: "172.16.64.0/20"
      DomainName: "production.example.com"
Conditions:
  NatEnabled: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayEnabled, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-vpc"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-eigw"
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetCidr1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetCidr2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-2"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnetCidr3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-3"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnetCidr1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnetCidr2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-subnet-2"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-rt"
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-rt"
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-nat-eip"
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-nat-gw"
  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: NatEnabled
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateRouteToEgressOnlyIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-nacl"
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundHTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundSSH:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundVPN:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535
  PublicNetworkAclEntryEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-nacl"
  PrivateNetworkAclEntryInbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
  PrivateNetworkAclEntryOutbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-placement-group"
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-dhcp-options"
  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
    Value: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCidr]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr"
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds"
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"
  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: Private route table ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: "[a-z0-9]+"
    Description: Stage name for API Gateway deployment
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      TableName: !Sub "Movies-${Environment}"
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrud
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  title = body['title']
                  item = body
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if item:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps(item)
                      }
                  else:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 404,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Movie not found'})
                      }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  title = body['title']
                  update_expression = "SET "
                  expression_attribute_values = {}
                  for key, value in body.items():
                      if key != 'title':
                          update_expression += f"{key} = :{key}, "
                          expression_attribute_values[f":{key}"] = value
                  update_expression = update_expression.rstrip(', ')
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values
                  )
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to provision a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona with a scoped IAM execution role. Optionally creates a self-contained VPC and domain when no existing domain ID is provided.'
Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. If provided, the user profile is attached to this domain. Otherwise, a new domain with VPC is created.'
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: 'Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile.'
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: SageMakerExecutionRole-MLOps
    Description: 'Name of the IAM execution role for the user profile.'
Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
Resources:
  VPC:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'SageMakerStudio-VPC-${AWS::StackName}'
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'SageMakerStudio-IGW-${AWS::StackName}'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  Subnet:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'SageMakerStudio-Subnet-${AWS::StackName}'
  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'SageMakerStudio-RT-${AWS::StackName}'
  Route:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'SageMakerStudio-SG-${AWS::StackName}'
  Domain:
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub 'MLOpsDomain-${AWS::StackName}'
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref ExecutionRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerMLOpsPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManagePipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createpipeline
                  - sagemaker:startpipelineexecution
                  - sagemaker:stoppipelineexecution
                  - sagemaker:retrypipelineexecution
                  - sagemaker:updatepipeline
                  - sagemaker:listpipelineexecutions
                  - sagemaker:describepipelineexecution
                  - sagemaker:listpipelines
                  - sagemaker:describepipeline
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createmonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:updatemonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:deletemonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:describemonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:listmonitoringschedules
                  - sagemaker:startmonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:stopmonitoringschedule
                  - sagemaker:createprocessingjob
                  - sagemaker:describeprocessingjob
                  - sagemaker:listprocessingjobs
                  - sagemaker:stopprocessingjob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createmodel
                  - sagemaker:deletemodel
                  - sagemaker:describemodel
                  - sagemaker:listmodels
                  - sagemaker:createmodelpackage
                  - sagemaker:updatemodelpackage
                  - sagemaker:deletemodelpackage
                  - sagemaker:describemodelpackage
                  - sagemaker:listmodelpackages
                  - sagemaker:createmodelpackagegroup
                  - sagemaker:deletemodelpackagegroup
                  - sagemaker:describemodelpackagegroup
                  - sagemaker:listmodelpackagegroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ViewExperiments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:listexperiments
                  - sagemaker:describeexperiment
                  - sagemaker:listtrials
                  - sagemaker:describetrial
                  - sagemaker:listtrialcomponents
                  - sagemaker:describetrialcomponent
                  - sagemaker:listlineagegroups
                  - sagemaker:describelineagegroup
                  - sagemaker:addassociation
                  - sagemaker:deleteassociation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RunJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createtrainingjob
                  - sagemaker:describetrainingjob
                  - sagemaker:listtrainingjobs
                  - sagemaker:stoptrainingjob
                  - sagemaker:createtransformjob
                  - sagemaker:describetransformjob
                  - sagemaker:listtransformjobs
                  - sagemaker:stoptransformjob
                  - sagemaker:createprocessingjob
                  - sagemaker:describeprocessingjob
                  - sagemaker:listprocessingjobs
                  - sagemaker:stopprocessingjob
                  - sagemaker:createhyperparametertuningjob
                  - sagemaker:describehyperparametertuningjob
                  - sagemaker:listhyperparametertuningjobs
                  - sagemaker:stophyperparametertuningjob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createendpoint
                  - sagemaker:updateendpoint
                  - sagemaker:deleteendpoint
                  - sagemaker:describeendpoint
                  - sagemaker:listendpoints
                  - sagemaker:invokeendpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:createapp
                  - sagemaker:deleteapp
                  - sagemaker:describeapp
                  - sagemaker:listapps
                  - sagemaker:createspace
                  - sagemaker:deletespace
                  - sagemaker:describespace
                  - sagemaker:listspaces
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref Domain, !Ref ExistingDomainId]
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !GetAtt UserProfile.UserProfileArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB, JavaScript pipeline resolvers, and real-time subscriptions
Resources:
  TodoDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  AppSyncGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
  AppSyncApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoDynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"
  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoDynamoDBTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
  AppSyncSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: "type Todo {\n  id: ID!\n  name: String\n  description: String\n  owner: String\n  createdAt: String\n  updatedAt: String\n}\n\ninput CreateTodoInput {\n  name: String!\n  description: String\n  owner: String!\n}\n\ninput UpdateTodoInput {\n  id: ID!\n  name: String\n  description: String\n  owner: String\n}\n\ntype Query {\n  getTodo(id: ID!): Todo\n  listTodos: [Todo]\n  listTodosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]\n}\n\ntype Mutation {\n  createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo\n  updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo\n  deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo\n}\n\ntype Subscription {\n  onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: [\"createTodo\"])\n  onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: [\"updateTodo\"])\n  onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: [\"deleteTodo\"])\n}\n\nschema {\n  query: Query\n  mutation: Mutation\n  subscription: Subscription\n}"
  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: createTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  const { input } = ctx.arguments;\n  const id = util.autoId();\n  const now = util.time.nowISO8601();\n  const item = { id, ...input, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now };\n  return { operation: 'PutItem', key: { id: { S: id } }, attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item) };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: updateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  const { input } = ctx.arguments;\n  const now = util.time.nowISO8601();\n  const updates = {};\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {\n    if (key !== 'id' && value !== undefined) {\n      updates[key] = value;\n    }\n  }\n  updates.updatedAt = now;\n  return { operation: 'UpdateItem', key: { id: { S: input.id } }, update: { expression: 'SET #updatedAt = :updatedAt', expressionNames: { '#updatedAt': 'updatedAt' }, expressionValues: { ':updatedAt': { S: now } } } };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: deleteTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return { operation: 'DeleteItem', key: { id: { S: ctx.arguments.id } } };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: getTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return { operation: 'GetItem', key: { id: { S: ctx.arguments.id } } };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: listTodosFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return { operation: 'Scan' };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result.items;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  ListTodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: listTodosByOwnerFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  const { owner } = ctx.arguments;\n  return { operation: 'Query', query: { expression: '#owner = :owner', expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' }, expressionValues: { ':owner': { S: owner } } }, index: 'owner-index' };\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result.items;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - TodoDataSource
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt CreateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt UpdateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt DeleteTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
  ListTodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosByOwnerFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: "export function request(ctx) {\n  return {};\n}\nexport function response(ctx) {\n  return ctx.result;\n}"
    DependsOn:
      - AppSyncSchema
Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The GraphQL endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Description: The API key for authentication
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncApiKey.ApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: CloudFormation template to create composite CloudWatch alarms for a cross-region failover application using existing API Gateway, Lambda functions, and RDS instance.
Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: RemittanceAPI
    Description: The name of the API Gateway API.
  ApiStage:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: The stage name of the API Gateway API.
  ApiMethod:
    Type: String
    Default: ANY
    Description: The HTTP method for the API Gateway resource.
  ApiResource:
    Type: String
    Default: /remittances
    Description: The resource path for the API Gateway API.
  LambdaFunction1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: The name of the first Lambda function.
  LambdaFunction2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: The name of the second Lambda function.
  DBInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: The identifier of the RDS DB instance.
Resources:
  Api4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Api4XXErrorAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when 4XX errors average > 0 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage
        - Name: Method
          Value: !Ref ApiMethod
        - Name: Resource
          Value: !Ref ApiResource
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  Api5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Api5XXErrorAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when 5XX errors average > 1 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage
        - Name: Method
          Value: !Ref ApiMethod
        - Name: Resource
          Value: !Ref ApiResource
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  ApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiLatencyAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when latency average >= 10000 ms over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiStage
        - Name: Method
          Value: !Ref ApiMethod
        - Name: Resource
          Value: !Ref ApiResource
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  LambdaErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaErrorAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Summed errors across both Lambda functions exceed 0
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Errors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref LambdaFunction1Name
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: m2
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Errors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref LambdaFunction2Name
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: e1
          Expression: m1+m2
          Label: SumErrors
          ReturnData: true
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  LambdaInvocationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaInvocationAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Summed invocations across both Lambda functions exceed 2
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Invocations
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref LambdaFunction1Name
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: m2
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Invocations
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref LambdaFunction2Name
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: e1
          Expression: m1+m2
          Label: SumInvocations
          ReturnData: true
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  LambdaDurationAlarmGet:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaDurationAlarmGet
      AlarmDescription: Duration of GetRemittances average >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref LambdaFunction1Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  LambdaDurationAlarmCreate:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaDurationAlarmCreate
      AlarmDescription: Duration of CreateRemittance average >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref LambdaFunction2Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  RDSCPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSCPUAlarm
      AlarmDescription: CPU utilization average >= 70% over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSConnectionsAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Database connections average >= 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSDeadlocksAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Deadlocks average >= 10 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSNetworkTxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSNetworkTxAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Network transmit throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSNetworkRxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSNetworkRxAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Network receive throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSQueriesAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Queries average >= 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Disk queue depth average >= 50 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSReadLatencyAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Read latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDSWriteLatencyAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Write latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  ApiGatewayHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for API Gateway health (OR of 4XX, 5XX, latency)
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(\"${Api4XXErrorAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${Api5XXErrorAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${ApiLatencyAlarm}\")"
  LambdaHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for Lambda health (OR of errors and duration alarms)
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(\"${LambdaErrorAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${LambdaDurationAlarmGet}\") OR ALARM(\"${LambdaDurationAlarmCreate}\")"
  RDSHealthComposite:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Health"
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm for RDS health (OR of all individual RDS alarms)
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(\"${RDSCPUAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSConnectionsAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSDeadlocksAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSNetworkTxAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSNetworkRxAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSQueriesAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSReadLatencyAlarm}\") OR ALARM(\"${RDSWriteLatencyAlarm}\")"
Outputs:
  CompositeAlarmArns:
    Description: ARNs of the composite alarms
    Value: !Sub
      - "API Gateway Health: ${ApiGatewayHealthComposite}, Lambda Health: ${LambdaHealthComposite}, RDS Health: ${RDSHealthComposite}"
      - {}
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CompositeAlarmArns"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "your-script-bucket"
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket containing Glue job scripts. Update this to your actual bucket name.
  ScriptPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "glue-scripts/"
    Description: Prefix path for scripts within the script bucket
Resources:
  AdminS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
  AdminS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AdminS3Bucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AdminS3Bucket}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
  MainIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:DeleteJob
                  - glue:CreateTrigger
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:UpdateTrigger
                  - glue:DeleteTrigger
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AdminS3Bucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AdminS3Bucket}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*"
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}assets_access.py"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}assets_metadata.py"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}folder_assets.py"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}q_metadata.py"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}q_access.py"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}ds_properties.py"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: "G.1X"
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPathPrefix}datasource_properties.py"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: "G.1X"
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Ref AdminS3Bucket
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties
      StartOnCreation: true
  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties
      StartOnCreation: true
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub "admin-suite-firehose-ingestion-${AWS::AccountId}"
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quickSightMetrics/ingestion/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamVisualization:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub "admin-suite-firehose-visualization-${AWS::AccountId}"
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quickSightMetrics/visualization/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamSPICE:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub "admin-suite-firehose-spice-${AWS::AccountId}"
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quickSightMetrics/spice/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub "admin-suite-firehose-quickindex-${AWS::AccountId}"
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quickSightMetrics/quickIndex/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
  FirehoseDeliveryStreamActions:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub "admin-suite-firehose-actions-${AWS::AccountId}"
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quickSightMetrics/actions/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "admin-suite-metricstream-ingestion-${AWS::AccountId}"
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryStreamIngestion.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MainIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount
  MetricStreamVisualization:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for a serverless CRUD API for Kitten service using API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB.'
Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenCrudFunction
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              http_method = event['httpMethod']
              path = event['path']
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              
              headers = {
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'
              }
              
              try:
                  if http_method == 'OPTIONS':
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': ''
                      }
                  
                  if http_method == 'POST' and path == '/kitten':
                      kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing name or color'})
                          }
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color,
                          'createdAt': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 201,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(item)
                      }
                  
                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path == '/kitten':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(items)
                      }
                  
                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(response['Item'])
                      }
                  
                  elif http_method == 'PUT' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing name or color'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      table.update_item(
                          Key={'KittenId': kitten_id},
                          UpdateExpression='SET #name = :name, #color = :color',
                          ExpressionAttributeNames={'#name': 'name', '#color': 'color'},
                          ExpressionAttributeValues={':name': name, ':color': color}
                      )
                      updated_item = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})['Item']
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(updated_item)
                      }
                  
                  elif http_method == 'DELETE' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Kitten deleted'})
                      }
                  
                  else:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Unsupported operation'})
                      }
              
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': headers,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: API for CRUD operations on Kittens
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  ApiGatewayResourceKitten:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten
  ApiGatewayResourceKittenId:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource

      PathPart: '{id}'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenOptions:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:

      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKitten
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenPost:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKitten
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKitten
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenIdOptions:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKittenId
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenIdGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKittenId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenIdPut:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKittenId
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ApiGatewayMethodKittenIdDelete:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceKittenId
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
