AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Step Functions state machine with version, alias, and multiple event-driven triggers"

Parameters:
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyStateMachine
    Description: Name for the Step Functions state machine

Resources:
  # Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "StartAt": "PassState",
          "States": {
            "PassState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": 1,
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      StateMachineType: STANDARD

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # State Machine Version
  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine

  # State Machine Alias
  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: prod
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # IAM Role for API Gateway
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${StateMachineName}-api"
      Description: API to start Step Functions execution

  ApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  ApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "{}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: prod

  # EventBridge Rule for terminated state changes
  EventRuleTerminated:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - SUCCEEDED
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
            - ABORTED
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRoleTerminated.Arn

  EventRoleTerminated:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # EventBridge Scheduled Rule (disabled, every minute)
  EventRuleScheduled:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRoleScheduled.Arn

  EventRoleScheduled:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # EventBridge Rule for tag events
  EventRuleTagEvents:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRoleTagEvents.Arn

  EventRoleTagEvents:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # EventBridge Scheduler Schedule (every minute, flexible time windows disabled)
  SchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: "{}"

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

Outputs:
  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions alias
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the API Gateway
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/start"

              - iam:DetachRolePolicy

              - iam:ListRolePolicies

              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:ListUpdates
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAccessPolicies
              - eks:DescribePodIdentityAssociation
              - eks:ListPodIdentityAssociations
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
              - eks:DescribeInsight
              - eks:ListInsights
              - eks:ListEksAnywhereSubscriptions
              - eks:DescribeEksAnywhereSubscription
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:ListAliases
            Resource: '*'
      Description: 'Read-only policy for EKS clusters, node groups, and workloads'

  # IAM Roles
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref ControlPlaneRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: CAPA

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref NodesRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: CAPA

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref ControllersRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/id/*'
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                oidc.eks.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/id/*:sub: 'system:serviceaccount:cluster-api-provider-aws:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: CAPA

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref EKSControlPlaneRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: CAPA

  # Instance Profiles
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ControlPlaneRoleName}-InstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NodesRoleName}-InstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ControllersRoleName}-InstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the nodes IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt NodesRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the controllers IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the control plane instance profile
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
  NodesInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the nodes instance profile
    Value: !Ref NodesInstanceProfile
  ControllersInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the controllers instance profile
    Value: !Ref ControllersInstanceProfile
  ReadOnlyPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the read-only EKS policy
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyEKSPolicy.PolicyArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with NAT Gateways, Flow Logs, and VPC Endpoints for ECR and S3'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ2
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ2
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period for flow log CloudWatch Logs
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture
  EndpointSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block allowed for outbound HTTPS from endpoint SG (VPC CIDR)

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NATEIP1'

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NATEIP2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NATGW1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NATGW2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogs'

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flowlogs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogRole'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLog'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECR interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroupIngress
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSG'

  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ECRDockerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First Availability Zone
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ1'

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second Availability Zone
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ2'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for VPC Endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for KerberosEMRonEKS VPC with Microsoft AD infrastructure support, including subnets, NAT gateways, flow logs, KMS key, and VPC endpoints."

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/26"
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 1"
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.64/26"
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 2"
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.128/26"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 1"
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.192/26"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 2"
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "First availability zone (leave empty to auto-select)"
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Second availability zone (leave empty to auto-select)"

Conditions:
  UseDefaultAz1: !Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone1, ""]
  UseDefaultAz2: !Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone2, ""]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseDefaultAz1, !Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Ref AvailabilityZone1]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseDefaultAz2, !Select [1, !GetAZs ""], !Ref AvailabilityZone2]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseDefaultAz1, !Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Ref AvailabilityZone1]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseDefaultAz2, !Select [1, !GetAZs ""], !Ref AvailabilityZone2]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2"

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP1"

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2"

  PublicRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRouteTable1"

  PublicRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRouteTable2"

  PublicRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable2"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKmsKey"

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogLogGroup"

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "FlowLogPolicy"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for a self-contained SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with a test user profile and dedicated IAM role.'
Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.
    Default: my-ml-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    MaxLength: 63
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the test user profile.
    Default: data-scientist
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    MaxLength: 63
  DefaultS3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name (not ARN) of the default S3 bucket for the domain. Must exist.
    Default: my-sagemaker-artifacts
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional VPC ID. Leave empty to create a new VPC.
    Default: ''
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional comma-separated list of subnet IDs. Leave empty to create new subnets.
    Default: ''
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional comma-separated list of security group IDs. Leave empty to create a new security group.
    Default: ''
Conditions:
  CreateVpc:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref VpcId
      - ''
  CreateSubnets:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref SubnetIds
      - ''
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      - ''
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If [CreateVpc, !Ref VPC, !Ref VpcId]
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If [CreateVpc, !Ref VPC, !Ref VpcId]
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-2'
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Domain
      VpcId: !If [CreateVpc, !Ref VPC, !Ref VpcId]
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-sg'
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CustomS3AndPassRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${DefaultS3BucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${DefaultS3BucketName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${DomainName}-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      VpcId:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateVpc
          - !Ref VPC
          - !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateSubnets
          - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          - Fn::Split:
              - ','
              - !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIdForDomainBoundary:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateSecurityGroup
          - !Ref SecurityGroup
          - Fn::Select:
              - 0
              - Fn::Split:
                  - ','
                  - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName
  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TestUserName
Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: SageMaker Domain ID
    Value: !Ref SageMakerDomain
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain
    Value:
      Fn::Join:
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - '.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region='
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - '#/studio/'
          - !Ref SageMakerDomain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template that creates a comprehensive set of CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for analyzing Claude Code application metrics, scoped to the /aws/claude-code/metrics log group."
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/claude-code/metrics"
    Description: "The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metrics."
Resources:
  QueryTokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "1a - Real-Time: Token and Request Rate Per User"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats count() as request_count, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, avg(tokens_total) as avg_tokens_per_request by user_id
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCurrentTPMAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "1b - Real-Time: Current TPM Averages"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","model":"*","tpm":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats avg(tpm) as avg_tpm, max(tpm) as peak_tpm, count() as sample_count by user_id, model
        | sort avg_tpm desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCurrentRPMAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "1c - Real-Time: Current RPM Averages"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","model":"*","rpm":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats avg(rpm) as avg_rpm, max(rpm) as peak_rpm, count() as sample_count by user_id, model
        | sort avg_rpm desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "1d - Real-Time: Rate-Limit Risk Detection"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","rate_limit_hit":"*","tpm":"*","rpm":"*","*":*}' as *
        | filter rate_limit_hit > 0 or tpm > 80000 or rpm > 4000
        | stats count() as rate_limit_events, max(tpm) as max_tpm, max(rpm) as max_rpm, latest(@timestamp) as last_event by user_id
        | sort rate_limit_events desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "2a - User & Session: Session-Level Usage"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"session_id":"*","user_id":"*","tokens_total":"*","cost_usd":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, count() as request_count, min(@timestamp) as session_start, max(@timestamp) as session_end by session_id, user_id
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "2b - User & Session: Hourly Activity Timeline"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","tokens_total":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats count() as request_count, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, count(distinct user_id) as active_users by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 168
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryErrorThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "2c - User & Session: Error & Throttling Detection"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","status":"*","error_code":"*","*":*}' as *
        | filter status != 200 or error_code != ""
        | stats count() as error_count, latest(error_code) as last_error, latest(@timestamp) as last_occurrence by user_id, status, error_code
        | sort error_count desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryUserActivitySummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "2d - User & Session: User Activity Summary"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","session_id":"*","tokens_total":"*","cost_usd":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats count(distinct session_id) as sessions, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, avg(tokens_total) as avg_tokens_per_request, sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, count() as total_requests, latest(@timestamp) as last_active by user_id
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "3a - Cost & Attribution: Cost by User"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","cost_usd":"*","tokens_total":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, count() as request_count, avg(cost_usd / tokens_total) as avg_cost_per_token by user_id
        | sort total_cost desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "3b - Cost & Attribution: Cost by Model"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"model":"*","cost_usd":"*","tokens_prompt":"*","tokens_completion":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, sum(tokens_prompt) as total_prompt_tokens, sum(tokens_completion) as total_completion_tokens, count() as request_count, avg(cost_usd / (tokens_prompt + tokens_completion)) as avg_cost_per_token by model
        | sort total_cost desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "3c - Cost & Attribution: Cost by Organization"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"org_id":"*","cost_usd":"*","tokens_total":"*","user_id":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, count(distinct user_id) as active_users, count() as request_count by org_id
        | sort total_cost desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4a - Debugging: Model Efficiency"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"model":"*","tokens_prompt":"*","tokens_completion":"*","latency_ms":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats avg(tokens_prompt) as avg_prompt_tokens, avg(tokens_completion) as avg_completion_tokens, avg(tokens_completion / tokens_prompt) as avg_completion_to_prompt_ratio, avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, count() as request_count by model
        | sort avg_latency_ms desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitRateOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4b - Debugging: Cache Hit Rate (Overall)"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"cache_hit":"*","cache_miss":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as total_cache_hits, sum(cache_miss) as total_cache_misses, (sum(cache_hit) / (sum(cache_hit) + sum(cache_miss))) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_percent, count() as total_requests
        | limit 1
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitRateOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4c - Debugging: Cache Hit Rate Over Time"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"cache_hit":"*","cache_miss":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as cache_hits, sum(cache_miss) as cache_misses, (sum(cache_hit) / (sum(cache_hit) + sum(cache_miss))) * 100 as hit_rate_percent by bin(15m)
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 96
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitRateBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4d - Debugging: Cache Hit Rate by Session"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"session_id":"*","cache_hit":"*","cache_miss":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as cache_hits, sum(cache_miss) as cache_misses, (sum(cache_hit) / (sum(cache_hit) + sum(cache_miss))) * 100 as hit_rate_percent, count() as total_requests by session_id
        | sort total_requests desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4e - Debugging: Peak Usage Windows"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"tokens_total":"*","cost_usd":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats count() as request_count, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, count(distinct user_id) as active_users by bin(5m)
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QuerySessionDeepDive:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4f - Debugging: Session Deep-Dive Lookup"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"session_id":"*","*":*}' as *
        | filter session_id = "SESSION_ID_PLACEHOLDER"
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 200
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4g - Debugging: Field Explorer (Discover Available Attributes)"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | limit 10
        | display @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @logGroup
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "4h - Debugging: Daily Usage Summary"
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
        | parse @message '{"*":*,"user_id":"*","tokens_total":"*","cost_usd":"*","model":"*","*":*}' as *
        | stats count() as total_requests, sum(tokens_total) as total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) as total_cost, count(distinct user_id) as unique_users, count(distinct model) as models_used, avg(tokens_total) as avg_tokens_per_request by bin(1d)
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 90
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
Outputs:

    Description: "QueryDefinitionId for 'Token and Request Rate Per User'"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB"
Resources:
  AppSyncApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
      XrayEnabled: false
  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  AppSyncSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"
  AppSyncDataSource1:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource1
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"
  AppSyncDataSource2:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource2
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Select [1, !Split ["/", !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn]]
        AwsRegion: !Select [3, !Split [":", !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn]]
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSource1.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSource2.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
Outputs:
  GraphQLUrl:
    Description: "GraphQL API URL"
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiId:
    Description: "AppSync API ID"
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
  TableName:
    Description: "DynamoDB Table Name"
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First availability zone
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second availability zone
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets across three Availability Zones, with IPv4 and IPv6 support."
Parameters:
  VpcIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyVPC"
    Description: "Identifier for the VPC (used in Name tag)."
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC."
  EnablePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Whether to create public subnets, Internet Gateway, and public route table."
Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref EnablePublicSubnets, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcIdentifier
  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Public-RT"
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Private-RT"
  # Private subnets (always created)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Private-Subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Private-Subnet-2"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Private-Subnet-3"
  # Public subnets (conditional)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Public-Subnet-1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Public-Subnet-2"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn:
      - VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 24]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-Public-Subnet-3"
  # Route table associations for private subnets
  PrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  # Route table associations for public subnets (conditional)
  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !If
      - HasPublicSubnets
      - !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
      - ""
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: cluster-api
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming
  EksOidcProviderArn:
    Type: String

Resources:
  ClusterAPIControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster-api-controller-policy'
      Description: >-
        Broader managed policy for Cluster API Provider for AWS controllers.
        Covers EC2 networking, load balancing, auto scaling, EKS cluster and
        nodegroup management, and service-linked role creation.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
              - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
              - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
              - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:ListInstanceProfileTags
              - iam:TagInstanceProfile
              - iam:UntagInstanceProfile
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
              - iam:TagRole
              - iam:UntagRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:ListImages
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudformation:CreateStack
              - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
              - cloudformation:DeleteStack
              - cloudformation:UpdateStack
              - cloudformation:ListStackResources
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
              - cloudformation:GetTemplate
            Resource: '*'
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-worker-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-worker-node-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-controllers-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                },
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Federated": "${OidcProviderArn}"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                  "Condition": {
                    "StringEquals": {
                      "${OidcProviderArn}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:capas-system:capas-controller-manager"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - OidcProviderArn: !Ref EksOidcProviderArn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-eks-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-bootstrapper-group'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User

      UserName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-bootstrapper-user'
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
  BootstrapperUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref BootstrapperUser
  BootstrapperUserSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-bootstrapper-credentials'
      Description: Bootstrapper user access credentials for the Cluster API environment
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"AccessKeyId":"${AccessKeyId}","SecretAccessKey":"${SecretAccessKey}"}'
        - AccessKeyId: !Ref BootstrapperUserAccessKey
          SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt BootstrapperUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the Kubernetes control plane nodes
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile for the control plane nodes
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the Cluster API controllers
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the Kubernetes worker nodes
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile for the worker nodes
    Value: !Ref WorkerNodeInstanceProfile
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the EKS control plane
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  BootstrapperUserName:
    Description: IAM user name for the bootstrapper identity
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperUser
  BootstrapperAccessKeyId:
    Description: Access key ID for the bootstrapper user
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperUserAccessKey
  BootstrapperSecretAccessKeySecretArn:
