  PrivateSubnetCIDRs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24,10.0.2.0/24,10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR blocks for private subnets (3 subnets)"
  PublicSubnetCIDRs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "10.0.101.0/24,10.0.102.0/24,10.0.103.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR blocks for public subnets (3 subnets)"
  NATGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Description: "NAT Gateway deployment type: Single (cost-effective) or PerAZ (high availability)"
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: "Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs"
Conditions:
  IsPerAZNAT: !Equals [!Ref NATGatewayType, "PerAZ"]
  IsSingleNAT: !Equals [!Ref NATGatewayType, "Single"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref PublicSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref PublicSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref PublicSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDRs]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NATGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGatewayEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1"
  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2"
  NATGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-3"
  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref NATGateway1, !Ref NATGateway]
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNAT
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway3
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2, !Ref PrivateRouteTable1]
  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Ref PrivateRouteTable3, !Ref PrivateRouteTable1]
  VPCFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
  VPCFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
  VPCFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCFlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogsRole.Arn
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-id"
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-ids"
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-ids"
  NATGatewayIds:
    Description: "List of NAT Gateway IDs"
    Value: !If [IsPerAZNAT, !Join [",", [!Ref NATGateway1, !Ref NATGateway2, !Ref NATGateway3]], !Ref NATGateway]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-ids"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application with VPC endpoints for Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets Manager, SSM, KMS, S3, and X-Ray, plus encrypted VPC Flow Logs and dedicated security groups."
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  SubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 1"
  SubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 2"
  SubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 3"
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "alias/flow-logs-key"
    Description: "Alias for the KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ai-customer-support-vpc"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "private-subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "private-subnet-2"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "private-subnet-3"
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "private-route-table"
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
                - "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "flow-logs-kms-key"
  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "FlowLogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "flow-log-role"
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flow-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "flow-log-log-group"
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "vpc-flow-log"
  AgentRuntimeSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for the Agent Runtime component"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "agent-runtime-sg"
  MCPRuntimeSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for the MCP Runtime component"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "mcp-runtime-sg"
  LambdaFunctionSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for Lambda functions"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "lambda-function-sg"
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for VPC interface endpoints"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "vpc-endpoint-sg"
  EndpointIngressFromAgentRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSG
  EndpointIngressFromMCPRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSG
  EndpointIngressFromLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaFunctionSG
  AgentRuntimeEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSG
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  MCPRuntimeEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSG
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  LambdaEgressToEndpoints:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaFunctionSG
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
  AgentRuntimeEgressToDNS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSG
      IpProtocol: udp
      FromPort: 53
      ToPort: 53
      CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  MCPRuntimeEgressToDNS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSG
      IpProtocol: udp
      FromPort: 53
      ToPort: 53
      CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  LambdaEgressToDNS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaFunctionSG
      IpProtocol: udp
      FromPort: 53
      ToPort: 53
      CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  BedrockInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  BedrockRuntimeInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  EcrApiInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  EcrDkrInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  LogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  MonitoringInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  DynamoDBInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: false
  RdsDataInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  SecretsManagerInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  SSMInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  KMSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  S3InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: false
  XRayInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "ID of the isolated private VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "IDs of the private subnets"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security group ID for the Agent Runtime"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EKS VPC with public and private subnets across three AZs, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateway, route tables, security groups, and tags.'
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyEKSCluster
    Description: Name used to tag resources (e.g., for load balancer discovery).
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/16$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2.
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 3.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2.
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 3.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-IGW'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  EIPNAT1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-1'
  EIPNAT2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-2'
  EIPNAT3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-3'
  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNAT1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW-1'
  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNAT2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW-2'
  NATGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNAT3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW-3'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-Public-RT'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-Private-RT-1'
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-Private-RT-2'
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-Private-RT-3'
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway3
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  SecurityGroupEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane communication with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10255
          ToPort: 10255
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-EKSControlPlaneSG'
  SecurityGroupApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for application ports exposed to the internet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 30000
          ToPort: 32767
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-AppSG'
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  SecurityGroupEKSControlPlaneId:
    Description: Security Group ID for EKS control plane
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupEKSControlPlane
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EKSControlPlaneSG'
  SecurityGroupAppId:
    Description: Security Group ID for application ports
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupApp
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSG'
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Conditions:
  HasPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, ""]]
  HasEKSClusterName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EKSClusterName, ""]]
  HasVpcId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  HasLifecycleScriptsBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName, ""]]
  HasSecurityGroupIds: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref SecurityGroupIds], ""]]
  HasPrivateSubnetIds: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], ""]]
  CreateRIGResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateRIGResources, "true"]
  EnableGatedAccess: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, "true"]
  HasRIGInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGInputBucketName, ""]]
  HasRIGOutputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGOutputBucketName, ""]]
  CreateRIGPolicy: !And [!Condition CreateRIGResources, !Condition HasRIGInputBucket]
Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Prefix for resource names (e.g., my-hyperpod)
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster (required for eks-auth policy)
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: VPC ID for the SageMaker HyperPod cluster (required for ENI policies)
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of security group IDs (e.g., sg-123,sg-456)
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of private subnet IDs (e.g., subnet-789,subnet-012)
  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for lifecycle scripts
  RIGInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG input (optional)
  RIGOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG output (optional)
  CreateRIGResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Flag to create RIG resources
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Flag to enable gated access
Resources:
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasPrefix
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, "ExecRole"]]
        - "ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:ResourceTag/aws:ec2:source: "network-interface"
        - PolicyName: BroaderENIManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasVpcId
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                    - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                    - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                    - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                    - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  Resource: "*"
                  Condition:
                    StringEquals:
                      ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - HasEKSClusterName
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                  Resource: !Join
                    - ""
                    - - "arn:aws:eks:"
                      - !Ref AWS::Region
                      - ":"
                      - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                      - ":cluster/"
                      - !Ref EKSClusterName
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - !If
                - HasLifecycleScriptsBucketName
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Join
                      - ""
                      - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                        - !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName
                    - !Join
                      - ""
                      - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                        - !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName
                        - "/*"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - CreateRIGPolicy
          - PolicyName: RIGPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: 2012-10-17
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Join
                      - ""
                      - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                        - !Ref RIGInputBucketName
                    - !Join
                      - ""
                      - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                        - !Ref RIGInputBucketName
                        - "/*"
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  Resource: "*"
                  Condition:
                    StringLike:
                      lambda:FunctionName:
                        - "*SageMaker*"
                        - "*sagemaker*"
                - !If
                  - EnableGatedAccess
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                    Resource:
                      - !Join
                        - ""
                        - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                          - !Ref RIGInputBucketName
                          - "/*"
                      - "arn:aws:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*"
                    Condition:
                      StringEquals:
                        s3:DataAccessPointBucket: !Ref RIGInputBucketName
                  - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                - !If
                  - EnableGatedAccess
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - sqs:SendMessage
                      - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                      - sqs:DeleteMessage
                      - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                      - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                    Resource: "arn:aws:sqs:*:*:*"
                    Condition:
                      StringLike:
                        sqs:QueueName:
                          - "*SageMaker*"
                          - "*sagemaker*"
                  - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                - !If
                  - HasRIGOutputBucket
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                      - s3:PutObject
                      - s3:DeleteObject
                    Resource:
                      - !Join
                        - ""
                        - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                          - !Ref RIGOutputBucketName
                      - !Join
                        - ""
                        - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                          - !Ref RIGOutputBucketName
                          - "/*"
                  - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !If
            - HasPrefix
            - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, "ExecRole"]]
            - "ExecRole"
  SubnetPolicies:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasPrivateSubnetIds
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !If
        - HasPrefix
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, "-SubnetPolicy"]]
        - "SubnetPolicy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                ec2:Subnet: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
              StringEquals:
                ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
  SecurityGroupPolicies:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasSecurityGroupIds
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !If
        - HasPrefix
        - !Join ["", [!Ref ResourceNamePrefix, "-SecurityGroupPolicy"]]
        - "SecurityGroupPolicy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                ec2:SecurityGroup: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
              StringEquals:
                ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM execution role
    Value: !Ref ExecutionRole
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

  NatGatewayB:

    Properties:

  NatGatewayC:

    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-1c"
  NetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NetworkAcl"
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.24.24.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet-1a"
  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.24.25.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet-1b"
  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.24.26.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet-1c"
  RouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable-1a"
  RouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable-1b"
  RouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable-1c"
  RouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA
  RouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB
  RouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC
  SubnetRouteTableAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableA
  SubnetRouteTableAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableB
  SubnetRouteTableAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTableC
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTableA
        - !Ref RouteTableB
        - !Ref RouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource: "*"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-S3Endpoint"
Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma separated list of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB, !Ref PrivateSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"
  RouteTableIds:
    Description: "Comma separated list of private route table IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref RouteTableA, !Ref RouteTableB, !Ref RouteTableC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-RouteTableIds"
  SubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: "CIDR block covering all private subnets"
    Value: "10.24.24.0/21"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-SubnetGroupCidr"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for operational personas.'

Resources:
  # Managed Policies
  SystemAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SystemAdminPolicy
      Description: 'Policy for system administrators with near-full access except IAM, requires MFA, denies billing console and logging KMS key tampering.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            NotAction: 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:ResourceTag/Purpose': 'Logging'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IAMAdminPolicy
      Description: 'Policy for IAM administrators with full IAM access, requires MFA, denies billing console and logging KMS key tampering.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:ResourceTag/Purpose': 'Logging'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'

  InstanceOpsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: InstanceOpsPolicy
      Description: 'Policy for instance operations limited to EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling, denies VPC modifications, requires MFA, denies billing console and logging KMS key tampering.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:*'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
              - 'cloudwatch:*'
              - 'autoscaling:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'ec2:CreateVpc'
              - 'ec2:DeleteVpc'
              - 'ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute'
              - 'ec2:CreateSubnet'
              - 'ec2:DeleteSubnet'
              - 'ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute'
              - 'ec2:CreateInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:AttachInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:DetachInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:CreateRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:DeleteRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:CreateRoute'
              - 'ec2:DeleteRoute'
              - 'ec2:ReplaceRoute'
              - 'ec2:CreateNetworkAcl'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl'
              - 'ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry'
              - 'ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry'
              - 'ec2:CreateSecurityGroup'
              - 'ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup'
              - 'ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress'
              - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress'
              - 'ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress'
              - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress'
              - 'ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection'
              - 'ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection'
              - 'ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection'
              - 'ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection'
              - 'ec2:CreateVpnGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteVpnGateway'
              - 'ec2:AttachVpnGateway'
              - 'ec2:DetachVpnGateway'
              - 'ec2:CreateVpnConnection'
              - 'ec2:DeleteVpnConnection'
              - 'ec2:CreateCustomerGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteCustomerGateway'
              - 'ec2:CreateNatGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNatGateway'
              - 'ec2:CreateNetworkInterface'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface'
              - 'ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute'
              - 'ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses'
              - 'ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:ResourceTag/Purpose': 'Logging'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'

  ReadOnlyAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyAdminPolicy
      Description: 'Policy for read-only administrators with broad read access, requires MFA, denies billing console and logging KMS key tampering.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:Describe*'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:Describe*'
              - 'cloudwatch:Describe*'
              - 'cloudwatch:Get*'
              - 'cloudwatch:List*'
              - 'autoscaling:Describe*'
              - 's3:Get*'
              - 's3:List*'
              - 'rds:Describe*'
              - 'dynamodb:Describe*'
              - 'dynamodb:Get*'
              - 'dynamodb:List*'
              - 'lambda:Get*'
              - 'lambda:List*'
              - 'sns:Get*'
              - 'sns:List*'
              - 'sqs:Get*'
              - 'sqs:List*'
              - 'iam:Get*'
              - 'iam:List*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
              - 'kms:List*'
              - 'cloudformation:Describe*'
              - 'cloudformation:Get*'
              - 'cloudformation:List*'
              - 'logs:Describe*'
              - 'logs:Get*'
              - 'logs:List*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:ResourceTag/Purpose': 'Logging'
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'

  ReadOnlyBillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyBillingPolicy
      Description: 'Policy for read-only billing access, no MFA requirement.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:View*'
              - 'aws-portal:Get*'
              - 'billing:Get*'
              - 'billing:List*'
            Resource: '*'

  # IAM Groups
  SystemAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdminGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdminGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOpsGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdminGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyBillingGroup
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # IAM Roles for EC2
  InstanceOpsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOpsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdminRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  # Instance Profiles
  InstanceOpsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOpsInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsRole

  ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminRole

Outputs:
  SystemAdminGroupId:
    Description: 'ID of the System Admin Group'
    Value: !Ref SystemAdminGroup
  IAMAdminGroupId:
    Description: 'ID of the IAM Admin Group'
    Value: !Ref IAMAdminGroup
  InstanceOpsGroupId:
    Description: 'ID of the Instance Operations Group'
    Value: !Ref InstanceOpsGroup
  ReadOnlyAdminGroupId:
    Description: 'ID of the Read-Only Admin Group'
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdminGroup
  ReadOnlyBillingGroupId:
    Description: 'ID of the Read-Only Billing Group'
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyBillingGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with three tiers across three Availability Zones, NAT Gateways per AZ for app and db tiers"

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC (must be a /16)

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web subnets (AZ A, B, C)
  WebSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Web-A"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.2.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Web-B"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.3.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Web-C"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # App subnets
  AppSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.4.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-A"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.5.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-B"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.6.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-C"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # DB subnets
  DbSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.7.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Db-A"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.8.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Db-B"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.9.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Db-C"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # Web route table and associations
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Web-RT"

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs and NAT Gateways
  NatEIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP-A"

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-A"

  NatEIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP-B"

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-B"

  NatEIPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP-C"

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-C"

  # App route tables (one per AZ)
  AppRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-RT-A"

  AppDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  AppSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA

  AppRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-RT-B"

  AppDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  AppSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB

  AppRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-App-RT-C"

  AppDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  AppSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC

  # DB route tables (one per AZ)
  DbRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Db-RT-A"

  DbDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  DbSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA

  DbRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Db-RT-B"

  DbDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  DbSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetB

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Lab VPC with web and app tiers, S3 gateway endpoint, and Kinesis interface endpoints'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC'
  WebSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for Web Subnet 1'
  WebSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for Web Subnet 2'
  AppSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for App Subnet 1'
  AppSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.4.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for App Subnet 2'

Resources:
  LabVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR'
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: 'VPC ID'
    Value: !Ref LabVPC
  WebSubnet1ID:
    Description: 'Web Subnet 1 ID'
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2ID:
    Description: 'Web Subnet 2 ID'
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1ID:
    Description: 'App Subnet 1 ID'
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2ID:
    Description: 'App Subnet 2 ID'
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupID:
    Description: 'Web Security Group ID'
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

    MinLength: 1
    ConstraintDescription: "App must be a non-empty string"
  Env:
    Type: String
    Description: "Target environment name (default 'dev', override as needed)"
    Default: "dev"
    MinLength: 1
    ConstraintDescription: "Env must be a non-empty string"
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Workload name (default 'data-service', override as needed)"
    Default: "data-service"
    MinLength: 1
    ConstraintDescription: "Name must be a non-empty string"

Resources:

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "bs"
          AttributeType: "N"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "bs"
          KeyType: "HASH"

  DynamoDBAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:

              - dynamodb:PutItem
