AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Multi-account Transit Gateway hub and RAM share infrastructure for enterprise network transit'
Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ReferenceFunctions'
    Description: 'Name of the stack containing the TransitGatewayReferenceFunction'
  CompanyName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Camelz'
    Description: 'Company name for tagging'
  SystemName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Prototype'
    Description: 'System name for tagging'
  AccountName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Core'
    Description: 'Account name for tagging'
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Core'
    Description: 'Environment name for Transit Gateway naming'
  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'AWS account ID where the Transit Gateway is created (leave blank for current account)'
  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: 'BGP ASN for the Transit Gateway'
  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Type: String
    Default: 'enable'
    AllowedValues: ['enable', 'disable']
    Description: 'Auto-accept shared attachments'
  DnsSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: 'enable'
    AllowedValues: ['enable', 'disable']
    Description: 'DNS support'
  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: 'enable'
    AllowedValues: ['enable', 'disable']
    Description: 'VPN ECMP support'
  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare'
    Description: 'Name of the RAM resource share'
  Organization:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'AWS Organization ID (e.g., o-xxxxxx) to share with'
  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: 'Allow external principals (used only when no Organization and individual accounts are specified)'
  OrganizationAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Organization AWS account ID'
  JumpstartAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Jumpstart AWS account ID'
  ManagementAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Management AWS account ID'
  LogAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Log AWS account ID'
  RecoveryAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Recovery AWS account ID'
  BuildAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Build AWS account ID'
  CoreAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Core AWS account ID'
  ProductionAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Production AWS account ID'
  StagingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Staging AWS account ID'
  UATAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'UAT AWS account ID'
  QAAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'QA AWS account ID'
  TestingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Testing AWS account ID'
  DevelopmentAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Development AWS account ID'
Conditions:
  IsPrimaryAccount:
    Fn::Or:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, '']
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
  IsSecondaryAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Condition: IsPrimaryAccount
  HasOrganization:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref Organization, '']
  NoOrganization:
    Fn::Equals: [!Ref Organization, '']
  HasOrganizationAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref OrganizationAccount, '']
  HasJumpstartAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref JumpstartAccount, '']
  HasManagementAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref ManagementAccount, '']
  HasLogAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref LogAccount, '']
  HasRecoveryAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref RecoveryAccount, '']
  HasBuildAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref BuildAccount, '']
  HasCoreAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref CoreAccount, '']
  HasProductionAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref ProductionAccount, '']
  HasStagingAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref StagingAccount, '']
  HasUATAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref UATAccount, '']
  HasQAAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref QAAccount, '']
  HasTestingAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref TestingAccount, '']
  HasDevelopmentAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, '']
  HasAnyAccountPart1:
    Fn::Or:
      - Condition: HasOrganizationAccount
      - Condition: HasJumpstartAccount
      - Condition: HasManagementAccount
      - Condition: HasLogAccount
      - Condition: HasRecoveryAccount
      - Condition: HasBuildAccount
      - Condition: HasCoreAccount
      - Condition: HasProductionAccount
      - Condition: HasStagingAccount
      - Condition: HasUATAccount
  HasAnyAccountPart2:
    Fn::Or:
      - Condition: HasQAAccount
      - Condition: HasTestingAccount
      - Condition: HasDevelopmentAccount
  HasAnyAccount:
    Fn::Or:
      - Condition: HasAnyAccountPart1
      - Condition: HasAnyAccountPart2
  AllowExternalPrincipalsParamTrue:
    Fn::Equals: [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, 'true']
  AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue:
    Fn::Or:
      - Condition: AllowExternalPrincipalsParamTrue
      - Fn::And:
          - Condition: NoOrganization
          - Condition: HasAnyAccount
Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Condition: IsPrimaryAccount
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Condition: IsPrimaryAccount
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals:
        Fn::If:
          - AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue
          - true
          - false
      ResourceArns:
        - !GetAtt TransitGateway.TransitGatewayArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Condition: IsPrimaryAccount
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RamAssociationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ram:AssociateResourceShare
                  - ram:DisassociateResourceShare
                  - ram:GetResourceShareAssociations
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  TransitGatewayAssociationFunction:
    Condition: IsPrimaryAccount
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          ram = boto3.client('ram')
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  resource_share_arn = props['ResourceShareArn']
                  principals_string = props.get('Principals', '')
                  # Split and filter out empty strings
                  principals = [p.strip() for p in principals_string.split(',') if p.strip()]
                  if request_type == 'Create' or request_type == 'Update':
                      if principals:
                          ram.associate_resource_share(
                              resourceShareArn=resource_share_arn,
                              principals=principals
                          )
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if principals:
                          ram.disassociate_resource_share(
                              resourceShareArn=resource_share_arn,
                              principals=principals
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})
  RamAssociationCustomResource:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates an IAM user and group for SES SMTP, generates SMTP credentials, and stores them in SSM Parameter Store."
Parameters:
  IAMUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: "The desired IAM username for the SES SMTP user."
  AccessKeyRotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1"
    Description: "Version number to force rotation of the access key and SMTP password."
  LambdaLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "The number of days to retain logs for the Lambda function."
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key to encrypt the SSM parameters. Leave empty to use the default AWS managed key."
Conditions:
  UseCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]]
Resources:
  SESGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${IAMUserName}Group"
  SESPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${IAMUserName}SESSendPolicy"
      Groups:
        - !Ref SESGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: "*"
  SESUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUserName
  SESUserGroupAttachment:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SESGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref SESUser
  SESAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SESUser
    DependsOn: SESUserGroupAttachment
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses-smtp/${IAMUserName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/SmtpCredentialGenerator-${IAMUserName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetentionDays
  SmtpCredentialGenerator:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, hmac, hashlib, base64, json, os, logging
          import cfnresponse
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          def handler(event, context):
            logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
            response_data = {}
            try:
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              username = props['IAMUserName']
              access_key_id = props['AccessKeyId']
              secret_access_key = props['SecretAccessKey']
              kms_key_arn = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')
              param_prefix = '/ses-smtp/' + username
              username_param = param_prefix + '/username'
              password_param = param_prefix + '/password'
              if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                smtp_password = base64.b64encode(
                  hmac.new(secret_access_key.encode('utf-8'), b'SendRawEmail', hashlib.sha256).digest()
                ).decode('utf-8')
                # Store username
                put_kwargs = {
                  'Name': username_param,
                  'Value': access_key_id,
                  'Type': 'SecureString',
                  'Overwrite': True
                }
                if kms_key_arn:
                  put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)
                # Store password
                put_kwargs['Name'] = password_param
                put_kwargs['Value'] = smtp_password
                ssm.put_parameter(**put_kwargs)
                response_data['UsernameParameter'] = username_param
                response_data['PasswordParameter'] = password_param
              elif request_type == 'Delete':
                try:
                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=username_param)
                except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                  pass
                try:
                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=password_param)
                except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                  pass
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data)
            except Exception as e:
              logger.error("Error: %s", str(e))
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, response_data, reason=str(e))
  SmtpCredentials:
    Type: Custom::SmtpCredentialGenerator
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SmtpCredentialGenerator.Arn
      IAMUserName: !Ref IAMUserName
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SESAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SESAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      KmsKeyArn: !If [UseCustomKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]
      RotationVersion: !Ref AccessKeyRotationVersion
Outputs:
  SMTPUsernameParameter:
    Description: "SSM Parameter name for the SMTP username (IAM Access Key ID)"
    Value: !Sub "/ses-smtp/${IAMUserName}/username"
  SMTPPasswordParameter:
    Description: "SSM Parameter name for the SMTP password"
    Value: !Sub "/ses-smtp/${IAMUserName}/password"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for grant-processing job status updates with encrypted Lambda environment variables and encrypted CloudWatch logs

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: The name of the API Gateway stage
  RelatedFunctionRoleArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of IAM role ARNs for related Lambda functions that can decrypt the KMS key used for Lambda environment variables

Conditions:
  HasRelatedRoles: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref RelatedFunctionRoleArns], '']]

Resources:
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda function environment variables
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - HasRelatedRoles
            - Sid: AllowRelatedFunctionsToDecrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref RelatedFunctionRoleArns
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
              Resource: '*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/lambda-env-kms-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  CloudWatchLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting CloudWatch Logs log group used by API Gateway
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  CloudWatchLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cloudwatch-logs-kms-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudWatchLogsKmsKey

  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: WebSocketConnections
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: KMSDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManageConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          API_ENDPOINT: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')
              domain_name = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('domainName')
              stage = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('stage')

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  try:
                      table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error storing connection {connection_id}: {e}")
                      return {'statusCode': 500}
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  try:
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error removing connection {connection_id}: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == 'sendmessage':
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                      message = body.get('message', '')
                      api_client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}")
                      response = table.scan(ProjectionExpression='connectionId')
                      for item in response.get('Items', []):
                          try:
                              api_client.post_to_connection(
                                  ConnectionId=item['connectionId'],
                                  Data=json.dumps({'message': message}).encode('utf-8')
                              )
                          except ClientError as e:
                              if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'GoneException':
                                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': item['connectionId']})
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error in sendmessage: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantStatusWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  WebSocketIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      ConnectionType: INTERNET

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref WebSocketIntegration]]

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref WebSocketIntegration]]

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref WebSocketIntegration]]

  SendMessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: sendmessage
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref WebSocketIntegration]]

  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - SendMessageRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebSocketDeployment
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: true
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 5000
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 10000
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","caller":"$context.identity.caller","user":"$context.identity.user","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
      Tags:
        Name: !Join ['', ['WebSocketStage-', !Ref StageName]]

  ApiGatewayAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${WebSocketApi}
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogsKmsKey.Arn

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

Outputs:
  WebSocketConnectionUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
    Description: WebSocket connection URL (HTTP endpoint)
  WssEndpoint:
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
    Description: Secure WebSocket endpoint URL
  ApiArn:
    Value: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/apis/${WebSocketApi}
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Stripe webhook handler for Squarespace to Slack via SNS"

Parameters:
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: "API token for Squarespace Commerce API. This is a required parameter and must be provided at stack creation."
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    MinLength: 1
    ConstraintDescription: "A non-empty Squarespace API token must be provided."
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: "Stripe webhook signing secret for verifying events. This is a required parameter and must be provided at stack creation."
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    MinLength: 1
    ConstraintDescription: "A non-empty Stripe webhook signing secret must be provided."

Resources:
  WebhookLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebhookPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/webhook-function:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SnsTopic

  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: slack-notifications
      DisplayName: SlackNotifs

  WebhookLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/webhook-function
      RetentionInDays: 7

  WebhookLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: webhook-function
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          STRIPE_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, hmac, hashlib, urllib.request, urllib.error, boto3

          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN = os.environ["SQUARESPACE_TOKEN"]
          STRIPE_SECRET = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET"]
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ["SNS_TOPIC_ARN"]

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              sig_header = event["headers"].get("Stripe-Signature")
              payload = event["body"]
              if not verify_stripe_signature(payload, sig_header):
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": "Invalid signature"}

              data = json.loads(payload)
              if data["type"] == "checkout.session.completed":
                  session = data["data"]["object"]
                  order_id = session.get("metadata", {}).get("squarespace_order_id")
                  if order_id:
                      order = fetch_squarespace_order(order_id)
                      if order:
                          message = format_slack_message(order)
                          publish_sns(message)
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "OK"}

          def verify_stripe_signature(payload, sig_header):
              if not sig_header:
                  return False
              parts = sig_header.split(",")
              timestamp = None
              signatures = []
              for part in parts:
                  k, v = part.split("=", 1)
                  if k == "t":
                      timestamp = v
                  elif k == "v1":
                      signatures.append(v)
              if not timestamp or not signatures:
                  return False
              signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.{payload}"
              expected = hmac.new(STRIPE_SECRET.encode(), signed_payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return hmac.compare_digest(signatures[0], expected)

          def fetch_squarespace_order(order_id):
              url = f"https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/orders/{order_id}"
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {SQUARESPACE_TOKEN}"})
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      return json.loads(resp.read())
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  print(f"Error fetching order {order_id}: {e}")
                  return None

          def format_slack_message(order):
              items = "\n".join([f"{i['quantity']}x {i['productName']}" for i in order.get("lineItems", [])])
              return json.dumps({
                  "text": f"New Squarespace order {order['id']}\nCustomer: {order.get('customerEmail', 'N/A')}\nItems:\n{items}\nTotal: ${order.get('total', 0):.2f}"
              })

          def publish_sns(message):
              sns = boto3.client("sns")
              sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN, Message=message)

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StripeWebhookApi
      Description: API for Stripe webhook to process Squarespace orders

  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookLambda.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses: []

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production deployment

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebhookLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/POST/webhooks"

  WebhookErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: WebhookLambdaErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm if Lambda function encounters any errors
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookLambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: URL of the API Gateway prod stage webhook endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/webhooks"
  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for Slack notifications
    Value: !Ref SnsTopic

Description: 'Self-contained test environment for ElastiCache Redis replication group with cluster mode, Multi-AZ, encryption, SNS topic, and IAM role for SSM Automation signals.'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
  CacheNodeType:
    Type: String
    Default: cache.r5.large
    Description: ElastiCache node type
  EngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '7.0'
    Description: Redis engine version
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'
  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache Redis
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'
  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for ElastiCache Redis
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for ElastiCache and SNS encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow ElastiCache to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:

              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kms'
  SNSTopic:

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sns'
  SNSTopicPolicy:

    Properties:

        - !Ref SNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
  IAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMSendAutomationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-iam-role'
  ReplicationGroup:

    Properties:

      CacheNodeType: !Ref CacheNodeType
      ReplicationGroupDescription: Redis cluster with Multi-AZ and encryption

      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      Port: 6379
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis'
Outputs:

    Value: !Ref VPC

  Subnet2Id:

    Value: !Ref Subnet2

    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup

    Description: IAM role ARN

Description: 'CloudFormation template for AppSync GraphQL API for songs service with DynamoDB and IAM authorization'
Resources:

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id

      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs'

  AppSyncApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-api'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  AppSyncSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }
        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }
        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: '2012-10-17'

        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

  DataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  ValidationFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Name: validateArtist
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {
            "artist": $context.arguments.artist
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if ($context.result.artist == "" || $context.result.artist == $util.toJson(""))
          $util.error("Artist is missing", "ValidationError")
        #elseif (!$util.matches($context.result.artist, "^[A-Za-z]+$"))
          $util.error("Artist must contain only letters", "ValidationError")
        #else
          $util.toJson($context.result)
        #end

  PutSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      Name: putSong
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "name": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($context.arguments.name),
            "artist": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($context.arguments.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Scan",
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($context.arguments.limit, 100)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result.items)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidationFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt PutSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)

Outputs:

Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito User Pool with API Gateway and Lambda"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: "Environment name for the deployment stage"
  PasswordMinLength:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    Description: "Minimum password length for the user pool"
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-user-pool"
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your verification code from MyApp"
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: !Ref PasswordMinLength
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-client"
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  lambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambdaExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  lambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-function"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt lambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod')
              resource = event.get('resource')

              if resource == '/me' and http_method == 'GET':
                  claims = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('authorizer', {}).get('claims', {})
                  response = {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'This is a protected endpoint. You are authenticated.',
                          'claims': claims
                      })
                  }
              elif resource == '/open' and http_method == 'GET':
                  response = {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'This is an open endpoint. No authentication required.',
                          'claims': 'none'
                      })
                  }
              else:
                  response = {
                      'statusCode': 404,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'error': 'Resource not found'
                      })
                  }

              return response
  lambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt lambdaFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*"
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api"
      Description: "REST API secured by Cognito"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  ApiGatewayAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      AuthorizerResultTtlInSeconds: 300
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoAuthorizer"
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Type: COGNITO
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
  ApiGatewayResourceMe:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      PathPart: "me"
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
  ApiGatewayMethodMeGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiGatewayAuthorizer
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceMe
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Integration:
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:ambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${lambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  ApiGatewayResourceOpen:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      PathPart: "open"
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
  ApiGatewayMethodOpenGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceOpen
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Integration:
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:ambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${lambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DeendsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethodMeGet
      - ApiGatewayMethodOpenGet
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayStageProd:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Description: "Prod stage"

        - DataTraceEnabled: false

  CustomResourceLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName:
        Fn::Sub: 'marbot-registration-${AWS::StackName}'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - LambdaExecutionRole
          - Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MARBOT_API_BASE_URL:
            Ref: MarbotApiBaseUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': reason or 'See the details in CloudWatch Log Stream: ' + context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              response_body_json = json.dumps(response_body)
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=response_body_json.encode('utf-8'),
                  headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': str(len(response_body_json))},
                  method='PUT')
              try:
                  urllib.request.urlopen(req)
                  logger.info('CloudFormation response sent successfully.')
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Failed to send CloudFormation response: {str(e)}')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f'Received event: {json.dumps(event)}')
              try:
                  base_url = os.environ.get('MARBOT_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.marbot.io')
                  endpoint_id = event['ResourceProperties']['EndpointId']
                  account_id = event['ResourceProperties']['AccountId']
                  stack_id = event['ResourceProperties']['StackId']
                  role_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['CrossAccountRoleArn']

                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      url = f'{base_url}/v1/register'
                      payload = {
                          'endpointId': endpoint_id,
                          'accountId': account_id,
                          'stackId': stack_id,
                          'region': os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1'),
                          'crossAccountRoleArn': role_arn
                      }
                      data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data,
                          headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          method='POST')
                      try:
                          response = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
                          response_data = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
                          logger.info(f'Registration response: {response_data}')
                          send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Message': 'Registration successful', 'Response': response_data}, physical_resource_id='marbot-registration')
                      except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                          error_body = e.read().decode('utf-8')
                          logger.error(f'Registration HTTP error: {e.code} - {error_body}')
                          send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, reason=f'HTTP error: {e.code}')
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f'Registration error: {str(e)}')
                          send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, reason=f'Error: {str(e)}')
                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id='marbot-registration')
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Handler error: {str(e)}')
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, reason=f'Handler error: {str(e)}')
  CustomResourceRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    Properties:
      ServiceToken:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - CustomResourceLambda
          - Arn
      EndpointId:
        Ref: MarbotEndpointId
      AccountId:
        Ref: AWS::AccountId
      StackId:
        Ref: AWS::StackId
      CrossAccountRoleArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - CrossAccountRole
          - Arn
      Region:
        Ref: AWS::Region

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Glue Data Catalog database, optional crawler, and optional Spark ETL job for data lake catalog and transform layer'
Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used to name all resources
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens
    Default: my-datalake
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing S3 bucket that the crawler scans
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN or empty
    Default: ''
  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix within the source S3 bucket for the crawler to scan
    Default: ''
  CrawlerEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable or disable the Glue crawler
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron schedule for the crawler (default once daily at midnight)
    Default: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
    AllowedPattern: 'cron\([^)]+\)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid cron expression in the format cron(...)
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing S3 bucket for ETL job output (optional)
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN or empty
  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix within the target S3 bucket for ETL job output
    Default: ''
  ETLJobEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable or disable the Glue Spark ETL job
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  ScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 path to the ETL script (e.g., s3://bucket/script.py)
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^s3://[a-z0-9.-]+/.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 path starting with s3:// or empty
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: Worker type for the Glue ETL job
    Default: G.1X
    AllowedValues:
      - Standard
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
      - G.025X
  WorkerCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of workers for the Glue ETL job
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Timeout in minutes for the Glue ETL job
    Default: 2880
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs for the Glue ETL job
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period in days for CloudWatch logs
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
Conditions:
  HasSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']]
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
  HasScriptLocation: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScriptLocation, '']]
  IsCrawlerEnabled: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CrawlerEnabled, 'true']
    - Condition: HasSourceBucket
  IsETLJobEnabled: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref ETLJobEnabled, 'true']
    - Condition: HasSourceBucket
Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Condition: HasSourceBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-database'
        Description: !Sub 'Glue Data Catalog database for ${Environment} environment created by CloudFormation'
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasSourceBucket
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-s3-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                  - !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}*'
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !Sub '${TargetBucketArn}/${TargetBucketPrefix}*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasScriptLocation
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref ScriptLocation
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${SourceBucketArn}'
            Exclusions:
              - '**/_SUCCESS'
              - '**/$folder$'
              - '**/.DS_Store'
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}}}'
      Description: !Sub 'Crawler for ${Environment} environment scanning ${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: IsETLJobEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: IsETLJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref GlueJobLogGroup
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': ''
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--output-path': !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${TargetBucketArn}/${TargetBucketPrefix}'
          - ''
        '--source-path': !Sub 's3://${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
        '--database-name': !Ref GlueDatabase
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref WorkerCount
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      Description: !Sub 'Spark ETL job for ${Environment} environment transforming data from ${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog database
    Value: !If [HasSourceBucket, !Ref GlueDatabase, 'No database created']
  DatabaseArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue Data Catalog database
    Value: !If [HasSourceBucket, !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/${GlueDatabase}', 'No database created']
  CrawlerName:
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler (if enabled)
    Value: !If [IsCrawlerEnabled, !Ref GlueCrawler, 'Crawler not created']
  CrawlerArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue crawler (if enabled)
    Value: !If [IsCrawlerEnabled, !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:crawler/${GlueCrawler}', 'Crawler not created']
  JobName:
    Description: Name of the Glue ETL job (if enabled)
    Value: !If [IsETLJobEnabled, !Ref GlueJob, 'Job not created']
  JobArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue ETL job (if enabled)
    Value: !If [IsETLJobEnabled, !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/${GlueJob}', 'Job not created']
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the crawler and job
    Value: !If [HasSourceBucket, !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn, 'No role created']
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for the ETL job (if enabled)
    Value: !If [IsETLJobEnabled, !Ref GlueJobLogGroup, 'Log group not created']

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "kms:ViaService": !Sub "dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TableName}"

  UserKeyMappingKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-user-key-mapping"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKMSKey

  UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKMSKey
        SSEType: KMS
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: codex-bedrock
        - Key: component
          Value: jwt-middleware
        - Key: managed-by
          Value: cloudformation

  StackRootAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-root-access-policy"
      Description: !Sub "Root IAM access policy for stack ${AWS::StackName} - grants full access to DynamoDB table and KMS key"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable.Arn
              - !Sub "${UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !GetAtt UserKeyMappingKMSKey.Arn
      Roles: []
      Users: []
      Groups: []

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table for user-to-key mapping"
    Value: !Ref UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableName"
  TableARN:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB table for user-to-key mapping"

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              fragment = event.get('fragment', {})
              params = event.get('params', {})
              request_id = event.get('requestId', '')
              policy_type = params.get('PolicyType', '')

              try:
                  if policy_type == 'LogArchive':
                      fragment = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:PutObject",
                                      "s3:ListBucket"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": "*"
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                  elif policy_type == 'CloudTrail':
                      fragment = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:ListBucket",
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": "*"
                              }
                          ]
                      }

                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "success",
                      "fragment": fragment
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "failure",
                      "fragment": fragment,
                      "errorMessage": str(e)
                  }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template to create EventBridge rules for forwarding system, monitoring, and operational events to cross-account organizational event buses. Replace the default ARN parameter values with the actual organizational event bus ARNs before deployment.
Parameters:
  OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the organizational CloudWatch event bus (e.g., arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudwatch)
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudwatch
  OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the organizational CloudFormation event bus (e.g., arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudformation)
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudformation
  OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the organizational CloudTrail event bus (e.g., arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudtrail)
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudtrail
  OrgSlackEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the organizational Slack event bus (e.g., arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-slack)
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-slack
  OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the organizational Auto Scaling event bus (e.g., arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-autoscaling)
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-autoscaling
Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudwatch-alarm-state-change-org-forwarder
      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state changes to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-alarm-state-change
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole
  CloudFormationStatusChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudformation-status-change-org-forwarder
      Description: Forwards CloudFormation resource, stack, stack set, and stack set operation status changes to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudformation
        detail-type:
          - CloudFormation Resource Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Set Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Set Operation Status Change
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-cfn-state-change
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudFormationOrgSinkRole
  CloudTrailRootActivityRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudtrail-root-activity-org-forwarder
      Description: Forwards CloudTrail root user API calls and console sign-ins to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudtrail
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
          - AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail
        detail:
          userIdentity:
            type:
              - Root
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-trail-root-activity
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole
  SlackMessagePayloadRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: slack-message-payload-org-forwarder
      Description: Forwards custom Slack message relay payload events to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - custom.slack
        detail-type:
          - Slack Message Payload
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-slack-message-payload
          Arn: !Ref OrgSlackEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole
  AutoScalingEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: autoscaling-events-org-forwarder
      Description: Forwards EC2 Auto Scaling instance launches, terminations, and instance refresh lifecycle events to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.autoscaling
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance Launch Successful
          - EC2 Instance Launch Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Successful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Refresh Lifecycle Action
      Targets:
        - Id: org-autoscaling-events
          Arn: !Ref OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole
Outputs:
  CloudWatchRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm state change rule
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRule
  CloudFormationRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation status change rule
    Value: !Ref CloudFormationStatusChangeRule
  CloudTrailRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail root activity rule
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailRootActivityRule
  SlackRuleName:
    Description: Name of the Slack message payload rule
    Value: !Ref SlackMessagePayloadRule
  AutoScalingRuleName:
    Description: Name of the Auto Scaling events rule
    Value: !Ref AutoScalingEventsRule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional parent stack name that exports an SNS topic ARN for alerts.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: "ALL-SERVICES"
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL-SERVICES
      - S3-PUBLIC-ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: Service to restrict KMS key usage, or special value S3-PUBLIC-ACCESS for public S3 decryption.
Conditions:
  IsSpecificService: !Not [!Or [!Equals [!Ref Service, "ALL-SERVICES"], !Equals [!Ref Service, "S3-PUBLIC-ACCESS"]]]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, "S3-PUBLIC-ACCESS"]
  IsRegionBasedService: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Service, "importexport"]]
  CreateAlertRule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, ""]]
Mappings:
  ServiceEndpointMap:
    ALL-SERVICES:
      Prefix: ""
    S3-PUBLIC-ACCESS:
      Prefix: ""
    connect:
      Prefix: connect
    dms:
      Prefix: dms
    ssm:
      Prefix: ssm
    ec2:
      Prefix: ec2
    elasticfilesystem:
      Prefix: elasticfilesystem
    es:
      Prefix: es
    kinesis:
      Prefix: kinesis
    kinesisvideo:
      Prefix: kinesisvideo
    lambda:
      Prefix: lambda
    lex:
      Prefix: lex
    redshift:
      Prefix: redshift
    rds:
      Prefix: rds
    secretsmanager:
      Prefix: secretsmanager
    ses:
      Prefix: email
    s3:
      Prefix: s3
    importexport:
      Prefix: importexport
    sqs:
      Prefix: sqs
    workmail:
      Prefix: workmail
    workspaces:
      Prefix: workspaces
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CallerCrypto
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Fn::If:
                - IsSpecificService
                - StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService:
                      Fn::If:
                        - IsRegionBasedService
                        - !Sub
                          - "${Prefix}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
                          - Prefix: !FindInMap [ServiceEndpointMap, !Ref Service, Prefix]
                        - !Sub
                          - "${Prefix}.amazonaws.com"
                          - Prefix: !FindInMap [ServiceEndpointMap, !Ref Service, Prefix]
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - Fn::If:
              - IsS3PublicAccess
              - Sid: PublicS3Decrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Principal: "*"
                Action: "kms:Decrypt"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  EventRule:
    Condition: CreateAlertRule
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
          resources:
            - !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Targets:
        - Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${ParentAlertStack}-TopicArn"
          Id: AlertTopic
Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
  KeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
