AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Enforces S3 Block Public Access at account level using Systems Manager and EventBridge'
Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3BlockPublicAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/S3BlockPublicAccessAutomation'
  SSMAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: S3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Enables S3 Block Public Access at the account level'
        parameters:
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: 'AWS Account ID to apply S3 Block Public Access settings'
            default: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableS3BlockPublicAccess
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            description: 'Calls S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock to enable all block public access settings'
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: 'Scheduled rule to enforce S3 Block Public Access daily'
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(1 day)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/S3BlockPublicAccessAutomation'
          Id: S3BlockPublicAccessTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}"}'
Outputs:
  SSMAutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the SSM Automation document'

  SymbolsRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Require symbols in password policy"
Conditions:
  RequireSymbols: !Equals [!Ref SymbolsRequired, "true"]
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "agentcore-gateway-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbols, true, false]
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Join
        - "-"
        - - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - !Select

            - !Split ["/", !Ref "AWS::StackId"]
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: "agentcore-gateway"
      Name: "AgentCore Gateway Resource Server"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: "Read access"
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: "Write access"
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: "Admin access"
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: "agentcore-gateway-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "agentcore-gateway/read"
        - "agentcore-gateway/write"
        - "agentcore-gateway/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCognitoSecretPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-*"
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.13
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          def handler(event, context):
              response_data = {}
              try:
                  logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                      secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      client_id = event['ResourceProperties']['ClientId']
                      secret_name = event['ResourceProperties']['SecretName']
                      logger.info(f"Describing user pool client: {client_id}")
                      response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, ClientId=client_id)
                      client_secret = response['UserPoolClient']['ClientSecret']
                      secret_value = {
                          'client_id': client_id,
                          'client_secret': client_secret,
                          'user_pool_id': user_pool_id
                      }
                      logger.info(f"Checking secret: {secret_name}")
                      try:
                          secrets.describe_secret(SecretId=secret_name)
                          logger.info("Secret exists, updating")
                          secrets.update_secret(SecretId=secret_name, SecretString=json.dumps(secret_value))
                      except secrets.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          logger.info("Secret does not exist, creating")
                          secrets.create_secret(Name=secret_name, SecretString=json.dumps(secret_value))
                      physical_id = secret_name
                      response_data['SecretName'] = secret_name
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                      secret_name = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', event['ResourceProperties']['SecretName'])
                      logger.info(f"Deleting secret: {secret_name}")
                      try:
                          secrets.delete_secret(SecretId=secret_name, ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True)
                      except secrets.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          logger.info("Secret already deleted")
                      physical_id = event['PhysicalResourceId']
                  logger.info("Sending success response")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physicalResourceId=physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {str(e)}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  TenantApplicationCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Callback URL for the tenant application
    Default: "https://tenant.example.com/callback"
    AllowedPattern: "^https://.*"
  AdminApplicationCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Callback URL for the admin application
    Default: "https://admin.example.com/callback"
    AllowedPattern: "^https://.*"
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the siloed tenant IAM role
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
Resources:
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: "Welcome to the SaaS Operations application. Your username is {username} and temporary password is {####}. Please visit {##tenantappurl##} to sign in."
          EmailSubject: "Your temporary password for SaaS Operations"
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
        EmailSubject: "Verify your email for SaaS Operations"
  PooledTenantAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient

      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref TenantApplicationCallbackHost
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

        - profile

        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH

        - email
        - "custom:tenantId"
        - "custom:userRole"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - "custom:tenantId"
        - "custom:userRole"

      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId

          Mutable: true

          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
        - Name: apiKey

        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:

  OperationsUserPoolDomain:

  SystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:

  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:

        Statement:

            Action:

              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:

                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem

                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/Order"]]

                      - "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:

                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/TenantDetails"]]
                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/TenantStackMapping"]]
                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/Settings"]]
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys":
                      - "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/*"]]

  SiloedTenantRole:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedProductOrderAccess
          PolicyDocument:

            Statement:

                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/Product-${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"]]
                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/Order-${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"]]
              - Effect: Allow

                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:

                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/TenantDetails"]]

                  - !Join ["", ["arn:aws:dynamodb:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":table/Settings"]]
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys":

              - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create a customizable DynamoDB table with optional features including auto scaling, backups, and alarms.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: The partition key attribute name for the DynamoDB table.
    Default: pk
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+'
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: The type of the partition key attribute (S, N, B).
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional table name. If empty, a name is generated.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name. Leave empty if not needed.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: The type of the sort key attribute (S, N, B).
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute name 1.
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for extra attribute 1.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute name 2.
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for extra attribute 2.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute name 3.
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for extra attribute 3.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the first global secondary index.
    Default: GSI1
  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute name for the first GSI. Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''
  GSI1PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for GSI1 partition key.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name for the first GSI.
    Default: ''
  GSI1SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for GSI1 sort key.
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the second global secondary index.
    Default: GSI2
  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute name for the second GSI. Leave empty to skip.
    Default: ''
  GSI2PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for GSI2 partition key.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name for the second GSI.
    Default: ''
  GSI2SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type for GSI2 sort key.
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  TTLAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Description: Attribute name for Time to Live. Leave empty to disable.
    Default: ''
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: Stream view type. Leave empty to disable.
    Default: ''
    AllowedValues:
      - ''
      - NEW_IMAGE
      - OLD_IMAGE
      - NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      - KEYS_ONLY
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Billing mode for the table.
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (only used for PROVISIONED mode).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (only used for PROVISIONED mode).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
  ReadMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum read capacity for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ReadMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum read capacity for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum write capacity for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum write capacity for auto scaling.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Description: Target utilization percentage for auto scaling.
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  SSEEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with AWS managed KMS key.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Backup retention in days. Set to 0 to disable backups.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for CloudWatch alarms and backup vault notifications. Leave empty to disable.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI1SortKey: !And
    - !Condition HasGSI1
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !And
    - !Condition HasGSI2
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, '']]
  HasExtra1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute1Name, '']]
  HasExtra2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute2Name, '']]
  HasExtra3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, '']]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TTLAttributeName, '']]
  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  SSEEnabledCondition: !Equals [!Ref SSEEnabled, 'true']
  CreateBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  HasAlerts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]
  CreateBackupAlerts: !And
    - !Condition CreateBackup
    - !Condition HasAlerts
  PointInTimeRecovery: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI1SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasExtra3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI2SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TTLAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PointInTimeRecovery
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SSESpecification: !If
        - SSEEnabledCondition
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: alias/aws/dynamodb
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - application-autoscaling:*
                Resource: '*'

  ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${DynamoDBTable}
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${DynamoDBTable}
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WriteScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: CreateBackup
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}
      Notifications: !If
        - CreateBackupAlerts
        - BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RESTORE_JOB_STARTED
            - RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED
          SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: CreateBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 ? * * *)
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
      BackupPlanTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateBackup
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:ListBackups
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - backup:*
                Resource: '*'

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: CreateBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${DynamoDBTable}

  ReadThrottlesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottles
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when read throttles exceed 1
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  WriteThrottlesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottles
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when write throttles exceed 1
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when throttled requests exceed 1
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when user errors exceed 1
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when system errors exceed 1
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: The name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TableName
  StreamArn:
    Description: The ARN of the DynamoDB stream, if enabled.
    Condition: HasStream
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-StreamArn

  DxInterfaceTable:

  AccountInfoReadScalableTarget:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for a secure, highly available network foundation for a containerised Streamlit application with ECS cluster."
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 1 in the first Availability Zone."
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 2 in the second Availability Zone."
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 1 in the first Availability Zone."
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 2 in the second Availability Zone."
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitAppVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitAppIGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-PrivateSubnet2
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-PublicRT
  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  EIPNAT1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIPNAT2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNAT1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-NATGW1
  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNAT2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitApp-NATGW2
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless AI Campaign Orchestration Platform'
Parameters:
  EmailSender:
    Type: String
    Default: 'placeholder@example.com'
    Description: 'Notification email address for campaign delivery'
  PhoneNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: '+1234567890'
    Description: 'Messaging phone number identifier for SMS'
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'amazon.titan-text-express-v1'
    Description: 'Amazon Bedrock model ID for generative AI steps'
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'Enable optional OpenSearch Serverless vector collection'
Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']
Resources:
  CampaignKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for encrypting campaign data stores'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
  CampaignKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/campaign-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: 'CustomerProfiles'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: 'CustomerId'
          AttributeType: 'S'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: 'CustomerId'
          KeyType: 'HASH'
      BillingMode: 'PAY_PER_REQUEST'
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: 'KMS'
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: 'ChannelRateLimits'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: 'Channel'
          AttributeType: 'S'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: 'Channel'
          KeyType: 'HASH'
      BillingMode: 'PAY_PER_REQUEST'
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: 'KMS'
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: 'DeliveryTracking'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: 'MessageId'
          AttributeType: 'S'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: 'MessageId'
          KeyType: 'HASH'
      BillingMode: 'PAY_PER_REQUEST'
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: 'KMS'
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'campaign-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'CampaignLambdaPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:GetItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:PutItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:Query'
                  - 'dynamodb:Scan'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignKMSKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'bedrock:InvokeModel'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'states:StartExecution'
                  - 'states:DescribeExecution'
                  - 'states:ListExecutions'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: '*'
  CampaignStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'StateMachineExecutionPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ParseInstruction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SegmentCustomers.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PredictBestChannel.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SafetyCheck.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdaptContent.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliverMessages.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RecordResults.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:GetLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:UpdateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:DeleteLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:ListLogDeliveries'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                Resource: '*'
  ParseInstruction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: 'ParseInstruction'
      Runtime: 'python3.14'
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: 'index.lambda_handler'
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless URL Shortener - Creates a DynamoDB-backed REST API with Lambda functions for creating and retrieving shortened URLs.'

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing URL mappings.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix for Lambda function names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.14
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.14
      - python3.13
      - python3.12
    Description: Python runtime version for Lambda functions.
  ApplicationUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com
    Description: Base URL of the application used to construct shortened links.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: devops
    Description: Owner tag value.

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  URLShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt URLShortenerTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # Create Lambda Function
  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-create"
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import string
          import random
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          app_url = os.environ['APPLICATION_URL']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  long_url = body.get('longUrl')
                  if not long_url:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing longUrl'})
                      }

                  # Generate random short ID of length between 12 and 16
                  length = random.randint(12, 16)
                  characters = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
                  short_id = ''.join(random.choice(characters) for _ in range(length))

                  table.put_item(Item={'shortId': short_id, 'longUrl': long_url})

                  short_url = f"{app_url}/{short_id}"
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'shortUrl': short_url})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref URLShortenerTable
          APPLICATION_URL: !Ref ApplicationUrl
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # Retrieve Lambda Function
  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve"
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  short_id = event['pathParameters']['shortId']
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'shortId': short_id})
                  if 'Item' in response:
                      long_url = response['Item']['longUrl']
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 301,
                          'headers': {'Location': long_url},
                          'body': ''
                      }
                  else:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 404,
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Short URL not found'})
                      }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref URLShortenerTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: url-shortener-api
      Description: REST API for URL shortener
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # API Gateway Resources
  # /create resource
  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: create

  # /admin resource
  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  # /{shortId} resource
  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{shortId}'

  # Methods
  # POST /create
  CreateMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  # GET /admin (simple health check or admin info)
  AdminMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Admin endpoint"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  # GET /{shortId}
  ShortIdMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.shortId: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 301

  # Lambda Permissions for API Gateway
  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/POST/create'

  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/{shortId}'

  # API Gateway Deployment (no StageName to avoid conflict with explicit Stage)
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMethod
      - AdminMethod
      - ShortIdMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  # Explicit Stage resource for test stage
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: test
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: Test stage
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # API Gateway Account Role for CloudWatch Logs
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: URL of the API Gateway endpoint (test stage)
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test'
  CreateFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Create Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn
  RetrieveFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Retrieve Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref URLShortenerTable

  IncidentProcessorLambda:

          import json

      Environment:

  NotifierLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: notifier
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128

      Code:
        ZipFile: |

      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Incident alerting workflow",
          "StartAt": "ParallelNotify",
          "States": {
            "ParallelNotify": {
              "Type": "Parallel",
              "Branches": [
                {
                  "StartAt": "NotifyImmediate",
                  "States": {
                    "NotifyImmediate": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "${NotifierLambda.Arn}",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "type": "immediate",
                        "incident": {
                          "incidentId.$": "$.incidentId",
                          "teamId.$": "$.teamId",
                          "description.$": "$.description"
                        }
                      },
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "States.TaskFailed"],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 3,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }

                      "End": true
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "StartAt": "WaitFiveMinutes",
                  "States": {
                    "WaitFiveMinutes": {

                      "Seconds": 300,
                      "Next": "NotifyEscalation"

                    "NotifyEscalation": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "${NotifierLambda.Arn}",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "type": "escalation",
                        "incident": {
                          "incidentId.$": "$.incidentId",
                          "teamId.$": "$.teamId",
                          "description.$": "$.description"
                        }
                      },
                      "Retry": [

                          "ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "States.TaskFailed"],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 3,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }
                      ],
                      "End": true
                    }
                  }
                }
              ],
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  IncidentApiStage:

    Properties:

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/apigateway/incident-api-access-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7
  IncidentApiLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission

      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${IncidentApi}/*"
  SenderEmailParameter:

    Properties:

      Description: SES sender email address
  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Description: Base URL of the incident API
Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Config Conformance Pack for CloudWatch operational best practices, including five AWS managed Config rules for CloudWatch alarms and log group encryption. Sets up required Config recorder and delivery channel if not already present.
Parameters:
  AlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms require at least one action for the ALARM state (true/false).
  InsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms require at least one action for the INSUFFICIENT_DATA state (true/false).
  OkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms require at least one action for the OK state (true/false).
  AlarmActionsEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarm actions should be enabled (true/false).
  MetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: CPUUtilization
    Description: Metric name for the alarm resource check (e.g., CPUUtilization).
  ResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Description: Resource type for the alarm resource check (e.g., AWS::EC2::Instance).
  LogGroupKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: NOT_SET
    Description: Optional KMS key ID for CloudWatch log group encryption check. Set to NOT_SET to only verify encryption is enabled.
  AlarmSettingsMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: CPUUtilization
    Description: Metric name for the alarm settings check (e.g., CPUUtilization).
  AlarmSettingsNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: AWS/EC2
    Description: Namespace for the alarm settings check (e.g., AWS/EC2).
  AlarmSettingsPeriod:
    Type: String
    Default: '300'
    Description: Period in seconds for the alarm settings check (e.g., 300).
  AlarmSettingsStatistic:
    Type: String
    Default: Average
    Description: Statistic for the alarm settings check (e.g., Average, Sum).
  AlarmSettingsThreshold:
    Type: String
    Default: '80'
    Description: Threshold value for the alarm settings check (e.g., 80).
  AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator:
    Type: String
    Default: GreaterThanThreshold
    Description: Comparison operator for the alarm settings check (e.g., GreaterThanThreshold).
  AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: String
    Default: '2'
    Description: Number of evaluation periods for the alarm settings check (e.g., 2).
  DeliveryBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing S3 bucket name for Config delivery. Leave empty to create a new bucket.
Conditions:
  CreateDeliveryBucket: !Equals [!Ref DeliveryBucketName, '']
Resources:
  ConfigServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: config.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for AWS Config
  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateDeliveryBucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy

        Statement:

              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:

      Name: default
      S3BucketName: !If [CreateDeliveryBucket, !Ref ConfigBucket, !Ref DeliveryBucketName]
  CloudWatchConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: cloudwatch-operational-best-practices
      ConformancePackInputParameters:
        - ParameterName: AlarmActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmActionRequired
        - ParameterName: InsufficientDataActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired
        - ParameterName: OkActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref OkActionRequired
        - ParameterName: MetricName
          ParameterValue: !Ref MetricName
        - ParameterName: ResourceType
          ParameterValue: !Ref ResourceType
        - ParameterName: LogGroupKmsKeyId

        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsMetricName

        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsNamespace
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsNamespace
        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsPeriod
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsPeriod
        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsStatistic
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsStatistic
        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsThreshold
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsThreshold
        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator
        - ParameterName: AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods
      TemplateBody: |
        AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
        Description: Conformance pack template for CloudWatch operational best practices rules
        Parameters:
          AlarmActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'true'
          InsufficientDataActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'true'
          OkActionRequired:
            Type: String
            Default: 'false'
          MetricName:
            Type: String
            Default: CPUUtilization
          ResourceType:
            Type: String
            Default: AWS::EC2::Instance
          LogGroupKmsKeyId:
            Type: String
            Default: NOT_SET
          AlarmSettingsMetricName:
            Type: String
            Default: CPUUtilization
          AlarmSettingsNamespace:
            Type: String
            Default: AWS/EC2
          AlarmSettingsPeriod:
            Type: String
            Default: '300'
          AlarmSettingsStatistic:
            Type: String
            Default: Average
          AlarmSettingsThreshold:
            Type: String
            Default: '80'
          AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator:
            Type: String
            Default: GreaterThanThreshold
          AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods:
            Type: String
            Default: '2'
        Conditions:
          HasLogGroupKmsKeyId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogGroupKmsKeyId, 'NOT_SET']]
        Resources:
          CloudWatchAlarmActionCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarms have at least one action configured for the specified alarm states.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              InputParameters:
                alarmActionRequired: !Ref AlarmActionRequired
                insufficientDataActionRequired: !Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired
                okActionRequired: !Ref OkActionRequired
          CloudWatchAlarmActionEnabledCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-enabled-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarm actions are enabled.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
          CloudWatchAlarmResourceCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-resource-check
              Description: Checks whether a CloudWatch alarm exists for the specified metric and resource type.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              InputParameters:
                metricName: !Ref MetricName
                resourceType: !Ref ResourceType
          CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-settings-check
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarms have the specified settings for the given metric.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                  - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              InputParameters:
                metricName: !Ref AlarmSettingsMetricName
                namespace: !Ref AlarmSettingsNamespace
                period: !Ref AlarmSettingsPeriod
                statistic: !Ref AlarmSettingsStatistic
                threshold: !Ref AlarmSettingsThreshold
                comparisonOperator: !Ref AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator
                evaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods
          CloudWatchLogGroupEncrypted:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-log-group-encrypted
              Description: Checks whether CloudWatch log groups are encrypted.
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED
              InputParameters:
                kmsKeyId: !If [HasLogGroupKmsKeyId, !Ref LogGroupKmsKeyId, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
Outputs:
  ConformancePackName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch operational best practices conformance pack
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchConformancePack
  ConfigBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket used for Config delivery
    Value: !If [CreateDeliveryBucket, !Ref ConfigBucket, !Ref DeliveryBucketName]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Encryption-at-rest foundation for a restaurant assistant application"

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    Description: "The name of the project, used for resource naming"
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: "The deployment environment (e.g., dev, staging, prod)"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key with automatic rotation
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for ${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName} encryption-at-rest"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: "key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-encryption-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # DynamoDB Sessions Table
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-sessions"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: dataType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: dataType
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # DynamoDB Market Prices Table
  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-market-prices"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: marketName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: lastUpdated
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: marketName
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: ingredient-lastUpdated-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: lastUpdated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # DynamoDB Reminders Table
  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-reminders"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # DynamoDB Rate Limits Table
  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-rate-limits"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # S3 Access Logs Bucket
  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-access-logs"
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket

        Version: "2012-10-17"

          - Sid: "S3ServerAccessLogsPolicy"
