              ArnLike:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-images"
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # S3 Image Bucket with logging enabled
  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: AccessLogsBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-images"
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: "image-bucket-access-logs/"
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: "KMS Key ID for encryption-at-rest"
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKey
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "KMS Key ARN for encryption-at-rest"
    Value: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: "KMS Key Alias"
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKeyAlias
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: "Sessions DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
  MarketPricesTableName:
    Description: "Market Prices DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable
  RemindersTableName:
    Description: "Reminders DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
  RateLimitsTableName:
    Description: "Rate Limits DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref RateLimitsTable
  ImageBucketName:
    Description: "S3 bucket for images"
    Value: !Ref ImageBucket
  AccessLogsBucketName:
    Description: "S3 bucket for access logs"
    Value: !Ref AccessLogsBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Shared identity and state layer for a stateful agent demo on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore'
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Name of the project used to derive SSM parameter store paths'
    Default: finance-agent-demo
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Email address for the seeded test user'
    Default: demo-user@example.com
  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Password for the seeded test user'
    Default: DemoPassword123!
    NoEcho: true
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted domain'
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    Default: finance-agent-demo-domain
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-user-pool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Verify your email for the finance agent demo'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub ${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::StackName}
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub ${ProjectName}-api
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-resource-server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: finance.read
          ScopeDescription: Read finance tracking data
        - ScopeName: finance.write
          ScopeDescription: Write finance tracking data
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-m2m-client
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub ${CognitoResourceServer}/finance.read
        - !Sub ${CognitoResourceServer}/finance.write
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-web-client
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - phone
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
        - !Sub ${CognitoResourceServer}/finance.read
        - !Sub ${CognitoResourceServer}/finance.write
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoTestUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser
    Properties:
      DesiredDeliveryMediums:
        - EMAIL
      ForceAliasCreation: false
      UserAttributes:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail
        - Name: email_verified
          Value: 'true'
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  SetPasswordRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-set-password-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SetPasswordPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                Resource: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  SetPasswordFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-set-password
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SetPasswordRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              user_pool_id = props['UserPoolId']
              username = props['Username']
              password = props['Password']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      # No cleanup needed
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                  else:
                      client.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          Password=password,
                          Permanent=True
                      )
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})
      Timeout: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  SetPasswordCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::SetPassword
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SetPasswordFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      Password: !Ref TestUserPassword
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoTestUser
  DynamoDBFinanceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-finance-state
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: SessionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: SessionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  MCPExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-mcp-server-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MCPDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBFinanceTable.Arn
                  - !Sub ${DynamoDBFinanceTable.Arn}/index/*
        - PolicyName: MCPBedrockAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeAgent
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MCPSSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  AgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBFinanceTable.Arn
                  - !Sub ${DynamoDBFinanceTable.Arn}/index/*
        - PolicyName: AgentBedrockAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeAgent
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                  - bedrock:RetrieveAndGenerate
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AgentSSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
      Description: 'Cognito User Pool ARN'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/m2m-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoM2MClient
      Description: 'Machine-to-machine client ID for client credentials flow'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/web-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoWebClient
      Description: 'Web client ID for interactive sign-in'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMOIDCDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/oidc-discovery-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration
      Description: 'OpenID Connect discovery endpoint'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/cognito/token-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://${CognitoUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token
      Description: 'OAuth2 token endpoint'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMTableName:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/dynamodb/table-name
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DynamoDBFinanceTable
      Description: 'DynamoDB table name for finance tracking state'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMMCPServerRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/iam/mcp-server-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MCPExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: 'IAM role ARN for the MCP server runtime'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
  SSMAgentRuntimeRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/iam/agent-runtime-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: 'IAM role ARN for the agent runtime'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Two-tier VPC network with public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, and Internet Gateway"
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 1"
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet 2"
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 1"
    Default: "10.0.101.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet 2"
    Default: "10.0.102.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2"
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  EIP1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NATGateway1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1"
  NATGateway2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-id"
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: "Public Subnet 1 ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1-id"
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: "Public Subnet 2 ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2-id"
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: "Private Subnet 1 ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1-id"
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: "Private Subnet 2 ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2-id"
